chapters.title: Chapter 1551: Forming the First Chaos Heart (7)
paragraphs: [Chaos’s Memory - First Dragon Tribulation]
Chaos had just returned from a hunt after he chased down a merchant who many claimed had over 20,000 drops of Dragon Spirit Essence.
It was a few years after his name started to spread in the Blood Region.
Once he secured the essence, which actually turned out to be more than he expected, he chose to shed his first scale and form a new one.
So he began, absorbing all 25,600 drops. While it was nowhere close to how much he could consume, he didn’t have the luxury to be picky, so he used the little he had to temper the essentials.
When the last was absorbed, the tribulation cloud started to form.
[Start of the memory]

"Ah, Elina would have loved this moment. She always wanted to see what my first shedding would be like," he sighed, a pained look crossing his eyes. He gnashed his teeth, pain and a frown appearing on his face
"Forsaken bastards, just wait for me. I will be sure to eradicate your filthy lives from the face of the universe."
He looked up, and for a moment, he wished for a day when he would reunite with his beloved.
But then his moment was interrupted when a Chinese chess (Go) board appeared from the cloud and stopped just before him.
From the cloud, a silhouette of a handsome man who appeared to be in his late 40s emerged and sat opposite him. He occupied the white (yang) side of the board while Chaos stood on the black (yin).
The man had dragon horns and a few silver dragon scales lined perfectly along his neck. He had silver hair, a rather beautiful hair compared to Chaos dirty gold with strands of crimson.
His tail was not visible, but Chaos knew he had one. He himself had one, but thanks to his superior bloodline, he could make it disappear whenever he wanted.
His expression remained calm despite having the faintest idea of who the man was or what his motives were. Also, he could not read his cultivation base, something many would be freaked out about.
Not Chaos, by the way.

Inwardly, he was a bit disturbed that the man in question was wearing a blindfold. If this were before he met Elina, he would have assumed it was a weird fashion that lower existences, or, as he used to call them, humans, indulge themselves in.
However, he now knew the man was blind.
"Who are you?" he asked in his unusual, tired tone.
The man looked at him and smiled.

"Some dragon you are, young man. I have lived since the dawn of time, since the eras before this, but I have never met a coldhearted, strong-willed, and slightly messed up dragon...no person, like you before."
Chaos frowned a bit, but then his expression relaxed. "I am one of a kind."

"Oh, I have no doubt about that," the man laughed. "I have been watching you closely, young man, and I have to be frank with you, the kind of path you are walking will not lead anywhere good. The path of slaughter and chaos, just who wants to live such a life? You had a chance to live a normal life, but threw it away."
Chaos narrowed his eyes at the man but said nothing.

"You could have been different. You could have learned to love, known peace, and learned how painful heartbreak is. But here you are, knee-deep in the chaos of this world, chasing nothing but destruction."
The man smiled.
"You know, I once fought Destruction but instantly regretted it after a few exchanges. Destruction is a variant of Chaos, and since you are the Master of Chaos, I suppose I can see some similarities.
However, tell me this: after all this chaos, all this destruction, what then would you do with your life?"
Chaos did not immediately reply.
Instead, he smiled, something he had never done since the day he left Elina’s side and returned to his homeworld when he learned the Forsaken Race was sweeping across their star system.
Showing a smile now felt somehow wrong, but the blind man did not mind.
Chaos slowly spoke... "If two people decide to fight, there is bound to be destruction. However, the moment one of them dies, that chaos, the destruction, the pain, and suffering will die with them.

You ask what I will do after all of this is done. My answer is simple: I will become the one standing, making sure that in my presence, there will not be anyone brave enough to even dare to start a fight. I will become the rule, the law."

The blind man smiled. "You know, I have this friend, a bit handsome, with white hair like a sage and golden eyes that attract all the ladies. He calls himself the Paragon, claiming he is stronger than everyone. Come to think of it, he indeed is scary. I crossed swords with him once, and I regretted it after a few exchanges."
"Your point is?"
"Wow, chill, bro. You have to allow me to premise the argument."
Chaos glared hatefully at the man and groaned.

"Better. Now, where was I... Oh, Paragon. He was one dangerous dude, perhaps the scariest of them all. In case you two meet one day, do not antagonize him. Ah, come to think of it, you two seem to share some traits.
When I asked him the same question I asked you, his answer was simple: he is absolute, and so he fears nothing; rather, everything fears him. The audacity of that bastard."
Chaos wanted to punch the bastard in the face, but he restrained himself.
Perhaps seeing that he was losing his temper—the irony in that, considering he is blind—he smiled and brought his words to a great climax.

"The point here is, you are crazy, and as it happens, I, the Master of Purgatory, like crazy bastards. So we are going to play a game, one that, if you succeed, as Paragon used to say, you will have the chance to become an absolute.
However, if you fail, then you can forget about avenging your dear girlfriend. Do we have a deal, Master of Chaos?"
[Present day]

Kent let a pale smile appear on his face as he looked at the chessboard slowly descending from the clouds. For a moment, he felt like he had a sense of déjà vu, which he did, only that what he saw was a false positive.
The chessboard stopped before him, and like before, the black side pointed toward him.
From the cloud, a silver-haired dragon-man descended, his expression filled with great happiness, even though he was blind. When he reached Kent’s level, his smile widened even more.
"We meet again, old friend," he said, acknowledging Kent.
"We indeed meet again, Master of Purgatory," Kent also smiled and sat down opposite the silver-haired man.
In the distance, Vexthra and the other ladies frowned, their expressions filled with confusion. However, seeing Kent smile with the man, they relaxed a bit.
They could tell he was in no danger whatsoever.
Though the man, whose back was the only thing they could see, unsettled them.
"13 eras had passed since we last saw each other, Master of Chaos. How has life been treating you?"
"Pretty good," Kent replied, maintaining his smile. "How about you? Anything new happen to you?"

Master of Purgatory thought for a moment and nodded. "Indeed. That crazy bastard had to go pick a fight with some beings you and I have no business fighting. In fact, he was the reason why I am here today."
Master of Purgatory grinned and pointed up. "He sends his regards."

chapters.title: Chapter 1552: Forming the First Chaos Heart (8)
paragraphs: Kent looked up just as a statue of a dragon appeared from the tribulation cloud and hovered right below it.
He felt a chill run down his spine when he laid eyes on this statue.
"Damn, just what is this thing?"
The Master of Purgatory smiled as if he had read his mind.

"This statue, according to Paragon, is an absolute form of your current self. This means this dragon is a Heavenly Ascension Stage, but a perfect absolute version of what, in his eyes, a Heavenly Ascension Stage being in this in this uninverse should be."
Kent narrowed his eyes at the statue, fear gripping him.
As a dragon, he can be considered a predator, an existence that sees everyone else as prey. So, for him to be feeling fear meant the dragon statue was something to be afraid of.

"Just what kind of person is he?" Kent asked, then let out a sigh. After a few seconds, he added, "I had the privilege to meet his older selves, and recently, I met his younger self, but every version of him scares me."
"Big Brother Paragon is an existence that cannot be comprehended. When I met him for the first time ever, I wondered just what kind of existence he was, for even I couldn’t see his true peak."
Kent cleared his throat as if to say, but you are blind, so how can you see him, but he just smiled. Master of Purgatory also smiled.

"The point is, he took interest in growth, and thanks to his rogue nature, I grew into an existence that even the heavens came to fear. I still don’t know why he has taken an interest in you, but what I can tell you is this: when the Paragon comes calling, it is nothing good. However, most of the time, it had to do something very important, something that the Presence of the Primordial Chaos Dragon would be needed.

So we must play chess again, only that this time, it will be against a monster who can break into any universe and manipulate events, all just to ensure the people he calls friends suffer, but one day becomes the absolute version of themselves."
Kent smiled, for he knew indeed his life had been manipulated by the Paragon in all the right ways from the start. The [Soul Universe] and his living sword [Gaap] were all his doing.
However, just what is he up to this time around?
"Tell me plainly, Master of Purgatory, compared to this statue, how far have I risen? In other words, out of 100, what is my score if the statue is a 100?"
"Probably 65%."
"That low?" Kent smiled.

"Yes. But that would become 100% if you can win against this statue today. In simple terms, defeat this statue, and you will become an absolute. Your new scales will be absolute. Your bloodline will be the same. Everything about you will become absolute."
"What if I fail?"
"Well, if you fail, I guess I will have no reason to visit you again."
Kent took a deep breath, picked one black stone, and placed it in a strategic position on the board. "I suppose becoming an absolute doesn’t sound too bad."
"That is the spirit."
Kent stood up and walked over to his wives. "Things are about to get chaotic. However, whatever happens, do not try to help me."
They nodded, though all their focus was shifted to the Master of Purgatory.
Vexthra asked, "Who is that man?"
Kent smiled and kissed her forehead. "An old friend of mine."
That was all they needed to hear.
Afterward, they kissed him, Ainna distancing herself from him, with a clear sign she had no plans to kiss him.
Kent just laughed and moved away.
"Okay, Master of Purgatory, let’s play chess."
Kent rose into the air, and as he did, his body started to transform. By the time he was 100 meters from the statue, he had turned into a colossal dragon.
He let out a powerful roar, releasing terrifying killing intent.
The Master of Purgatory smiled. "Indeed, let’s play chess."
He placed a white stone on the board, and up in the air, the statue cracked. The crack expanded, and soon, it started to line the entire body. Some parts began to fall off.
It took just a few seconds for a golden dragon to be revealed.
It was the same size as Kent, just that while Kent has a dark-gold scale with streaks of red, the new dragon is completely golden.
Its crimson eyes, however, caused Kent to close his eyes for a moment—a moment he regretted.
BOOM
A terrifying tail slammed into his body, sending him crashing back to the ground. The attack rattled him, his body trembling.
As he fell, his mind spinning, a terrifying thought flashed through his mind, causing him to close his eyes at once. This time, he shut them for his own good.
"Drago Gaze,"
He recognized the skill, and that was why he shut his eyes. From what he knew, it was one of the most terrifying innate abilities a dragon could ever awaken.
Chaos awakened it after his second tribulation, and since then, he had become a terror that could easily defeat an opponent with a mere gaze.
"I suppose tempering my mind was what saved me... ahhhh!" he screamed when his body finally slammed into the ground.
However, he flapped his wings and was back up, his maw opening. Just as he did, a terrifying torrent of green flames burst out, lunging at the golden dragon.
He aimed to burn it to a crisp.
However, to his shock, just as his flame was 3 meters away, the golden dragon’s tail elongated, its scales rearranging themselves into a deadly, whip-like weapon.
Before he could make sense of everything, a terrifying whip slashed across the side of his face, blood gushing out from his mouth and nose.
"OUCH!" he screams, his voice spreading across the planet.
On the ground, his wives wince, their hands instinctively going to their faces.
On the other side, Ainna grinned. "That’s got to hurt," she laughed and added, "Go, Mr. Gold Dragon. Teach this bastard a lesson."
Inaya glared hatefully at her friend, but Ainna just stuck out her tongue in a teasing manner.
"Bitch." She turned away, fist clenched.

In the air, the flame breath attack missed, and Kent was sent flying back. However, just when he was getting out of range, the dragon’s tail whipped through the air and grabbed him by the neck, pulling him back again.
Just as he was sent flying back, Kent saw from his peripheral vision a terrifying claw attack that, if he didn’t evade, the battle would come to an end in an instant come at him.
"Damn you, Paragon..."
He ignited his body in green and red flames, and then his wings expanded.
Just when the claw was a meter away, a humming sound came from his wings, and he vanished from sight, the void cracking where he had stood a moment before.
The claw attack missed, striking nothing but air.
3 km away, Kent hovered in the air, eyes closed, Soul Map opened as he looked at the golden dragon. His metallic dragon wings now had an added layer: dark-silver wings humming with void energy.
The Jade Void Wings have been active.
Kent knew he had to use it, so after igniting all his flame veins, he activated it, saving him from the claw attack.
As if playing the game in person, a black stone move landed on an offensive spot on the board. The Master of Purgatory smiled and placed a second stone on the board.
Up in the air, the golden dragon let out a terrifying roar and expanded its wings. In the distance, Kent did the same. They each took a deep breath, and then they vanished, clashing in the air.
Shockwaves exploded from their bodies, crashing down. Wherever their attacks met, the void shattered. Soon, blood started to rain down.

chapters.title: Chapter 1553: Forming the First Chaos Heart (9)
paragraphs: Kent’s claw scraped across the surface of the golden dragon’s scales, letting out a metallic sound. Seeing he can’t hurt it, he distanced himself.
However, just when he was about to move several steps back, a whip lashed across his back, a painful sensation seeping into his body.
’This is so embarrashing...’
He endured the pain and moved his body mid-air, arranging his wings to form a razor-sharp weapon. He flew up and dove down at a terrifying speed.
Using the momentum of his descent, he landed a terrifying slash across the side of the golden dragon.
This time, his attack connected, leaving a cut mark on its body. Kent flew back and unleashed a breath attack before moving further back to catch his breath.
His body was streaked with several cuts, blood dripping from them.

He had tried very hard to maintain his flow, but with every new plan he cooked up, the golden dragon seemed to have a counter. Naturally, the game of chess between him and the Master of Purgatory wasn’t going well for him.

In the past, he seemed to have held his own against him even from the start. However, the game was now being played between him and two terrifying entities. The fact that he still remains in the game is a miracle in itself.
Paragon was an existence even the Master of Purgatory had no idea just how deep he went.
So while he may have had it easy in the past, this time around, he was fighting a battle that even he had no idea just how deep it went.
’Is this how terrifying an absolute is?’ Kent thought, his mind wandering to just how terrifying he really would become if he were to reach such a stage.
His thought was interrupted when the golden dragon moved and was upon him the next moment. He also moved, and the deadly struggle continued.
As the battle raged on, Kent couldn’t help but start to pick up on some subtle hints that if he were to capture a few more, he would be able to have some success in the offensive.

He knew for a fact there would be no opening he could exploit, so his focus was rather turned to finding patterns he could exploit. As it happened, in his mind were 1.6 million possible moves an opponent could make.

While his brain isn’t strong enough just yet to be able to detect and create a counter against an opponent like the golden dragon, he knew if he could find a pattern, winning wouldn’t be too far from sight.
The problem, however, was that he had to stay alive to comprehend those patterns.
"Ah, the journey to the peak this time is a bit more harrowing than the last time."

Kent evaded a tail attack, and then he unleashed a breath attack before jumping into the chaos, his body going into a deadly spin. This move, however, allowed him to turn the jade void wings into sharp weapons.
Metallic sounds filled the air as the golden dragon was pushed back. It tried to push back, even attacking with its whip-like tail, but Kent pressed on, spinning faster.
Suddenly, just when he managed to cut into the side of the golden dragon, Kent sensed his body become sluggish.
On the ground, the Master of Purgatory smiled. "Your move now, Master of Chaos."
Up in the air, Kent grew heavy, his spinning suddenly dull.
"What is happening?"
[It appears the master was struck with a paralytic debuff skill. Right now, the master has suffered a 30% debuff to all attributes.]
"Oh, that is some dirty—" He was sent crashing down, his body digging a deep crater into the ground before he could finish his sentence.
Kent rose back up, and before the golden dragon could close in on him, he vanished from where he stood and appeared in the air.
"This is crazy. I have lived many lives, yet a mere dragon is trashing me like I am some kind of—"
"Wait a minute. I have lived more than one life. Meaning I have more than one set of experiences. Meaning I can use any form of skill and technique."
Kent felt like he had neglected a critical aspect of his existence.

He is a true reincarnator, meaning he has lived many lives and remembers them all. Since that is the case, why not fight with all parts of him? Being the Chaos Dragon is just a part of him. He had lived 13 lives, and so he cannot sum up his entire existence based on just one life.
’I was Chaos, the primordial Chaos Dragon.’
’I was Jest, the Sword Genesis.’
’I was Jaqen, the faceless assassin.’
’I was Kevin Sage, the smartest man to ever live.’
’I was Lex Morvane, the Ruthless Bandit.’
’I was Aurelion, the Divine Beast Tamer.’
Back on the ground, the Master of Purgatory smiled, watching as six black stones moved and stopped at strategic positions.
"Ah, looks like he has figured it out."
He looked up and smiled. "But how much can you use, Master of Chaos? How close can you come to defeating a perfect version of yourself?"

Suddenly, on the ground, thousands of shadows moved and flew toward Kent. They surrounded him, completely shielding him from everyone. The golden dragon sensed something was up, so it moved, closing the gap between them.
Just when it was close enough to attack, the shadows moved, and a black-clothed Kent appeared, a scythe fashioned from darkness going for a deadly swing.

His scythe met the deadly whip-like tail of the dragon. Just when that happened, some shadows moved and closed in on the dragon. Kent smiled and dissolved into the shadows, appearing overhead of the dragon, his scythe held in both hands, going for an overhead slash.
His attack never connected, but it appeared he expected that. Just when his weapon was mere inches away from digging itself into the dragon, the deadly tail appeared and stabbed him from behind.
However, instead of blood coming out, a mist of smoky shadow appeared, causing the Master of Purgatory to smile.
Kent dissolved into shadows again, but instead of going for another attack in person, he appeared 300 meters away and gestured forward.
His soul universe surged, and thousands of spears appeared, raining down on the poor dragon.
He moved again, leaving a trail of shadows in his wake. When he appeared before the dragon, the scene around him started to transform.
Standing several kilometers away, Inaya smiled. "Here we go."
Up in the air, a sea of swords surged, creating a raging tide of power, the kind that caused even the Master of Purgatory to furrow his brow.
’Well, that is new.’
He had seen the Genesis Sword Realm before, but this time, he seemed to have sensed something new about it. Naturally, it was because Kent had attained True Sword Energy this time around.
The Genesis Sword Realm roared to life, and the sea of swords formed, taking on the appearance of a dragon. Kent gestured forward, and the dragon moved, clashing with the golden dragon.
Kent felt like he could do more, and so he did. He transformed into his humanoid form and extended his hand, summoning an ordinary sword.
He pointed it forward and tapped into his memories of Lord Genesis. Suddenly, the clouds, already infected by the tribulation churn and red lightning, began to form.
Suddenly, a powerful red lightning bolt descended and landed on the sword. Kent smiled and raised it up, using both hands to hold it.
"Heaven & Earth Cleaver."
RUMBLE...

chapters.title: Chapter 1554: Forming the First Chaos Heart (10)
paragraphs: He slashed his sword downward, and a deadly arc flashed out, leaving trails of red lightning in its wake.

Already, the golden dragon was being besieged by thousands of spears and a sea of swords fashioned from sword aura and augmented by sword intent. So when the sword arc closed in on it, it had little to no time to react.
So the sword attack landed on its body, cutting a deep wound into it.
But Kent had only begun.
He moved, and before long, hundreds of sword arcs appeared, each finding its mark on the golden dragon’s body. The air had turned into a canvas, sword arcs painting beautiful images on it.
On the ground, the Master of Purgatory continued to smile as he watched this.
Vexthra and her sisters were the same. The only one with a frown was Ainna, who hoped Kent would get trashed some more. Now, he seemed to have found his groove.
He kept switching between Chaos, Faceless, and Jest.
When a deadly attack closed in on him, he would turn into a shadow and become intangible. This allowed him to avoid almost all the attacks that were aimed at him.

Then, with his Jest form, he allowed his sword to speak for him. Of course, with his sword ranking, he wasn’t having much success in that form. However, that changed nothing because, from what he had seen so far, the True Sword Energy he had awakened had made it so he could deal more devastating attacks.
However, where he lacked in his Jest form, his Chaos form compensated for that.
"He is just a Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator, yet he fights like a True Immortal. What a monster," Ainna muttered, a little bit too loudly. Inaya smirked.
"You haven’t seen anything yet. Or do you think I ran to him when that Sword God was after me because of his good looks? I knew he was the only one in the universe who could help."
She had nothing to say about that, so she could only continue to watch.
Hours passed by, yet Kent hadn’t managed to bring down the dragon. However, by now, he had seen some patterns and had created a perfect counter to all of them.
First, he rendered the dragon’s tail attacks useless by making sure that every time, his body turned to shadows. Thankfully, he had more than enough shadows at his disposal.
So he wasn’t being bothered by that anymore.
Their speeds matched thanks to the Jade Void Wings and all 340,000 flame veins.
While there was a gap in strength between him and the golden dragon, he compensated for that, too, using the blood seals. However, Kent noticed he couldn’t harness the power of all 250,000.

At most, he was able to harness 105,000, which, if he looked critically at it, meant the new blood seals he had formed couldn’t be used. So while he couldn’t say they were matched in strength, he was able to match it in some way.
If he had the means to harness all 250,000, perhaps he would have been stronger.
However, despite all that downside, everything had started to change now that he had begun using all of his abilities.
Of course, he had already begun recalling most of his memories, but he couldn’t use all of them. In fact, aside from Chaos, Jest, and Faceless, the rest weren’t ones he could use just yet.
His life as Kevin Sage wouldn’t help him in this danger, and the same went for his life as the Ruthless Bandit.

As for the Divine Beast Tamer, that life was what Kent was counting on to win this. He might not have as many memories of that life as the other three. However, what he knew in that life was precisely why he thought he could use it to win.
’But how can I keep this monster away from me for at least five seconds?’
Kent’s mind spun, all kinds of thoughts moving through his head, looking for a way to keep the golden dragon grounded for at least five seconds.
If he could keep it locked down for just that long, then winning was guaranteed.

A stabbing attack from the dragon’s tail pierced him through the chest, but Kent wasn’t even scratched. Instead, he moved and appeared over its colossal body. But before he could attack, the golden dragon retaliated, unleashing a breath attack.
Chaos Scales rearranged themselves, creating a shield that blocked the flame-breath attack.
He retreated and allowed the moment to pass, since landing an attack wouldn’t be possible. Yet again, he was attacked by the tail, but like before, he became a shadow.
In fact, he had trained his body to detect the attack and become a shadow, just to render it null. Thankfully, the dragon was just too monstrous, so he had all the motivation to master that.
Suddenly, the dragon came down on him with a claw attack.
However, Kent responded by forming the [Chaos Scale Shield] to block it. Its claws landed on the shield, and it trembled. However, it held, and for a moment, Kent felt something strange.
He may not have felt it before; however, just now, when the claw attack landed on the shield, he sensed deep within his soul a part of his blood sea surge, causing the chaos shield to bend slightly.
’Don’t tell me,’
His eyes widened.
’Oh, this is something,’
He wanted to laugh, but stopped himself.
Instead, he tapped into the sensation he felt, and lo and behold, he saw where the change came from.

A while back, he awakened two bloodline innate skills, one of them being the [Blood Calamity Fist]. It basically had to do with harnessing blood to form a large, overpowered fist that, when unleashed, not even a dragon can handle.
He had mastered it to the perfection stage but never used it. He suspected that without the blood runes augmentation, he wouldn’t be able to bring out its true power.
Today, he sensed it calling, and when he answered, what he saw was a bit joyful.
’Oh, so I can use it like that, huh?’
He smiled and distanced himself from the golden dragon.

On the ground, a black stone moved and stopped at a strategic position, one that made the Master of Purgatory frown. He tried to place a white piece, but he saw his move would yield no defence at all.
"Oh, nicely played, Master of Chaos."
In the air, just when Kent distanced himself, he formed a hand seal, and all 105,000 blood runes were activated. Then he waved his hand, manifesting over 800,000 pentagon-shaped chaos scales.

The moment they appeared, he tapped into his nature as Lord Genesis and used his hand to move them all, covering the entire body of the golden dragon. In an instant, its colour changed to crimson gold.
But that wasn’t all.

Tapping into the blood using knowledge from the [Blood Calamity Fist], he unleashed all his 105,000 blood runes and used them to form a complex lock, making sure every last chaos scale remained locked in place.
Just when that was done, his right hand moved, and the [Spirit Brush] appeared in it.
’One,’ he started to count.
’Two.’
His hand moved, and a rune started to manifest in the air. In that instant, too, blood started to drain from his face.
However, he held on strong.
’Three.’
’Four.’

Just when he reached the fourth second, a part of the shield cracked. This made him push harder, and just when the dragon’s tail burst out, a brilliant light exploded in the air, causing everyone watching to shield their eyes.
"And that is checkmate, Master of Purgatory." Kent muttered

chapters.title: Chapter 1555: Rebirth (1)
paragraphs: Cleanly written in the air was a beautiful rune that read ’cut’.
Around it, an incredible sword aura, one that seemed to have been forged from the very core of the Sword Dao, sharpened the air, making it extremely lethal to even look at.

Before the battle, the Master of Purgatory told him he would be fighting against a perfect, absolute version of himself, or at least what an absolute version of a Heavenly Ascension cultivator, in the Paragon’s eyes, should be.
Naturally, that was everything he needed to know. Winning with his own strength was just impossible.

He could not win, even if he had unlimited energy and unflagging stamina. In his eyes, the absolute version of himself is a monster beyond understanding. Winning using conventional ways is just impossible.
So he first chose to fight it.
This decision was so that he could find out just what an absolute version of himself would be like.
Safe to say, he saw it, and the result was abysmal. He was wrecked, and he knew deep within him that it was true; he was way weaker than he should be.
But it also showed him what he needed to see.
What he needed to know.
He saw how perfect and strong he was, how much he had to put in to be able to match the dragon.

But unfortunately, while he would have loved to keep fighting and slowly adapt and improve, he knew he would die before that happened. The dragon had what it took to kill him, so he had to come up with a way to be able to unleash an attack that matched the perfect version of himself.
So he did.
He tapped into his nature as a Spirit Master and wrote a perfect attack into the word ’Cut’.
It contained a perfect mastery of his sword at the Sword King stage. This included his mastery over his sword aura, sword intent, sword realm, and sword understanding.
Thankfully, he also had True Sword Energy, so that amplified everything.
Now that the rune was complete, he smiled and pressed the Spirit Brush against it and commanded,
"CUT."
The rune dissolved into a golden light and turned into a sword arc, one that sliced apart the void before severing the golden dragon in half.
For a moment, none of Kent’s wives said anything. Rather, their gazes were locked on the cleanly cut dragon, mouths agape.
A few seconds later, however, smiles formed on their faces.
"Now, that is what I am talking about," Inaya let out a joyful cheer, causing Kent to turn and look in her direction. Watching their happy expressions, he waved and blew a kiss in their direction.
They were happy and finally relaxed, considering that the past four hours had been the tensest any of them had ever been.
From the first few seconds of the battle, they knew Kent had met a monster. And as time passed, their tense feelings only seemed to increase. Now, however, they were happy to see their man had won.
The Master of Purgatory flew toward Kent.
"Congratulations on your win, Master of Chaos. For a moment there, I thought you would lose, but you have proven yourself, and for that, congratulations."
"Thank you, Master of Purgatory."
He nodded and extended his hand.
An exact miniature copy of the dragon Kent had just fought appeared.

"You should train harder, my friend. Your Universe and others out there need you, so become stronger very fast. I know for a fact that one day you will be able to fight on the same battlefield as Paragon, me, and the other.

I have no idea what fight he has found himself in now, but I do know it will be a battle to determine the fate of everything. Your universe, mine, and several others will rest on our shoulders, so train harder and faster."

Master of Purgatory let out a small smile and tapped Kent on the shoulder. "No pressure, though. In my universe, I was called the greatest swordsman to ever live, and I still am. However, while you aren’t even at 5% yet, I can tell you have the potential to reach my level one day.
In fact, I can tell you have already glimpsed the realm above the Celestial stage. Good, that is the realm you should get to before you can dream of crossing swords with me.

So train hard and don’t be afraid of who you are. I may be the Master of Purgatory, but you are the Master of Chaos. Perhaps among us, you will be the one to finally measure up to the Paragon and even surpass him."
Kent smiled. "He is that powerful, huh?"
"You have no idea.

But I guess that is why I am here. Because of his nature, helping us reach his level someday is easy for him. Once you discover what this statue is, you will understand why everyone needs him in their life.

So like I said, train hard and never walk away from those close to you. Believe it or not, those in our hearts aren’t our weakness; they are our strength. So cherish them, and when the time comes, they will be the weapons you will wield in battle."
Kent chuckled. "Although the ending is a bit unhinged, I see where your heart is, and I appreciate that."
The Master of Purgatory smiled and handed over the golden statue to Kent.
"I will be leaving now."
Kent nodded, but then a question came to mind. "How many would we be? You know, the team."
"Ah, glad you asked..."
RUMBLE
The sky started to turn dark, a clear sign that he had overstayed his welcome.
"Looks like I have to leave before those seven bastards get their hands on me." He winked at Kent—or more like Kent saw his brow twitch beneath the blindfold.
"Oh, in case you meet a certain handsome redhead with a skull tattoo on his forehead, tattered armor, and a terrifying black scythe placed on his shoulder, don’t antagonize him."
"Huh. Who is he?"
"The Paragon’s second unhinged sworn brother. Also a terrifying bastard."
The Master of Purgatory vanished, leaving Kent with a frown. "Huh, I thought I was his sworn brother."
He stood there for a few seconds and smiled. "Ah, he said second sworn brother. I may be the first."
Seated somewhere in the multiverse, a certain monkey holding a large gourd of wine smirked and muttered, "What an idiot. If I land one strike of my staff on his head, he will recover his senses."

Kent felt a chill run down his spine, but he shrugged it off and focused on the statue in his hand. He knew what to do with it, but before that, he wanted to capture its essence and perhaps recreate it.
Unfortunately for him, the creator was meticulous in carving that statue.
"Crazy bastard."
He smirked and turned toward his wives. "Ladies, I will be entering the critical phase now. If anybody who is not a fan of mine appears, you have my permission to slice them in half."
"Fear not, love, we will shred them to pieces."
"Freeze their bones in ice."
"And set them on fire."
Vexthra, Miryssa, and Inaya replied.
Kent nodded and turned toward Ainna, who smirked and turned away from him.
He chuckled and also turned away.
He looked at the statue again and then, in one swift motion, pressed it against his forehead. The moment he did, it vanished into his soul sea, and he transformed into his dragon form.
He let out a loud roar, causing the air to tremble around him.
Tower appeared in the air and hovered before him.𝑓𝑟𝑒𝘦𝓌𝑒𝑏𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝘭.𝒸𝘰𝑚
"Are you ready for your rebirth, Master?"
"Let’s turn me into an absolute perfect version of myself, Tower."

sentences.text: Cleanly written in the air was a beautiful rune that read ’cut’.
Around it, an incredible sword aura, one that seemed to have been forged from the very core of the Sword Dao, sharpened the air, making it extremely lethal to even look at.

Before the battle, the Master of Purgatory told him he would be fighting against a perfect, absolute version of himself, or at least what an absolute version of a Heavenly Ascension cultivator, in the Paragon’s eyes, should be.
Naturally, that was everything he needed to know.
Winning with his own strength was just impossible.
He could not win, even if he had unlimited energy and unflagging stamina.
In his eyes, the absolute version of himself is a monster beyond understanding.
Winning using conventional ways is just impossible.
So he first chose to fight it.
This decision was so that he could find out just what an absolute version of himself would be like.
Safe to say, he saw it, and the result was abysmal.
He was wrecked, and he knew deep within him that it was true; he was way weaker than he should be.
But it also showed him what he needed to see.
What he needed to know.
He saw how perfect and strong he was, how much he had to put in to be able to match the dragon.
But unfortunately, while he would have loved to keep fighting and slowly adapt and improve, he knew he would die before that happened.
The dragon had what it took to kill him, so he had to come up with a way to be able to unleash an attack that matched the perfect version of himself.
So he did.
He tapped into his nature as a Spirit Master and wrote a perfect attack into the word ’Cut’.
It contained a perfect mastery of his sword at the Sword King stage.
This included his mastery over his sword aura, sword intent, sword realm, and sword understanding.
Thankfully, he also had True Sword Energy, so that amplified everything.
Now that the rune was complete, he smiled and pressed the Spirit Brush against it and commanded,
"CUT."
The rune dissolved into a golden light and turned into a sword arc, one that sliced apart the void before severing the golden dragon in half.
For a moment, none of Kent’s wives said anything.
Rather, their gazes were locked on the cleanly cut dragon, mouths agape.
A few seconds later, however, smiles formed on their faces.
"Now, that is what I am talking about," Inaya let out a joyful cheer, causing Kent to turn and look in her direction.
Watching their happy expressions, he waved and blew a kiss in their direction.
They were happy and finally relaxed, considering that the past four hours had been the tensest any of them had ever been.
From the first few seconds of the battle, they knew Kent had met a monster.
And as time passed, their tense feelings only seemed to increase.
Now, however, they were happy to see their man had won.
The Master of Purgatory flew toward Kent.
"Congratulations on your win, Master of Chaos.
For a moment there, I thought you would lose, but you have proven yourself, and for that, congratulations."
"Thank you, Master of Purgatory."
He nodded and extended his hand.
An exact miniature copy of the dragon Kent had just fought appeared.
"You should train harder, my friend.
Your Universe and others out there need you, so become stronger very fast.
I know for a fact that one day you will be able to fight on the same battlefield as Paragon, me, and the other.
I have no idea what fight he has found himself in now, but I do know it will be a battle to determine the fate of everything.
Your universe, mine, and several others will rest on our shoulders, so train harder and faster."
Master of Purgatory let out a small smile and tapped Kent on the shoulder.
"No pressure, though.
In my universe, I was called the greatest swordsman to ever live, and I still am.
However, while you aren’t even at 5% yet, I can tell you have the potential to reach my level one day.
In fact, I can tell you have already glimpsed the realm above the Celestial stage.
Good, that is the realm you should get to before you can dream of crossing swords with me.
So train hard and don’t be afraid of who you are.
I may be the Master of Purgatory, but you are the Master of Chaos.
Perhaps among us, you will be the one to finally measure up to the Paragon and even surpass him."
Kent smiled.
"He is that powerful, huh?"
"You have no idea.
But I guess that is why I am here.
Because of his nature, helping us reach his level someday is easy for him.
Once you discover what this statue is, you will understand why everyone needs him in their life.
So like I said, train hard and never walk away from those close to you.
Believe it or not, those in our hearts aren’t our weakness; they are our strength.
So cherish them, and when the time comes, they will be the weapons you will wield in battle."
Kent chuckled.
"Although the ending is a bit unhinged, I see where your heart is, and I appreciate that."
The Master of Purgatory smiled and handed over the golden statue to Kent.
"I will be leaving now."
Kent nodded, but then a question came to mind.
"How many would we be?
You know, the team."
"Ah, glad you asked..."
RUMBLE
The sky started to turn dark, a clear sign that he had overstayed his welcome.
"Looks like I have to leave before those seven bastards get their hands on me." He winked at Kent—or more like Kent saw his brow twitch beneath the blindfold.
"Oh, in case you meet a certain handsome redhead with a skull tattoo on his forehead, tattered armor, and a terrifying black scythe placed on his shoulder, don’t antagonize him."
"Huh.
Who is he?"
"The Paragon’s second unhinged sworn brother.
Also a terrifying bastard."
The Master of Purgatory vanished, leaving Kent with a frown.
"Huh, I thought I was his sworn brother."
He stood there for a few seconds and smiled.
"Ah, he said second sworn brother.
I may be the first."
Seated somewhere in the multiverse, a certain monkey holding a large gourd of wine smirked and muttered, "What an idiot.
If I land one strike of my staff on his head, he will recover his senses."
Kent felt a chill run down his spine, but he shrugged it off and focused on the statue in his hand.
He knew what to do with it, but before that, he wanted to capture its essence and perhaps recreate it.
Unfortunately for him, the creator was meticulous in carving that statue.
"Crazy bastard."

chapters.title: Chapter 1556: Rebirth (2)
paragraphs: "Okay, Master, let’s get started," Tower said, pointing her finger at Kent’s forehead. Judging by how tiny she was compared to Kent’s colossal dragon body, even a mosquito was bigger.

But her size doesn’t matter in this regard. The moment she took action, Kent felt his body begin to change. He felt it—he was about to transcend so many stages of weakness, finally stepping into the rank of a True Chaos Dragon.

When Chaos had his first tribulation, he went from fighting Immortal Kings to Immortal Monarchs when he was merely a True Immortal. But when he formed the Chaos Heart, even demigods were within his capabilities, especially in moments when the chaos of the battle had reached the point where nobody was safe.
Tower remained in that state for ten minutes before a delighted expression suddenly appeared on her face.
"This is unreal," she muttered, fascination etched all over her face.
"What is it?" Kent asked.
"Master, this statue—it is beyond anything I have ever seen or imagined. It is like... I can’t even put it into words."
"Ah, that monster literally gave me an entire universe that resides in my soul. What makes you think he isn’t capable of doing more than that?"

"I suppose the Master is right. But this is beyond the soul universe, Master." Tower’s eyes sparkled. "This is like the masterpiece manual that has been designed to override everything, allowing you to unlock and awaken every last bit of your potential."

"Master, if before you were using 60% of your potential, then from now onward, this statue will push you to be at your absolute peak. You will even hate yourself if you aren’t performing at your best."
"My good luck, I suppose. That said, I really need all the help I can get, so we might as well use this now and think about how we can repay him later."
Tower nodded. "I suppose the Master is right. In that case, let’s get down to business."
She formed a hand seal, and deep inside Kent’s soul sea, the statue trembled and released waves of unknown energy.
"The Master will lose consciousness for the duration of the process. Rest assured, you are in good hands."
"Okay. I need some sleep after the torture I was put through by that damn—"
Tower knocked him out before he could finish his sentence. "Master talks too much."
She used her hand to cover her mouth and laugh. Afterward, she turned and looked at Vexthra and her sisters. Her gaze scanned them for a moment before landing on Ainna.
"Big Sister Ainna, please, I need your help."
"Huh?" Ainna turned and looked behind her, perhaps assuming Tower had made a mistake and was actually speaking to someone behind her. When she saw nobody there, she frowned.
"Me? What do you want from me?"
Tower smiled. "You are going to help me rebuild a body for my Master. Well, I need your supreme essence, but since it would be impolite to take it, I suppose you have to personally help me."

Ainna narrowed her eyes and was about to protest when Inaya grabbed her hand and pulled her forward, sending her flying toward Tower. "Ainna, just stop being petty and help my husband. I will owe you one."
"You—"
In the end, she sighed and glared at Tower just when she stopped a meter from her.
"What do you need me to do?"
"Very simple, Big Sister. When the Master sheds his scales, I will use the dragon spirit essence to further temper his body. You must use the supreme essence to do the same thing I will be doing."
"Hasn’t he already tempered his body?" she asked, a bit taken aback by Tower’s request.

"Yes, Master indeed has tempered his body. But it was only 60% done. Now, we have to complete the remaining 40% and make sure that when new scales are formed, he will become a mortal with a body worthy of a Supreme."
Ainna looked at Tower intently for a few minutes and then chuckled. "Tch. You and your Master will owe me a great deal. You had better pay up when I come knocking."
Tower smiled and nodded. "Rest assured, Big Sister, we will pay up with interest."
"I hope so."
Standing on the ground, Inaya smiled and turned to her sister. "Forgive her. She is just too petty."
"Oh, we are not mad." Vexthra smiled. "I, for one, would love to see just how hard she would fall when Kent gets his hands on her."
"Indeed." Miryssa nodded, a smirk forming at the corner of her lips.
Inaya just laughed.
"I wonder if that would ever happen. Ainna is the type of person who doesn’t know what she wants."
Vexthra placed her hand on Inaya’s shoulder and chuckled. "Leave everything to Selene. She will make sure she gets what she wants without her even knowing it."
They laughed.
Meanwhile, Ainna and Tower got to work.
A golden light surrounded Kent’s body for an hour before; suddenly, his scales started to fall off. "Big Sister, you can start when I give the command."
Ainna nodded and prepared.
Within ten minutes, every last scale came off Kent’s body.

The dragon spirit essence appeared, and Tower started using it to temper Kent’s body. Inside his soul sea, the golden statue emitted a brilliant light and began releasing golden runes, which flew in all directions.
"Big Sister, you can start now."

Ainna channeled her supreme essence and started tempering Kent’s colossal body. While she would have loved to torture him, she recognized this was an important moment for Kent and her friend Inaya, so she swallowed her anger and chose to do better work first.
After all, no matter how monstrous Kent becomes, he would be nowhere near the rank of a Supreme. So there would be plenty of time to get petty.
The process seemed to be going smoothly.

Once they were done, Kent would naturally form new scales, so for now, making his body strong enough was the priority. The golden statue was also doing its job—unlocking limits Kent hadn’t yet broken and awakening potentials he had yet to.
The process was affecting all his nature, be that of his dragon, sword, assassin, and other professions.
When he awakened, he wouldn’t be the same Kent anymore. His physique, mind, and soul would change, bringing out the best in him.
"I can’t wait to see the kind of monster he will become," Miryssa muttered, and her sister nodded.

Vexthra opened her mouth to say something, but she never got the chance. The next second, all three of them turned their gaze to the left, their vision piercing thousands of kilometers to look at three people who had just appeared through a secret teleportation gate.
A smile formed on their faces. "They are here."
"How should we handle this?" Inaya asked, summoning her sword as her evil Sword Dao ignited.
"Let’s capture all three of them and send them to the Tower Prisons for now."
Inaya and Miryssa nodded and vanished. Vexthra remained to stand guard.

Meanwhile, while everything was happening, Kent appeared in the middle of a desert, the scorching hot sun burning his scalp. "Ah, my bad luck. I only wanted to take a nap. Is that too much of an ask?"
He looked around for a few seconds before a frown appeared on his face.
He asked in a lazy tone, "Why am I here?"
"To see me, of course," a voice came from behind him. Turning around, his gaze landed on the last person he wanted to see.
"Ruthless Bandit..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1557: Conversation With The Ruthless Bandit
paragraphs: Kent anticipated a good nap while the Tower worked on building him a body worthy of his power. However, that dream was shattered when he appeared in this scorching hot desert.
To make matters even worse, he now stood face to face with the last person he expected to see - the Ruthless Bandit.
Among his past lives, the Ruthless Bandit was the one he had the fewest memories of. The reason for that was that, among his past lives, the Ruthless Bandit had it the worst.

The small memories he managed to recover were filled with the most heartbreaking life a person could ever wish for. He couldn’t handle them just yet since the last time he tried, he nearly lost his mind.
So he was a bit scared to even read the memory diary, fearing he might lose his mind again and maybe, this time, end up hurting someone.
The idea that he is afraid of himself is just preposterous. However, in this case, he indeed should be afraid of himself.
Looking at the evil grin on the Ruthless Bandit’s face and the fact that he reeked of blood, Kent couldn’t help but take a few steps back.
"Oh, I can tell you are afraid of me," the Ruthless Bandit smirked and moved toward Kent, appearing behind him despite them facing each other just now.
He placed his hand on Kent’s shoulder and whispered into his ear, "Am I that scary... oh, a much better question, are we that afraid of ourselves, you know, since you and I are the same person?"
Kent tried to wiggle his way out of his grip, but he failed miserably.
"Very funny, buddy. You and I are the same person, so why fear me when you should embrace me instead? Or do you think crossing the Star Gateway can be achieved by being a good person?"

He let go of Kent and laughed. "News flash, you are going to dirty your hands. In fact, you are going to need every bit of me to traverse that path because, guess what, that fancy star compass won’t help you, buddy."
Kent turned and wanted to ask how he knew he had plans to traverse the Star Gateway. But then he remembered all of this was happening in his mind space, and so his memories were simple to read.
He sighed and turned to face the Ruthless Bandit, who flashed him a knowing smile.
"Good. I suppose we can have a good conversation now."
Kent said nothing for a moment, taking a great deal of time to look at the Ruthless Bandit. Once he had had enough of him, he proceeded to ask a very simple question: "Why am I here?"

"Very simple, really, you are here to understand why I, or I should say we, were once called the Ruthless Bandit. Of course, I am not about to tell you what happened to me. I will just tell you the vision and the mission, and then you can continue from there when you go back."
He cleared his throat and began:𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺

"As it turns out, one doesn’t grow up to become the greatest evil; they are made into one. We were made into the greatest evil simply because of two things. First, it had to do with men’s greed; second, it was thanks to karma for our past mistakes.
Our parents died because of the greed of men, and we became evil due to that. However, our true evil intent came from our heart demon.
Our parents died, and I was vulnerable, so she wormed her way into my heart, latched her puppet strings onto my soul, and tried to manipulate me... the keyword is tried."
Kent nodded, knowing full well he wouldn’t be a puppet to anyone, even if it cost him his life.

"I was vulnerable, but not stupid. I realized at first that my anger was changing me and that if I didn’t pull myself together, it would eat me up. However, I also realized that anger gives me great strength, and if I want to succeed in eradicating my foes, I must harness it.

So I did, and it was the path I chose to walk. By tapping into my anger, I unleashed my heart demon, allowing her to turn me into an evil version of myself. But an evil me is a very dangerous version of myself.
I was evil to the point that my heart demon started to regret ever unleashing me. I grew my evil heart and bathed in my enemies’ blood, tempering my intent until my presence drove evil into hiding.

I became evil, and that path was what led me to the peak. But as you know, yin and yang have to balance. Being evil without a good side wasn’t balanced, so I ended up losing control and killing people I shouldn’t have.
Did I regret those actions? I don’t. But you will, because guess what: while I only have evil (yin), you have the good (yang), and since we are one and the same person, we naturally now have both.
So it is now up to you to find the balance and become the necessary evil you must become in order to succeed."
The Ruthless Bandit smirked:

"You know, I never knew we had that much evil in us until I one time looked at myself in the mirror. My reflection smiled back at me, a very proud moment if you ask me, because guess what, we accomplished all we wanted and caused even more mayhem before our time came to an end."
Kent wanted to say something, but looking at the smile on the Ruthless Bandit’s face, he stopped himself.
He felt a chill run down his spine, making him wonder if it was even worth recalling the memories of this life.
From his perspective, this kind of evil would change him. He would become something evil, something he doesn’t want around his wives.
However, he also knew that, to become a True Primordial, he must merge with all 13 pieces of his soul. This includes the Ruthless Bandit. So no matter what, he must become evil.

"Take some time to think it over. Though you must know, to cross the Star Gateway, you will need my memories. While they may not have anything to do with the Star Gateway at this point, to cross it, you will need that evil intent that would slowly awaken within you as you recall more of my life... our life."
Kent nodded but said nothing.
Ignoring a part of himself isn’t something he must do, so he had a lot of things to do. Hopefully, by the time he is ready to head over to Elina’s universe, he will have reached a decision.
"You can leave whenever you are ready. As for me, I am off. Until next time."
Kent was left alone, standing on the dune of endless heat, his expression calm, though deep within him, he felt a bit disturbed.
"At this point, I just have to conclude that when it comes to making a name for myself, first making peace with myself is paramount."
He sighed and gazed around the red environment before wishing to leave.
His gaze opened to the outside just when his scales were about to form.
"Right on time, master. Time to check your new scales." Tower formed a hand seal, and deep within him, Kent felt his body start to change.

Kent turned and wanted to ask how he knew he had plans to traverse the Star Gateway.
But then he remembered all of this was happening in his mind space, and so his memories were simple to read.
He sighed and turned to face the Ruthless Bandit, who flashed him a knowing smile.
"Good.
I suppose we can have a good conversation now."
Kent said nothing for a moment, taking a great deal of time to look at the Ruthless Bandit.
Once he had had enough of him, he proceeded to ask a very simple question: "Why am I here?"
"Very simple, really, you are here to understand why I, or I should say we, were once called the Ruthless Bandit.
Of course, I am not about to tell you what happened to me.
I will just tell you the vision and the mission, and then you can continue from there when you go back."
He cleared his throat and began:𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
"As it turns out, one doesn’t grow up to become the greatest evil; they are made into one.
We were made into the greatest evil simply because of two things.
First, it had to do with men’s greed; second, it was thanks to karma for our past mistakes.
Our parents died because of the greed of men, and we became evil due to that.
However, our true evil intent came from our heart demon.
Our parents died, and I was vulnerable, so she wormed her way into my heart, latched her puppet strings onto my soul, and tried to manipulate me... the keyword is tried."
Kent nodded, knowing full well he wouldn’t be a puppet to anyone, even if it cost him his life.
"I was vulnerable, but not stupid.
I realized at first that my anger was changing me and that if I didn’t pull myself together, it would eat me up.
However, I also realized that anger gives me great strength, and if I want to succeed in eradicating my foes, I must harness it.
So I did, and it was the path I chose to walk.
By tapping into my anger, I unleashed my heart demon, allowing her to turn me into an evil version of myself.
But an evil me is a very dangerous version of myself.
I was evil to the point that my heart demon started to regret ever unleashing me.
I grew my evil heart and bathed in my enemies’ blood, tempering my intent until my presence drove evil into hiding.
I became evil, and that path was what led me to the peak.
But as you know, yin and yang have to balance.
Being evil without a good side wasn’t balanced, so I ended up losing control and killing people I shouldn’t have.
Did I regret those actions?
I don’t.
But you will, because guess what: while I only have evil (yin), you have the good (yang), and since we are one and the same person, we naturally now have both.
So it is now up to you to find the balance and become the necessary evil you must become in order to succeed."
The Ruthless Bandit smirked:
"You know, I never knew we had that much evil in us until I one time looked at myself in the mirror.
My reflection smiled back at me, a very proud moment if you ask me, because guess what, we accomplished all we wanted and caused even more mayhem before our time came to an end."
Kent wanted to say something, but looking at the smile on the Ruthless Bandit’s face, he stopped himself.
He felt a chill run down his spine, making him wonder if it was even worth recalling the memories of this life.
From his perspective, this kind of evil would change him.
He would become something evil, something he doesn’t want around his wives.
However, he also knew that, to become a True Primordial, he must merge with all 13 pieces of his soul.
This includes the Ruthless Bandit.
So no matter what, he must become evil.
"Take some time to think it over.
Though you must know, to cross the Star Gateway, you will need my memories.
While they may not have anything to do with the Star Gateway at this point, to cross it, you will need that evil intent that would slowly awaken within you as you recall more of my life... our life."
Kent nodded but said nothing.
Ignoring a part of himself isn’t something he must do, so he had a lot of things to do.
Hopefully, by the time he is ready to head over to Elina’s universe, he will have reached a decision.
"You can leave whenever you are ready.
As for me, I am off.
Until next time."
Kent was left alone, standing on the dune of endless heat, his expression calm, though deep within him, he felt a bit disturbed.
"At this point, I just have to conclude that when it comes to making a name for myself, first making peace with myself is paramount."
He sighed and gazed around the red environment before wishing to leave.
His gaze opened to the outside just when his scales were about to form.
"Right on time, master.
Time to check your new scales." Tower formed a hand seal, and deep within him, Kent felt his body start to change.

chapters.title: Chapter 1558: Chaos Heart Formation
paragraphs: Before the scale shedding, Kent had dark-gold scales with a few red stripes. However, as the scales formed, a much richer golden-red color started to take form.
This time, the scales were clean, perfectly textured, and extremely beautiful.
If before he was a bit rough like a crocodile, then he had now become more dragon-like.
However, the beauty and color are only minor aspects of the new scales forming.
The main focus had to do with the nature of the scales. At first glance, the only thing that would come to mind is whether the scales are metallic or bone-like.

The texture itself seems bone-like; however, closer inspection reveals a metallic feel and look. Kent had always had metallic scales; however, this time, he seemed to have formed a much better version.
He had become stronger, and his scales seemed to have contributed immensely.

They look bone-like but feel metallic and, most importantly, are super durable. It took about three hours for his scales to form. When it was done, he flew into the air and moved about for a few minutes before descending. Before landing, he transformed into his humanoid form.
His wives rushed to his side, hugging him all over.
Although his appearance hadn’t changed much this time, he seemed even more handsome than before. His height rose to 6’5", just an inch, but a visible one.
Most of the changes happened internally. His strength is on another level. Even without checking the system interface, he could tell he had become much stronger, and that alone was enough.
"Thank you all for protecting me while I was out. Though I still have one last step to take, I can’t wait long enough to thank you properly,"
Vexthra, Miryssa, and Inaya blushed.
Kent turned and looked at Ainna, who seemed to have become tired after spending the past seven days using her Supreme Qi to temper Kent’s body.
He wanted to thank her; however, right when their gazes met, she scoffed and turned away.
Kent just laughed and turned back to his wives.
"I hope there were no troubles while I was out,"
The three ladies smiled. "There were a few, but we handled them. We will tell you everything when you are done."
He nodded.
If they were ordinary people, he would have worried. Being worried about three gods is just him being silly and a bit spoiled.
"Then I will get right on the next step,"
He kissed them and walked back to the cave. A lot had to be done, but for now, he knew that when the Chaos Heart was formed, he would be ready to head out to Elina’s Galaxy.
He would handle the rest as he goes.
Tower appeared beside him. "Congratulations, Master. It appears you have become much stronger than even I anticipated."
"I suppose I have you and the ladies to thank for that. However, how much stronger have I become?" he wanted to know in terms of percentages, and Tower was quick to pull up the information.
[Congratulations on shedding and forming your first Chaos Scale.]
[Your attributes have been boosted. Strength: 80,000%. Health: 40,000%. Mental: 30,000%. Soul: 20,000%]
Kent blinked a few times, then a smile formed on his face. "I guess things could have been worse,"
"I skipped some stuff for now since you really don’t need them. However, here is a recap of a few important ones." She raised one finger to count...

"First, aside from the boost in attributes, your bloodline has become much stronger. In fact, it has even become perfect. Now, aside from the two innate abilities you had unlocked, because of the boost, you are eligible for four more.

"More importantly, the [Blood Calamity Fist] and [Chaos Scale Shield] have undergone some upgrades. I wouldn’t bore you with the details, but know that the [Blood Calamity Fist] is now 20,000% more powerful. The [Chaos Scale Shield] is 40,000% stronger.
"Second, you can now harness all 250,000 blood runes you have awakened. It also means you are ready to start forming Blood Tattoos. That is the next stage of the [Bone Tempering Art] master.

"Third, and this is very important, you can now summon a unique armor called [Chaos Blood Armor]. It was awakened when you formed the scale. I don’t know how much deeper it went yet, but when wearing it, all attacks that land on you will lose 40% of their power. Aside from that, you will gain twice your strength while wearing it.
"That is 160,000% boost.
"Lastly, you have awakened two new skills. The first is [Dragon Tail Whip] and the second is [Dragon Gaze]. It seems you had inherited those from the statue."
Tower smiled and waved her hand, summoning the golden statue.
"Master, before you digest all I have just said, there is something you must first see." Tower painted at the bottom of the golden statue.
Thanks to Kent’s newly enhanced eyesight, he saw the initials at a glance. "This is...?"

"I know, right? When I first saw it, I was a bit taken aback, but then it struck me. If one wants to cheat destiny and go against the limits of the universe, who can they trust to ensure they succeed?"
"Someone with no ties to the heavenly laws..." Kent responded absentmindedly.

This made Tower smile. "A paragon indeed. When I saw your initials on the statue, the thought that came to mind was why the paragon would use your initials to mark something they had done. It didn’t make sense.

Then I stopped and thought, and that was when I saw it. This statue was your handiwork, Master. Somehow, you managed to unlock the path to becoming an Absolute, and so you manipulated events just to ensure that today, you would have it."

Kent’s hands shook for a moment, a bit taken aback by what he had just heard. However, while it sounded ridiculous, the fact that his initials now marked the golden statue told him all he needed to know.

"I was the cause of all this. I set the events in motion, making sure that in my first tribulation, I would face the Absolute Dragon and find a way to win. But why go through all this trouble just to get back something that is originally mine?"

Tower smiled. "Cause and effect, Master. What you inherited can be considered something forbidden. I am sure the paragon came to possess it because he was the only one who could hold onto it without the heavens making a fuss.

And since you can’t have it back as a gift because the heavens wouldn’t have allowed it, you designed everything with Paragon’s help so that you would have to fight for it and win it in what could be considered a fair trial.
In other words, you took advantage of the heavens to return something they forbade back to you now as an accepted treasure."
Kent’s mind expanded and contracted, trying to make sense of everything for a few seconds before he sighed and grabbed one [Chaos Heart Stone].
"All these theories are making my mind heat up. I will think about it when I am done forming the Chaos Heart."
Tower smiled and put away the statue.
"I guess the Spell of Origin did more than reincarnate people," she muttered, then snapped her fingers, summoning a formation.
"The Master should swallow the Chaos Heart Stone."
Kent nodded and tossed the stone into his mouth and swallowed it. The moment he did, his eyes turned red.
"The Master cannot sleep this time around."
Heat surged within him, his eyes becoming even redder. Inside his soul sea, the blood sea started to surge. A few seconds in, it began to boil, vapor rising into the air.
Deep under the blood sea, the Chaos Heart Stone slowly started to dissolve.
"The Master must hold on while the Chaos Heart Stone dissolves."

chapters.title: Chapter 1559: First Chaos Heart [End of Volume IX]
paragraphs: The process of dissolving the Chaos Heart Stone within his soul sea was what Kent feared. It is very painful; in fact, he would have to keep his mind focused on other things if he wanted to survive the agonizing pain.
Keeping his focus on the dissolving process will overwhelm his mind with so much pain and suffering.
Thankfully, the thought of him being responsible for the golden statue was enough to occupy his thoughts for a while.
Tower had already pointed out that, while indeed suspecting Paragon was a valid decision to make, there is the possibility that Kent chose to use him for his own good.
The Master of Purgatory had said a lot of things, but everything seemed to revolve around something bigger, something that had to do with his universe and several others out there.
He had no idea what the threat was just yet, but he knew there were going to be seven of them.
So far, he had met two of them: Paragon and the Master of Purgatory. Also, he had a hint that one of said people was the so-called second sworn brother of the Paragon.
He himself is a part of it, because why not?
So if that is the case, then perhaps there is something he is missing. Perhaps, once he recovers all of his Chaos Memories, he would be able to piece a few things together.

’At this point, saving my universe from the void beasts isn’t my only worry. I have to become strong enough to save other universes,’ he sighed. ’But first, I must get to Elina and ensure she is safe and sound.’
His thoughts wandered, and before long, three days had passed. Within those three days, the Chaos Heart Stone had dissolved considerably.
However, just as the process was about to end, Tower made a call that made Kent widen his eyes.
[It appears the master can handle more than one Chaos Heart Stone, so why don’t we add one more to ensure the Chaos Heart formed would be more robust?]
Kent blinked a few times before responding:
"Why not? If I am going to suffer, then I might as well gain something good from all the suffering."
Tower giggled and sent one more Chaos Heart Stone into Kent’s soul sea, causing the boiling sensation to intensify.
’Chaos spent less than five days forming his Chaos Heart. I wonder how long it will take me.’
Ten days later.
Kent released a powerful roar, his soul sea filled with so much chaotic energy. The two Chaos Heart Stones had been dissolved, and now, he had started the formation process.
Inside the First Blood Gate, right under the Blood Core, a purple core was slowly forming.
So far, Kent had formed two Blood Gates, and inside each, there was a Blood Core and a Flame Core. Right now, he was adding a Chaos Core (heart) into the first Blood Gate.
Once that was done, he would be able to use and absorb Chaos Energy.
It was surprisingly simple to form the core. The difficult part was the dissolving process. Once that was out of the way, the rest was as simple as forming the core by compressing everything.
In fact, because his cultivation techniques had become so automated, he wasn’t even doing anything. Tower and his body were doing all the heavy lifting.
’Chaos Energy, huh. I should be strong enough to contend even with Immortal Lords.’ Kent smiled, already looking forward to how much stronger he would become once everything was over.
It took three more days for the core formation process to be completed. However, just when that happened, a wave of powerful Chaos Energy exploded out from his body, spreading all over the planet.
Standing outside, Vexthra and her sisters raised their brows, shock appearing on their faces. They felt the pressure, and that was all they needed to know a monster had been born.

They could see that the air around the cave Kent was in had changed. It was much thicker and a bit suffocating. Even though they had no idea how much stronger he had become, they could tell from his aura that he was not the same Kent they knew.
Naturally, that was indeed true.
Kent had become a monster among monsters.
He had finally formed his Chaos Heart, and so he could finally harness the power of his bloodline much more efficiently.
His bloodline would only show its true power when he starts to use Chaos energy. Now that he had formed the chaos heart, he could use it without worry.
He now had access to Chaos Qi, Blood Qi, and Flame Qi. All these energies, if synced together, would make him a powerhouse that nobody was prepared for just yet.
Inside the cave, Kent opened the system interface and began reading some of the messages displayed there.
[You have formed your first Chaos Heart.]
[Congratulations. You have now unlocked Chaos Energy. You can absorb and harness Chaos Qi to power your attacks and spells.]
[You have awakened a unique skill called Chaos Soul.]
[Chaos Soul]
[Rank: Unique]
[Description: You can augment anything that is connected to your soul with Chaos Energy.]
Kent continued to read, most of the messages focusing on the unique skills he had awakened. Most of them were required if he wanted to use his Chaos Energy easily and without restrictions.
Of course, now that he had become an absolute existence, it was only normal for him to awaken such powerful abilities. Now, he could do more than he would have if he were still the old him.
It took some time to finish reading every last message. However, the smile on his face made it clear he was pleased with his gains.
Tower smiled beautifully, knowing that finally, her master was ready to head to the Star Gateway.
"I have already arranged everything for the master. So from here onwards, the master can easily handle the tasks ahead."
"Thank you, Tower." Kent stood up and walked out of the cave, feeling even more energized now. He had become so powerful that he couldn’t wait long enough to test his strength.
’Feels like I am me again,’ he smiled and looked at the clouds. After everything was said and done, the most logical decision he could ever make was to spend some time with his wives.
Once that was handled, he would be on his way.
So, since that logical decision was reached, he left the planet with his wives and Ainna. The next few months (outside time) would be spent in each other’s arms.

[A/N: End of Volume IX: Home Sweet Home. It has been a good ride over the past couple of Chapters. While we had some dull moments, the entire volume was very informative. We got to see another side of Kent (Spirit Painter), and even had a sneak peek into what the Ruthless Bandit had in store for him.
This is also to inform everyone that we are halfway through the novel. With that said, we still have some adventures to embark on, so we are not done just yet.
In the next volume, expect Chaos Unleashed and all hell breaking loose. The Chaos Dragon cannot ascend to the Immortal World without first causing some chaos.
By the end of Volume X, expect to see a whole new version of Kent and perhaps a sneak peek into his other lives.
On that note, let’s get the party started. I cannot wait to see the adventure Kent is about to embark on.
Volume X: Pursuit of Happiness]
