He had become so powerful that he couldn’t wait long enough to test his strength.
’Feels like I am me again,’ he smiled and looked at the clouds.
After everything was said and done, the most logical decision he could ever make was to spend some time with his wives.
Once that was handled, he would be on his way.
So, since that logical decision was reached, he left the planet with his wives and Ainna.
The next few months (outside time) would be spent in each other’s arms.
[A/N: End of Volume IX: Home Sweet Home.
It has been a good ride over the past couple of Chapters.
While we had some dull moments, the entire volume was very informative.
We got to see another side of Kent (Spirit Painter), and even had a sneak peek into what the Ruthless Bandit had in store for him.
This is also to inform everyone that we are halfway through the novel.
With that said, we still have some adventures to embark on, so we are not done just yet.
In the next volume, expect Chaos Unleashed and all hell breaking loose.
The Chaos Dragon cannot ascend to the Immortal World without first causing some chaos.
By the end of Volume X, expect to see a whole new version of Kent and perhaps a sneak peek into his other lives.
On that note, let’s get the party started.
I cannot wait to see the adventure Kent is about to embark on.
Volume X: Pursuit of Happiness]

chapters.title: Chapter 1560: Entering The Star Gateway
paragraphs: [Skull City - The Flame Temple]
Every 100 years, the natives of Skull City come to the Flame Temple to pray to the evil god and ask for his mercy and the mercy of the higher beings.
Every last being comes to the Flame Temple, even the aged and children. Even the sick are carried there to pray. This shows a clear respect and dedication to their culture and norms.
The High Priestess handles the gathering, leading the prayers since it is believed her voice is heard first by the evil god and higher beings.
Skull City can be considered a lower realm. It is among the 12 member states, comprising 12 different species of Star Beasts. For as long as they could remember, they had been living in this city.

For years, they faced many obstacles, with the most dire one being the sudden aggression of Stone City. It was said a very long time ago that, when the time comes, every being inside Skull City would have to take up arms and march into battle, for they would have no choice but to kill.

The only downside to this, however, was the fact that the natives of Skull City are pacifists. Killing is not in their nature, so they can only call on their higher beings to come to their aid in these times of great struggle.
As a lower realm, they have a few Immortal-level existences among them, with the High Priestess being the only demigod among them. She is a great healer and a wise leader.
Over the years, she had led her people in building all kinds of defensive formations to protect them. This had protected them for years until the sudden invasion of Stone City.
Now, they could only pray and hope for the best.
In the past, they had received some guidance. However, the past 20,000 years had been radio silent. Even so, they had not stopped and kept praying for the mercy of the higher beings.
A city of over 2 million beings coming together to pray surely must have an impact.
Today, as their prayer was coming to an end, a voice filled with such evil intent whispered in the High Priestess’s ear, and a look of astonishment appeared in her eyes.
It had been a very long time since she heard this voice. Today, it spoke to her again, and so she stood up and made a declaration.
"Light the Skull Bowl, a savior is coming to save us all."
Her words were received with great enthusiasm, with many singing the praises of the unknown higher beings they believed had spoken to them.
[Time Skip]
Meanwhile, three months had already passed on the outside since Kent had formed his Chaos Heart and entered the tower with his wives. Roughly six years had passed inside the tower.
Those years were spent in each other’s arms.
Kent hadn’t set foot outside the Harem Tower for the past few years. He had spent that time making love with his wives over and over again.

During that time, Lene had taken the next step with him, something that was long overdue. As for the rest, he hadn’t made any progress with them yet. However, they are not too far from joining the harem.
However, every good thing must come to an end, so after years spent making them feel loved, he had to leave for his final mission in the High World.
Gaia and her friends had already built the portal that would take him to the Star Gateway, so now that he was ready, it was only a matter of time before he left.
They freshened up and met the others inside the Legion Tower.
"Umai, great to see you once again," Kent said, looking at a silver-haired dragon lady.
She smiled and nodded at him. "Great to see you again, Lord Chaos."
While he was busy making love with his wives, Gaia took charge of the migration process, allowing Umai to relocate to the Dragon City built inside the tower.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚

There were 2,000 dragons in total under her care. Once they moved to the tower, she was briefed by Uncle Drake, making her aware that the Chaos Dragon had returned and that he owned the space she and her dragons now occupied.
She was both happy and a bit scared, considering that in the past, they had joined their master in fighting him many times. However, now that she had met him, she seemed to have relaxed a bit.
Kent nodded toward Daliah, who became pale but forced herself to nod back. This sight made him smile.

"Well, as you all know, I will be leaving for a few months, perhaps a year or two. While I’m gone, Lady Vexthra will be in charge," Kent paused when he sensed someone tug on his shirt. Looking down, his gaze met Gaia’s, who wore a pout on her face.
"Point of correction, while I am gone, Lady Vexthra and Sweet Gaia will be in charge. Listen to their instructions, and, well, if you need something, feel free to ask them.

I know some of you are eager to ascend to the Immortal World. That will happen, but before I return, be halfway done clearing the dungeon. Inasmuch as this is a free world, you must do some heavy lifting every now and then to keep your bodies active."
They nodded.

"Good. Also, it would be good if you all could form Primordial Spirits by utilizing the Primordial Chambers. Once I return, I will find a way to allow some of you to undergo Heavenly Tribulation to cleanse your bodies of impurities."
They nodded again, and Kent proceeded to leave more instructions.
Once he said all he had to say, he bade everyone goodbye and went to see Queen Eirdis and her daughter Xandira.
Since he would be gone for at least a year, by the time he returned, Xandira would be a little bigger, so he wanted to hold her for a few minutes before leaving.
As expected, for obvious reasons, Xandira was happy to see him. Her laughter filled the garden for a couple of minutes before he managed to make her sleep.
"When I return, we will play some more, little Xandy," Kent planted a kiss on her chubby cheeks and walked away. This sight made his wives smile and plan to hold another meeting when he was gone.
After he left Gaiaville, he went to meet his mom before finally heading to the portal.
"Big Brother, when coming, bring gifts," Yuna said, jumping from one stone to another. Purity and Aala kept following her around.
Kent nodded and promised all his lolis. Afterward, he kissed all his wives and then turned to Inaya.
"The seal will break in 10 days’ time. I have already instructed Baldy to protect you during your tribulation. So rest assured, with him there, you have nothing to worry about."
She nodded.
Kent nodded back and turned to Vexthra. "Take care of them while I am away. I will reward you when I return."
She smiled and nodded.
After a few minutes of kissing them again, he walked through the portal, and after two days, he emerged in front of what appeared to be the entrance to a large, dark cave.
Kent immediately knew he had to enter, so after making sure Tower and a few essentials were transferred into his Soul Universe, he moved forward and entered the cave.
His vision darkened the next second, and when he opened his eyes, he was lying inside a large forest, the sound of someone screaming jolting him to his feet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1561: Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty
paragraphs: Fifteen demi-humans with stone skin surrounded three ladies and five men, their weapons drawn, their smiles exuding evil, menacing intent.
The three ladies and five men had more human-like skin, with a bit of silver coating them.
On the ground, three men lay dead, their blood oozing out like a river.
Clearly, the eight people who had been surrounded were initially eleven. Judging by the look on their faces and the fear in their eyes, they knew all too well what awaited them.
One of the stone-skinned demi-humans grinned and said:

"It is a bit sad to think you chose to be the decoy for your princess to get away. If you had been forthcoming and allowed us to capture her, perhaps we would have ended your lives quickly and swiftly." His grin became twisted. "Now, it seems we have no choice but to make it even more painful."
He took one step forward, and the eight silver-skinned demi-humans trembled. Irrespective of their gender, they all trembled when he took that step.𝓯𝓻𝒆𝙚𝒘𝓮𝙗𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝒍.𝙘𝓸𝙢
Standing 300 meters away, Kent sighed, his expression turning a bit darker.

When he entered the Star Gateway, he expected to appear in a place where thousands of star beasts waited for him to slaughter them. He never expected to find himself in a place that seemed like a functional society.
There was bullying here, so he had no doubt that these people are sentient and part of communities. Bullying is the only thing sentient beings specialize in, regardless of their race.
The only problem here was which side to pick. He had no idea where he was or which species of star beasts these demi-humans belonged to, so picking a side would mean he must kill the other side.
The Ruthless Bandit had already told him he would need every bit of evil if he wanted to survive this journey, so he wasn’t about to be the hero and jump into saving anyone.
Thankfully, he had something that could aid him.
Vexthra managed to acquire a star compass from the Space God.
So from the moment he woke her up, Tower started syncing with it. In a few minutes, he would know which side to pick and, most importantly, he would know where to go next.

While waiting, he used the chance to pay closer attention to the fifteen demi-humans with stone skin. Ten were Root Immortals, two Spirit Immortals, and two Core Immortals. They only had one True Immortal, and he seemed to have already formed Immortal Qi.
Surprisingly, the cornered demi-humans were all Core Immortals, a much stronger team than the stone skins.
However, despite this, they seemed cornered and very afraid. This made Kent wonder just why that was. From his perspective, their lineup was strong enough to fight back and perhaps even win.
So why then were they cowering in fear?
His question was answered when Tower finally finished syncing with the Star Compass.
[It appears the master has arrived at the lowest level of the Star Realm. This place is called Green Skull Forest, one of the three forests bordering Skull City.

The silver-skinned demi-humans are known as Velkhar, and the stone-skinned demi-humans are known as Terrakhan. It also appears the Velkhar are pacifists by nature, so they cannot fight back even if they wanted to.]
"Hold on. Are you trying to tell me they would rather die than kill their attackers?"
[Yes, master. They are a race of healers, so killing is not in their nature.]
"And these are the same beasts that once terrorized our universe."

[Indeed. They are Star Beasts or, as most call them, Spatial Beasts. Just like us and other races, there are different species among them, so not all of them are violent. The Velkharians happen to be the most peaceful of them all.
However, the same cannot be said for the Terrakhan. They are a violent species that doesn’t know when to stop.]
"I see. I have no memory of when the Star Beasts invaded the universe, but I think learning that not all of them are violent, perhaps there is a future for them and us after all."
[The master is indeed correct. However, you have to make a decision first. Which of them would you save?]

"Before making a decision, I have a question. Do I know where to go if I want to cross to the next galaxy?" Since this mission was to traverse the harrowing depths of the Star Gateway to Elina’s galaxy, his objectives and actions must align with it.
[I haven’t just yet. However, I believe that once we reach a city, we can ask for some answers. Since this is their world, they would know more.]
"Then I suppose saving the Velkharians would do. They seem peaceful at least."
Tower had no objections, since she also believed that saving them would be the most logical decision.
The eight Velkharians were pushed to the corner and were on their last straw when a voice suddenly entered their ears.
"Easy there, tigers. We wouldn’t want to anger this monarch now, would we?"

The fifteen Terrakhans and eight Velkharians turned in the same direction, their gazes landing on Kent’s handsome face. He was clad in dark, cotton-like armor, styled to appear more regal yet perfect for combat.
His dragon horn was active, and his perfect purple hair, decorated with strands of red and gold, fell perfectly to the side of his face, giving him the appearance of royalty.

The only unsettling thing, however, was his eyes. They were golden, but his pupils seemed to have a reddish craziness buried within, giving him a presence that made all twenty-three of them take a few steps back.
The True Immortal among the Terrakhans pointed his sword at Kent and asked:
"Who are you, and what do you want?"
Kent smiled and answered:
"No need for the hostilities, brother. I am just a traveler passing through. If you pretend I wasn’t here, I will just walk away and pretend I saw none of whatever this is."

Maybe sarcasm wasn’t something the Star Beasts were familiar with, so the True Immortal misunderstood what Kent said. In his mind, Kent didn’t want to get into any trouble, so he pleaded to be allowed to pass.
Naturally, as beings who craved blood, they felt their blood boil at the thought of feasting on him after they were done with the eight Velkharians.
There was just something about Kent that made them unconsciously lick their lips.
"If you go down on your knees and bow to me, perhaps I will let you die first before feasting on you."
Kent laughed. "Oh my, this is a bit strange, you know."
His gaze narrowed, and he said, "I was about to say the same thing, minus the feasting part. However, since we seem to share the same ideology, then how about we each try and see who kneels first?"
Suddenly, a powerful presence filled the place, causing both the Velkharians and Terrakhans to tremble. Kent smirked, and then he pointed at the fifteen Terrakhans.
Tapping into the Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty innate ability, he commanded, "Why don’t you go down on your knees and bow to my majestic self?"
Under the stunned gaze of the eight Velkharians and the unwilling yet shocked expressions of the Terrakhans, they all went down on their knees and bowed to him—all fifteen of them.
"Better..."
Kent laughed and turned to the eight Velkharians.

chapters.title: Chapter 1562: Skull City
paragraphs: Kent had already been itching during the years he spent with his wives inside the harem tower to try out some of the skills he had awakened during his seclusion on Planet Rainy, but he never had the chance.
So when the opportunity finally presented itself, he didn’t hesitate.
What he never expected, however, was how potent the ability was.
He had only wanted to test it on them to see if there would be any effect. However, the effect was much more than he had anticipated.
Sometimes, the descriptions of skills don’t do them justice.
In the case of the Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty, it did a terrible job.
[Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty]
[Rank: Innate+]

[Description: You are the Chaos Monarch. Your authority is absolute. Even among the ranks of other monarchs, your Chaos will transcend all. In times of chaos, your authority has no bounds, allowing you to embody the essence of Chaos.]

The description portrayed the skill as something that could not be disobeyed. In this instance, the skill seemed to imply that even against a Celestial stage cultivator who was not a monarch, Kent can command them.
However, that was far from the truth.
In fact, the skill requires three factors to operate.

The first is his mind. Kent is expected to possess superior mental strength if he wants to be able to hold influence over those he intends to command. If he has less mental strength, then commanding the person would have little to no hold on them.
The second is his soul strength. His soul also had to be stronger, or at least be on the same level as the person, before the Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty could work.
The last, of course, was bloodline. Naturally, it could be said that Kent possessed a rather robust bloodline. His Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline was at the peak of the Celestial stage.

It was thanks to his bloodline that all those powerhouses felt his awakening when his blood reached the monarch grade. So it could be said that while his soul and mind were much weaker, even against a god, they would feel his monarch’s presence if he wanted them to.
Commanding them to do his bidding, however, is impossible at his current level. His soul and mind aren’t at the level to do something like that just yet.
However, it appeared these immortal-level Star Beasts were much weaker than he had expected. Now, they were all on their knees, the look of shock painted across their faces.

Clearly, they couldn’t believe their eyes. Upon all their arrogance and power, here they are, on their knees. Even willing themselves to stand up was proving to be impossible, and so they could only stare at Kent in horror.
"Ah, looks like this place would indeed bring out the evil in me," he grinned and activated the [Dragon Gaze].
Since he had picked a side, testing his second ability is only right.
Once the [Dragon Gaze] is active, he aimed it at the fifteen Terrakhans.

When they looked into his eyes, their expressions paled, and then, under the horrified gaze of the eight Velkharians, all fifteen of them plunged their weapons into their hearts, ending their own lives.
"Quite unfortunate, I suppose." Kent smiled and turned to the eight Velkharians.
"Hi, my name is Kent Madson. I don’t suppose this place is Skull City?"
For a moment, the eight Velkharians trembled, some losing their balance. As beings who hated killing, watching the gruesome way the fifteen Terrakhans died terrified them.
On top of that, while some of them felt the urge to vomit, looking at Kent smile after committing such a massacre made them even more afraid of him.
It took them five minutes before one of them found the confidence to speak.
"Hi, my name is Ketta. Please don’t kill us."
Kent raised his brow, a bit taken aback by her request. "Oh, why would I want to kill you?"
At his question, Ketta turned and looked at the dead bodies on the ground. Seeing this, Kent smiled weakly, a guilty expression appearing on his face.
He snapped his fingers, and the fifteen bodies on the ground were ignited in flames. It took less than a minute for them all to turn to ash.
"There you go. Now, the bad guys are dead, so you can relax and answer some of my questions. Also, do not worry, I will not kill you. I have no reason to kill you, not when I need your help."
His words seemed to have calmed them down a bit.

After a few moments, Ketta took a deep breath and looked at Kent. "Once again, my name is Ketta. I am the leader of this group. Together, we are the special escorts of the Skull Princess. And yes, this place is part of Skull City; however, the city itself is several thousand miles from here."
She gave Kent a curious look before asking:

"What business do you have here, and why did you kill them? While they would have killed us, those fifteen are from Stone City and were under the direct orders of one of the Stone Generals. If they don’t return in a few days’ time, they will notice their absence, and that would trigger a retaliation from them against us."
"Ah, so that was why you were afraid. You fear their retaliation against your kind, huh?"
Ketta nodded.
"All the more reason why you should take me to Skull City. You see, I am looking for something very important, and I believe your leaders can help me.

Of course, based on the help they can provide, I may decide whether to help you with your Stone people problem. So instead of standing here debating why I shouldn’t have killed the people who killed three of your people, we should rather be on our way."
Ketta wanted to protest, but one of her teammates interrupted her.
"Big sister Ketta, maybe we should take him to the High Priestess. Maybe he is the—"
"That is enough, Tui."
Ketta cut him off, but Kent was able to pick up on something that he could use to his advantage. ’It seems they are expecting someone important. If I play my cards right, I can be that person.’

[The master is indeed on to something. However, are you sure faking it is the way? From what I have read in all those summoning books, whenever a race of pacifists or those at risk of extinction performs a summoning ritual, the hero they summon is mostly someone with great power.
I hate to say this, but the master isn’t that hero, especially since the master has yet to even become an Immortal.]
’Have some faith in me, Tower. Just look at me, I check all the boxes.’
[And what are those boxes?]
’You know, good looks, strength, charm, hero presence, and any other boxes there are. Of course, even if I don’t check all the boxes, there are always the classic words... fake it till you make it.’
[I have a bad feeling about this. However, I suppose we will find out soon enough.]
It took Ketta a few minutes to come to a decision. They left the forest, and after four hours of travel, they arrived at the gate of a large city made entirely from the skull of a very large beast.
The skull was so large, in fact, that Kent wondered just what kind of monster it came from. He activated his Heavenly Jade Eyes, allowing him to see more than just its outer appearance.
Surrounding the city was a very powerful formation, the kind that even a god would become helpless against.
Standing at the entrance of the city were five Immortal Lords and a Demigod.

chapters.title: Chapter 1563: The Hero
paragraphs: Kent expected this welcome, since, when they were 2,000 miles from the city, he sensed someone scanning him thoroughly. He noticed this because his Soul Map was open at the time.
However, being welcomed by the leaders of Skull City was the least he expected.
He was not a genie, but he could tell the Demigod was the authority in this city, so seeing her at the entrance meant only one thing...
’They knew I would be coming.’
He said inwardly, feeling like faking his hero status wouldn’t be too hard after all.
It took just a few minutes, but soon they were only 10 meters from the six people. When they stopped, Ketta and her teammates bowed.
"We greet the High Priestess."

Kent stood like a metal beam, his gaze fixed as he scanned the six people in front of him. The High Priestess had silver hair with black strands. Her oval face, coupled with her blue eyes, made her a beauty to behold.
Looking around, he could tell silver hair was kind of their thing, since the others standing beside her all had it.
However, he also noticed something peculiar: all five Immortal Lords were women. This discovery made him raise an eyebrow.
This also means there is something afoot.
He opened the Soul Map and performed a quick scan. Now that he had formed his Chaos Heart and both his mind and soul had become much stronger, he could use the Soul Map more effectively.
Within a 30,000 km radius, he spotted over 3,000 hidden figures, each an Immortal Lord. From the look in their eyes, he could tell that should he make a slight mistake, they would attack him.
Seeing this, he was a bit puzzled.
’Tower, didn’t you say these people are pacifists?’
[I did say that.]
’Then why are there 3,500 of them hidden and ready to kill?’
[That is because they are mutants, and from the look of things, they are very dangerous mutants. I would be careful around them.]
’What the hell.’
While Kent was cursing his luck, the High Priestess told Ketta and her team to lift their heads. Once they did, her entire attention locked onto Kent.
Sensing her gaze, Kent’s chaos-filled blood surged, all forms of apprehension wiped from his mind and body, and a smile appeared on his lips.
"Forgive me, High Priestess, but aren’t you supposed to be a race of pacifists?"
She nodded but said nothing.
Seeing this, Kent grinned and pointed to his left. "Then why are there over 3,000 of your kind ready to kill me? Did I perhaps do something wrong?"

Hearing his words, the High Priestess frowned. The five Immortal Lords standing behind her also frowned. Clearly, they did not expect Kent to uncover their secret so easily. Not even Ketta and her friends knew of this lineup.
Kent saw he had made a blunder, so he smiled and introduced himself...

"Hi, my name is Kent Madson. I am a dragon and a being from outside this realm. I came here not by accident but on a journey to the galaxy that lies just beyond this realm. Is there any chance you can help me? I am willing to pay for your help."
The High Priestess’s unblinking gaze remained locked on Kent.
Kent said nothing else and remained standing there for five minutes before she spoke.
"You said you are from the world outside this place."
"Indeed."
"What era are we currently in?" she asked again...
"The Infinity Era."
"I see." She thought for a moment and then sighed...
She looked intently at Kent and then asked again, "Do you know the era the one named the King of Evil lived in?"
Kent furrowed his brow, a face appearing in his mind. ’It is him, the Ruthless Bandit. Though why did she refer to him as the King of Evil...’
His thoughts wandered for a moment before he nodded. "I believe he lived during the Dark Era."
"So he is dead?" she asked, to which Kent shook his head.
"Unknown. His death was never recorded, so nobody can tell with absolute certainty whether he is dead or alive."
"Legends have it that the King of Evil goes by another title. You wouldn’t happen to know that title, would you?" At her question, everyone’s eyes turned toward him.

Kent felt like his answer this time would determine his fate. Of course, he had already prepared an escape long before he arrived at this place. However, it would be a rough struggle if they attacked him.
That said, the answer was obvious.
"He was called the Ruthless Bandit."
Kent could see a relieved expression appear on everyone’s face. Even Ketta and her team seemed to have calmed down considerably.
The next second, however, his eyes widened.
The High Priestess, the five Immortal Lords, Ketta and her team, the guards on the bone walls, and every last Velkharian went down on their knees and spoke the words they never expected to hear.
"All hail the Hero of the Evil King."
"All hail the Hero of the Evil King."

Kent stood there in shock, his expression displaying how lost he was. He never expected to be hailed a hero when he hadn’t even made his move yet. In his mind, they merely wanted to confirm if he was indeed from the world outside the Star Realm.
Now, the hero he was planning to fake had been bestowed on him, and from the look of things, they had been expecting him.
While he was in shock, 3,500 warriors emerged from the ground and bowed, their fists pressed to their chests.
’I expected many surprises, but this was the most unexpected of them all.’ He was in shock, but he managed to remain calm.
[I believe they won’t stand unless the master tells them to.]
Kent was snapped back to his senses by Tower.
"Please stand."
The High Priestess and her people stood up, their expressions filled with happiness. They prayed for a savior, and he was now here, so of course, they were happy.
The only one in shock was Kent himself.
"Uhm, I believe we have a very extensive discussion to have, don’t you think?" Kent said, and to his amazement, the High Priestess nodded.
"We will answer all the questions you have, Lord Evil."
"Errrh." Kent smiled weakly, hearing how he was being referred to. "You can just call me Kent."
"Alright, Lord Kent."
"Just Kent is fine."
"I wouldn’t dare. As the Hero sent by the Evil King, referring to you by just your name is a grave sin."

Kent stared at her with a stunned expression. He knew all too well that all of this was his doing; however, he couldn’t tell them he was already dead and had reincarnated a few times already. They still believed in him, and from the look of things, he still answered their prayers, so he would play along.
"Lord Kent is fine." He had to accept their kind gesture.
"I suppose we should get going now."
A crowd had started to gather at the entrance, so he knew they had to leave before he was forced to wave and smile at them.
He wanted to first know where Lex Morvane (Ruthless Bandit) fit into all of this.
Understanding his intention, the High Priestess created a portal that took them directly to the Skull Temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 1564: Tale of the Evil King (The Saviour)
paragraphs: There is a lot Kent wants to know. But first, he wants to know more about the Evil King/Evil God, or whatever name they call him aside from the Ruthless Bandit.

He had no idea how all of this fit together, but he learned from Vexthra that the Ruthless Bandit had come to this place before. She even said that after he returned from this place, he became a much more evil person than he was before.
Naturally, that explains why these people know him.
What he wanted to know, however, was what he did when he was here.
"We can start by you telling me how you all came to know about the Evil King."
The high priestess was more than happy to answer everything.
"Before I start anything, you should know that, to us Star Beasts, the most important person is the Evil King. He saved us, and thanks to him, we are who we are now."
She let a beautiful smile appear on her face...

"The narrative began several billion years ago when we failed to conquer the Infinity Universe—your universe. Back then, we sustained so many losses, and we were banished to this place and sealed away to rot.

Because of our loss, most of our leaders perished, making it a race with no rulers and, most importantly, no law. Anyone could stand and say they were king, and nobody would dare to oppose them, or else they risk death.
It was the worst moment in our history, and for a while, we suffered.
However, that changed when he arrived—our saviour.
When he arrived here, we were at the breaking point. Some powerhouses among us chose to take control over the entire Star Beast race, and so we were at war. His presence changed that.
He asked nobody for permission.

When he arrived, he began taking whatever he wanted, and all who opposed him were cut down. Those who tried to use their superiority to suppress him were cut down, and even those who looked at him funny were cut down.
It took just a couple of months for everyone to recognise his power, and so the wise ones rallied behind him, making him their unintentional leader.

Soon, his name started to spread, and before long, every last Star Beast from all Seven Passages had heard his name. His presence spread like a plague, and by the time those who sought power from our suffering learned of his power and growing threat, it was already too late.
He had gained the power of faith, and so he ascended to godhood, becoming a god over all of us.
Bear in mind, we already had gods, some Supremes, and a few Celestials. However, his ascension overshadowed them all, making him someone they all had to bow to.

Once that happened, he was forced to become a god to us, and so he began. He killed more people, all who opposed his rule, and after a few thousand years, 80% of the Star Beast race came under his control.
At that point, the 20% who opposed his rule went to war against him, and for 20 years, a great battle raged. In the end, they lost, and so every last one of them was absorbed into his domain.
The day that happened, something impressive occurred here.
You see, when we were banished, this place was merely a prison we were sent to. We could not escape, and most importantly, we could not return to the Star Realm.
However, when the Evil King attained Supremacy by becoming the first existence to bring all Star Beasts under his rule, the long-forgotten Star Realm found us here.
This prison turned into our home.
The Low, High, and Divine Realms were established, and for years, the peace we once had returned to us," she sighed and looked at the glass ceiling...
"Safe to say that peace is now hanging on by a thread."
Kent wanted to know why that was. However, he paused and asked something else.
"You said the Star Realm found you. Care to explain how that happened?"
She nodded.

"The Star Realm is not a place you can go to. From what I know, the Star Realm is a presence, a domain that is established when Star Beasts find the peace they deserve. Before we attacked the Infinity Universe, the Star Realm was under the authority of the Star Celestial King.
However, after he died and we grew fractured, that authority left us, and we became just another realm without rules or laws.
That was the case until the Evil King appeared. Once the Star Realm was reestablished, we became Star Beasts again, and that has been the case for as long as any of us can remember."
"But that authority is breaking, huh?"
She nodded.
Kent asked, "How so?"
"You said you are going to a galaxy just beyond this realm, right?"
Kent nodded. He was indeed traversing the Star Gateway to reach Elina’s galaxy.
"Well, I know of that, and the answer is simple: the gateway you are in currently indeed leads there. In fact, this gateway has three passages to where you want to go.

The first one is at the Tormented Chaos Abyss, a place nobody, not even a god, would dare to go. The second is at the Upside-Down Cliff. I wouldn’t recommend it, not unless you have the means to kill a mutated, corrupted god.
The third is at Stone City, guarded by the Lava King. I have never met him before, but I learned he is the strongest demigod in this gateway.

The reason why I started with this is that inside this gateway, there are 12 kingdoms. All these kingdoms together form one gateway. There are seven gateways, meaning there are 84 cities total found in this lower realm.
You travelled here from one of the seven, and right now you are in Skull City.

Many years ago, the Evil King also arrived here. It was here his journey began, and so before he left, he built a formation to protect us. Safe to say his protection had been strong until recently, when the Stone King and his generals started attacking us.
We are a race of pacifists, and so we can only hide in here. However, that changed when other cities began sending them aid.
We don’t know why they are attacking now; however, I have a guess, and it has to do with something the Evil King left behind."
"What is it?"
"I don’t know."
Kent raised his brow, a bit taken aback by her answer. If she didn’t know, then how could she speculate that the attacks were aimed at that thing?
Seeing Kent’s expression, she smiled. "I don’t know because none of us can get close to it. However, hidden deep underground lies an object that not even I can perceive clearly."
Kent nodded, but then he smirked. "Aren’t you oversharing? I am a guest here, so why reveal such a secret to me?"
In response, the high priestess and her five elders smiled. "It was because you are the hero chosen by the Evil God."
"Oh? And why do you believe that? For all we know, I may just be an ordinary person who happens to know the answers to a few questions."
"No, you are not. If you were just anyone, you wouldn’t have been able to mention the forbidden name."
Kent furrowed his brow. "You mean the Ruthless Bandit?"
"Indeed. If I were to say it right now, I would be struck by the evil punishment and forever perish. The only reason you aren’t affected is that you were chosen by the Evil King."

"We can start by you telling me how you all came to know about the Evil King."
The high priestess was more than happy to answer everything.
"Before I start anything, you should know that, to us Star Beasts, the most important person is the Evil King.

She let a beautiful smile appear on her face...
"The narrative began several billion years ago when we failed to conquer the Infinity Universe—your universe.
Back then, we sustained so many losses, and we were banished to this place and sealed away to rot.
Because of our loss, most of our leaders perished, making it a race with no rulers and, most importantly, no law.
Anyone could stand and say they were king, and nobody would dare to oppose them, or else they risk death.
It was the worst moment in our history, and for a while, we suffered.

When he arrived here, we were at the breaking point.
Some powerhouses among us chose to take control over the entire Star Beast race, and so we were at war.
His presence changed that.
He asked nobody for permission.
When he arrived, he began taking whatever he wanted, and all who opposed him were cut down.

It took just a couple of months for everyone to recognise his power, and so the wise ones rallied behind him, making him their unintentional leader.
Soon, his name started to spread, and before long, every last Star Beast from all Seven Passages had heard his name.
His presence spread like a plague, and by the time those who sought power from our suffering learned of his power and growing threat, it was already too late.
He had gained the power of faith, and so he ascended to godhood, becoming a god over all of us.
Bear in mind, we already had gods, some Supremes, and a few Celestials.
However, his ascension overshadowed them all, making him someone they all had to bow to.
Once that happened, he was forced to become a god to us, and so he began.
He killed more people, all who opposed his rule, and after a few thousand years, 80% of the Star Beast race came under his control.
At that point, the 20% who opposed his rule went to war against him, and for 20 years, a great battle raged.
In the end, they lost, and so every last one of them was absorbed into his domain.

This prison turned into our home.

Kent wanted to know why that was.

However, after he died and we grew fractured, that authority left us, and we became just another realm without rules or laws.
That was the case until the Evil King appeared.
Once the Star Realm was reestablished, we became Star Beasts again, and that has been the case for as long as any of us can remember."

She nodded.

"You said you are going to a galaxy just beyond this realm, right?"
Kent nodded.
He was indeed traversing the Star Gateway to reach Elina’s galaxy.

The first one is at the Tormented Chaos Abyss, a place nobody, not even a god, would dare to go.
The second is at the Upside-Down Cliff.
I wouldn’t recommend it, not unless you have the means to kill a mutated, corrupted god.

I have never met him before, but I learned he is the strongest demigod in this gateway.

chapters.title: Chapter 1565: The Dreadful Mission
paragraphs: Chosen by the Evil King?
That is just some bullshit. Kent knew he wasn’t really going to take what she said seriously because, at the end of the day, he is the Evil God.

The only thing he never expected, however, was the fact that the Ruthless Bandit managed to bring together an entire race of beasts and even made them become one under his divinity, thereby invoking the Star Realm once again.
That came as a shock to him.
He had yet to know much of the Ruthless Bandit’s life, but he learned from Uncle Drew and the other Night Riders that he was the kind of person whose existence was plagued by evil.
Wherever he went, evil followed.
Such a person wasn’t one he expected to be the reason the Infinity Universe and the Star Beast could one day reach an agreement and form an alliance against a common enemy.
’Strange, very strange.’ He doesn’t hate himself, but deep down, he feels like he isn’t worthy to hold the divinity of these people.
Deep down, he knew he was right to feel that way.
This, of course, caused him to wonder if the divinity was what the Ruthless Bandit was after, or if there was something else.
If he wanted to become stronger, then why didn’t he comprehend the intent of evil and develop the Dao of Evil, just like how Vexthra has the Dao of Hatred and Resentment?
So what was he after, and, most importantly, why did he come to this place and even leave part of his will behind to ensure that, today, he would return here and meet these people?
’Suddenly, I feel like this journey wouldn’t be as simple as I expected.’
Yes, he had become a monster now. But from how things were progressing, he would have to be even more prepared if he wanted to make it out of this place alive.
He turned to the High Priestess:
"Let’s drop the issue of the Evil King for now and focus on what I must do to enter that portal you said is in Stone City. I suppose asking them to allow me entry is out of the picture."
"Indeed."
The High Priestess sighed and said:
"The eight people you came with were members of the Princess’s team. They were separated from her so they could serve as a decoy for the Princess to escape the Terrakhans.

She was on her way from Wind City after a meeting with the leaders there. Apparently, the Lightning and Flame City had formed an alliance with Stone City. They really intend to get their hands on the item left behind by the Evil King.
This then means, aside from the two demigods of Stone City, since they are now in an alliance, they would have four demigods and thousands of Immortal Lords.

Aside from that, all three cities are beings that have no fear of blood. Unlike us, they would kill to get what they want. The only upside, however, is that we have a powerful formation surrounding this city, so as long as we remain inside, we will be safe, at least for another two years.

I have already discovered that the power source powering this formation is running low, and if they were to start launching attacks at us, it would only be a matter of time before we run out completely.

We also cannot form alliances with any of the cities, simply because of our nature. No city will willingly join us knowing we cannot kill. If anything, they would prefer to stand on the sidelines and watch."
Kent nodded.
"So what you are saying here is, the Evil King brought me here hoping I can save you from four demigods and thousands of immortals."
He smiled in the end, a bit amused.
However, the expression on the High Priestess’s face told him that was indeed her thought. "Wait, you really believe I have what it takes to kill four demigods?"
"The Evil King wouldn’t have picked you if you don’t have the means."
’Well, that is just some next-level fanaticism.’
Kent smiled, his amused expression faltering a bit.

’Four demigods, really? Even if I can take on one demigod, what makes them think I can handle three more? I will be wrecked after taking on just one of them; three more would be me telling common sense I don’t believe in it anymore.’
The smile on his face brightened, making the High Priestess and the five elders turn and look at each other, wondering if he was alright in the head.

’I am a Sword Emperor and a Shadow Emperor. Aside from that, I have 250,000 Blood Runes, 350,000 Flame Runes, one Chaos Heart, two Flame Cores, and two Blood Cores.’ Kent paused, his eyes narrowing a bit.
’Wait a minute, I have a Chaos Heart... I have a Chaos Heart.’ Kent paused and let his breath slow down a bit.

’I have a Chaos Heart that is only filled with 10% Chaos energy. That is more than enough to give me an edge over a demigod. However, if I were to have slightly more, who is to say I won’t have the means to kill all four of them?’ He smiled, possibilities appearing in his mind.

’I have four more innate abilities to unlock, and aside from that, I am perfectly ready to attempt learning the Claw Art. Aside from that, I have the means to paint some things that can give me an edge over them.
In fact, with enough time and planning, I can actually pull off this dreadful mission and get to Elina much faster.’

He beamed with joy once more, his mind spinning, looking for a way out. After a few more seconds, he sighed. ’Too bad I have only 10% Chaos Qi. If only there were a way to get more...’ Kent paused and turned toward the High Priestess.
A realisation finally dawned on him.
"You said something about the Tormented Chaos Abyss. Is there a chance the beings that live there are Chaos Beasts?"
The High Priestess’ expression turned dark, a sense of fear enveloping her. For a moment, she and her five elders trembled.
"I did say that, but I would advise you shouldn’t think about going there."
Kent laughed. "And why is that?"

"Because while in there, the moment you run out of Essence, there is no way to replenish it. The Chaos Essese there is harmfil to non chaose beings. Aside from that, the beings there are mutated Chaos beings, terrifying to even imagine. It would be a suicide mission."
"Oh, so there are indeed Chaos Beasts living there," Kent asked again, and the High Priestess nodded.
"And you said this formation can hold for two more years, right?"
She nodded again.
"Great. I have more time then."
"What do you mean?"

Kent smiled. "Well, while you may not have the means to enter the Tormented Chaos Abyss, I do. In fact, I am a Chaos Beast." Kent released some of his Chaos Essence, causing the six people inside the hall to tremble in their seats.
"If I can kill just a few hundred Chaos Beasts, then there is a chance I will have the means to save this city and make sure no other city will dare mess around with your people ever again."
"But you would have to go to the Tormented Chaos Abyss, where there are even Chaotic God Beasts."
"I have no problem with that."

chapters.title: Chapter 1566: Princess Pandora
paragraphs: Kent isn’t someone who does this for no reason.

He saw the task ahead of him and knew there was just no way he could handle it. In fact, he saw that, to be able to face them, he must cheat, and that cheating may come from three things: the Ruthless Bandit’s memories, Spirit Painting, and Chaos Qi.
He needs Lex’s memories to be able to think of all the dubious ways to kill. He is going against demigods, so aside from his strength, he needs every evil idea he can come up with.

Thanks to Kevin Sage, his thinking abilities are on another level. However, that doesn’t mean he is evil mentally. That mentality would come from the Ruthless Bandit. So he would have to read the memory diary and know what happens next.

Then there is the Spirit Painting. He knew that to win, he needed help far beyond what he could provide right now. Inasmuch as he is now an absolute being, he alone cannot win, not even with the 3,500 Immortal Lords he knew would be his to command.

So he needs external help, and as it happens, he had witnessed more than enough to paint some powerful things. However, to be able to paint that, he needs both the mind, soul, body, and Chaos Qi. In fact, he needs Chaos Qi more if he wants to succeed in painting something out of this world.𝕗𝚛𝚎𝚎𝐰𝗲𝗯𝗻𝚘𝚟𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝕞
So he needs to replenish his Chaos Essence, and so he must go to the Tormented Chaos Abyss.
If he manages to absorb some Chaos Essence, then perhaps he would be able to handle them easily and challenge the guardian at the portal that would be taking him to Elina’s galaxy.
"So you really think you can make it there and back alive?" one of the elders asked, all of them feeling worried.
Kent, however, smiled and nodded. "I am a Chaos Beast, Senior. The fact that I am here now and even learning of this place is destiny, I suppose."
In a way, he seems to make some sense. Chaos Energy is highly harmful, so he cannot absorb it from the air like Spiritual Qi.
While he can convert Spiritual Qi or even Blood Qi into Chaos Qi, the conversion rate is very high, so he knew he can’t do that just yet.

This also means he must find a way to absorb real Chaos Qi. The Tormented Chaos Abyss would, without a doubt, have Chaos Essence in the air, and so he can easily absorb that and even kill and absorb from the Chaos Beasts.
As it happens, after his seclusion, his two Blood Cores had grown larger again, so he needed to replenish those, too. It would be like killing two birds with one stone.

"If that is what you think you must do to be able to help us, then we won’t stop you," the High Priestess said. She is a firm believer that the Evil King had sent Kent to them, and so there is no way she would go against him simply because she is afraid.
"However, there is someone you should meet first. She has gathered all kinds of maps of the Tormented Chaos Abyss, and so she might be able to tell you more about that place."
Kent nodded.
Learning more about that dreadful place sure would come in handy.
The High Priestess left the hall with Kent shortly, making their way toward a building about 600 meters away. Along the way, all those they met bowed, happiness appearing on their faces.

It was as if they had already come to the conclusion that, with him here, they were saved. If only it were that simple; however, Kent just smiled and waved at a few, making sure they didn’t panic and cower in fear.

If that happened, their belief in the Evil God would wane, and inasmuch as Kent would love not to be worshipped, he had no idea why his past self had come to this place and established himself as a god.
Until he understood why that was, he would do everything in his power to keep their belief in him intact. So smiling and waving seemed logically sane enough.
A few minutes later, they arrived at the small house where, in a garden, a redhead sat reading some manuals.
Kent furrowed his brow when he saw a different hair color. So far, all of the Velkharians he had seen had silver hair or black with shades of silver.
This is the first redhead he had seen.

She is the only daughter of the High Priestess, Princess Pandora. Just like the others, she is also a pacifist. However, instead of taking the healing path, she became a scholar who specialized in gathering knowledge of their people and, most importantly, the Evil King.
She is also good at solving puzzles, and thanks to her unique negotiation skills, they have managed to form trade alliances with other cities.
She can be said to be the economic backbone of their people. Without her, now that Stone City and its allies have started attacking them, they would have been pushed into a corner.
So her importance is paramount to the Velkharians.

When they entered the garden, she turned and looked at them, a surprised look appearing in her eyes. She dropped the scroll she was reading and stood up. Then, to Kent’s amazement, she bowed down. "I greet the hero of the Evil King."
Kent shook his head and smirked. "Please stand up, and you can just call me Kent."
"Okay, Lord Kent."
There is nothing he can do about that, so he just sighed and turned to the High Priestess. Since she had already come to terms with what he wanted to do, she wasted no time.
"Pandora, I want you to tell Lord Kent everything you know about the Tormented Chaos Abyss."
This time, it was Princess Pandora who furrowed her brow. However, seeing Kent smile made her sigh.
"I will do my best, Mother."
The High Priestess nodded.
"I will leave you in her care, Lord Kent. After you are done here, come to the temple. I have some things to show you first before you leave for the Tormented Chaos Abyss."
Kent nodded, and soon the High Priestess was gone, leaving only Kent and Princess Pandora in the garden.
"Please follow me."

She led Kent into the house and into an office. Following behind her, Kent couldn’t help but admire her hourglass shape. She is the type who has a thin waist and broad hips. This shape allowed her ass to show perfectly in the tight gown she was clad in.
One thing Kent noticed was that almost all the people he saw were clad in white gowns. Aside from that, there seemed to be more women than men.

While he hadn’t seen the entire city yet, his scan showed that 95% of the people were women. While that is irrelevant, he did notice that 90% of the warriors he saw outside the city were men, so perhaps he would find out more about why that is soon enough.
Once they entered the room, Princess Pandora walked to a cabinet, retrieved some scrolls, and laid them on the table.
She arranged them in order before she began to speak.
Her first question, however, caused Kent to widen his eyes.
"When did you reincarnate, my Evil King?"

As it happens, after his seclusion, his two Blood Cores had grown larger again, so he needed to replenish those, too.
It would be like killing two birds with one stone.
"If that is what you think you must do to be able to help us, then we won’t stop you," the High Priestess said.
She is a firm believer that the Evil King had sent Kent to them, and so there is no way she would go against him simply because she is afraid.
"However, there is someone you should meet first.
She has gathered all kinds of maps of the Tormented Chaos Abyss, and so she might be able to tell you more about that place."
Kent nodded.
Learning more about that dreadful place sure would come in handy.
The High Priestess left the hall with Kent shortly, making their way toward a building about 600 meters away.
Along the way, all those they met bowed, happiness appearing on their faces.
It was as if they had already come to the conclusion that, with him here, they were saved.
If only it were that simple; however, Kent just smiled and waved at a few, making sure they didn’t panic and cower in fear.

If that happened, their belief in the Evil God would wane, and inasmuch as Kent would love not to be worshipped, he had no idea why his past self had come to this place and established himself as a god.
Until he understood why that was, he would do everything in his power to keep their belief in him intact.
So smiling and waving seemed logically sane enough.
A few minutes later, they arrived at the small house where, in a garden, a redhead sat reading some manuals.
Kent furrowed his brow when he saw a different hair color.
So far, all of the Velkharians he had seen had silver hair or black with shades of silver.
This is the first redhead he had seen.
She is the only daughter of the High Priestess, Princess Pandora.
Just like the others, she is also a pacifist.
However, instead of taking the healing path, she became a scholar who specialized in gathering knowledge of their people and, most importantly, the Evil King.
She is also good at solving puzzles, and thanks to her unique negotiation skills, they have managed to form trade alliances with other cities.
She can be said to be the economic backbone of their people.
Without her, now that Stone City and its allies have started attacking them, they would have been pushed into a corner.
So her importance is paramount to the Velkharians.
When they entered the garden, she turned and looked at them, a surprised look appearing in her eyes.
She dropped the scroll she was reading and stood up.
Then, to Kent’s amazement, she bowed down.
"I greet the hero of the Evil King."
Kent shook his head and smirked.
"Please stand up, and you can just call me Kent."
"Okay, Lord Kent."
There is nothing he can do about that, so he just sighed and turned to the High Priestess.
Since she had already come to terms with what he wanted to do, she wasted no time.
"Pandora, I want you to tell Lord Kent everything you know about the Tormented Chaos Abyss."
This time, it was Princess Pandora who furrowed her brow.
However, seeing Kent smile made her sigh.
"I will do my best, Mother."
The High Priestess nodded.
"I will leave you in her care, Lord Kent.
After you are done here, come to the temple.
I have some things to show you first before you leave for the Tormented Chaos Abyss."
Kent nodded, and soon the High Priestess was gone, leaving only Kent and Princess Pandora in the garden.
"Please follow me."
She led Kent into the house and into an office.
Following behind her, Kent couldn’t help but admire her hourglass shape.
She is the type who has a thin waist and broad hips.
This shape allowed her ass to show perfectly in the tight gown she was clad in.
One thing Kent noticed was that almost all the people he saw were clad in white gowns.
Aside from that, there seemed to be more women than men.
While he hadn’t seen the entire city yet, his scan showed that 95% of the people were women.
While that is irrelevant, he did notice that 90% of the warriors he saw outside the city were men, so perhaps he would find out more about why that is soon enough.
Once they entered the room, Princess Pandora walked to a cabinet, retrieved some scrolls, and laid them on the table.
She arranged them in order before she began to speak.
Her first question, however, caused Kent to widen his eyes.
"When did you reincarnate, my Evil King?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1567: The Evil Queen
paragraphs: When Kent first laid eyes on Princess Pandora, he sensed something unusual about her. It was the kind of feeling one gets when standing before someone in disguise.
He said nothing at first because that would just be rude. Now, however, he can tell his feelings are being validated.
In fact, her hair colour was the main sign that should have told him she was different.
He, however, didn’t expect her first words after they settled down to regard his past self as the Ruthless Bandit. In fact, he didn’t even expect her to ask something like that.
From what he had observed so far, he could tell the Velkharians truly believed in the Evil King, and as such, they wouldn’t joke about things like this.
They wouldn’t casually mess around knowing that would be the worst kind of offence.
As Kent looked at the smile on Princess Pandora’s face, he could tell she wasn’t joking.
"Your Evil King," Kent muttered, his expression turning a bit lost. "You make it sound like you and I are close. Sorry to say, but I don’t know you, Princess."

Her expression didn’t falter. Rather, she stood up and walked toward Kent. When she was right in front of him, she climbed onto his lap and placed her hands on his shoulders, bringing her bountiful chest to his face.
Kent had to lift his head just to look at her.
"Isn’t it a bit inappropriate to do this to the hero chosen by the Evil King?" Kent tried to pull away, but he found himself unable to move.
"Rude, Lex." Princess Pandora pouted. "Just because you don’t have your memories doesn’t mean you should deny my existence. I am a bit hurt."
Kent had already come to the conclusion that he was bound to meet people who would recognise his past selves without him having the faintest idea of who they were.
So Princess Pandora didn’t come as a surprise to him.
What puzzled him, however, was the fact that someone like the Ruthless Bandit had a beloved.
’It is impossible. I may not have his memories, but I know it is impossible for that bastard to have someone he loved or someone who loves him. It is just impossible.’
He had met the Ruthless Bandit, and from what he had experienced, he could tell he wasn’t someone to even consider normal. Such an evil existence shouldn’t have someone who loves them.
But from what he could tell, Princess Pandora seemed to like him. This then made him wonder just what kind of person she really is at heart.

"It will be best if we take a step back and analyze things from a much wider perspective," Kent suggested, and for a moment, Princess Pandora held a pout. However, she nodded and walked back to her chair.
After she sat down, she gave Kent a curious scan before asking:
"Are you at least going to tell me if you are indeed the Ruthless Bandit or an imitator of him? I have spent millions of years with him, but I can’t tell which of him is the real deal."
Kent furrowed his brow, a bit taken aback by what Princess Pandora had said.

"Don’t get me wrong. I know you are the Ruthless Bandit because I can call you by that name. That is only possible because, from the moment I set my sights on you, the hold you have on the others was lifted off me.
You told me that would happen when we meet again. So don’t even try to lie to me."
Kent sighed, his expression softening.
"I am indeed the Ruthless Bandit. However, I have no memories of his life when you entered it. Though I have to ask, what was your relationship with me back when I was the Ruthless Bandit?"
"Master and disciple," Princess Pandora replied.
Kent nodded and smiled. Then he asked with a smug expression, "I suppose I was the master, right?"
To his dismay, Princess Pandora let out a resounding laugh, one that caused Kent to wonder if he had said anything funny.
It was perfectly logical for him to assume he was the master since he was the Evil King. However, from her laughter, it was clear that he wasn’t the master.
This, however, made him wonder just what Princess Pandora was like in her past life. He waited for her to give him an answer.
Thirty minutes later, she managed to calm down.

"You crack me up like always, Lex. When we met, you were but a demigod fleeing from twelve Chaos Gods. The sight of you hurling profanities at them while also at risk of dying piqued my interest. I couldn’t hold back my laughter back then."
She smiled, a beautiful expression on her face. "My little Evil King, you really need to recover your memories before you make your sweet master angry."
Kent kept his expression calm, but deep down, his heart was beating like a drum.
If others saw the smile on Princess Pandora’s face, they would become charmed, for it was very beautiful. She is extremely beautiful.

However, to someone like Kent, her beautiful smile was merely a mask hiding the darkest evil. Perhaps because his evil heart was slowly awakening, he could see past her mask, and what he saw was truly horrible.
The beauty before him is the worst kind of evil he had set his sights on, and he had seen his fair share of evil in his life as Jest (Lord Genesis).
"Just who are you, and why am I afraid of you even though you mean me no harm?"
Princess Pandora smiled and answered:
"It would be hard to explain it to you unless you recover your memories. Thankfully, I can sense evil in your heart, meaning you have already taken a step but stopped.
My advice is to continue, because if you want to survive the trip to the Tormented Chaos Abyss, you’ll need those memories.

In fact, your mission to kill the four demigods and the portal guardian is secondary. Your reason for coming here is to come see me, for I am the only person who can ensure you don’t become the worst version of yourself after recovering your memories."
She paused and gazed at Kent with a narrowed gaze. "If I am not mistaken, when you recovered your first set of memories, you lost control."
Kent didn’t know how she knew, but he nodded.

"That was because what is buried in you is so much darker that the current you is not strong enough to contain it. That said, I can help keep it at bay until you reach the stage where you can handle it."
"Then why don’t I keep it buried for now until I reach the stage where I can handle it?" Kent asked, but Princess Pandora shook her head.
"Keeping it buried is the most dangerous thing you can do. If—and this is a big if—but if one day you lose control and it awakens, how confident are you that you can contain it?"
Kent couldn’t answer her question.
Indeed, he was a bit short-sighted to assume that. If the unknown erupts one day, how then can he contain it if he has no prior experience?
"You know, I have lived for many billion years before I met you, Lex. I have seen all kinds of evil, but when I saw you, I saw the worst kind of evil that even I, the Evil Queen, was impressed by.
You have in you a True Evil, the kind that had never appeared after me, and so I would be damned if I let you waste it away."

chapters.title: Chapter 1568: Main Mission
paragraphs: Kent is now aware of some things that he believes will broaden his perspective.

First, the lady before him isn’t simple at all. He had no idea what she was like in the past, but he could tell she was someone he couldn’t mess around with, or else he risked death. In fact, he can’t even glimpse anything about her true nature.

Second, from what she said, it appeared she was Lex Morvane’s master during the Dark Era. Kent could tell she was telling the truth, and that alone made him wonder about so many things, some of them even making him question if this mission was worth the preparation he had done before coming.

From the look of things, everything now revolves around the Ruthless Bandit. While he already had it on good authority that he would need his ruthless memories, he never expected them to be the focal point of his mission.
It now appeared he must read those memories and prepare for what would happen next.
From what Princess Pandora said, he must awaken the evil within him and gain control of it before leaving.
"Is your name even Pandora?" Kent asked, feeling like he knew nothing reliable at this point.
"My name is indeed Pandora. However, I am not a princess in the slightest. In fact, this version of me is merely an afterimage."
"Say what now?" Kent’s eyes widened.
The smile on Princess Pandora’s face widened, perhaps enjoying the look of shock on Kent’s face.
Naturally, Kent, who had already recovered his memories of a life where he reached the peak of Celestialhood, knew what she said wasn’t something easily achievable.

He rose to the peak, becoming an existence whose sword could sever the threads of fate. His sword could cut through the fabric of reality, exposing the void. He had achieved so much, yet the idea of having one’s afterimage live a full life was never one of them.

Afterimages are basically instances within the moment of one’s existence. If one takes a step forward, that small movement consists of many micro-movements stacked together to form the complete movement.

When separated and one is picked, that one pick can also be broken down further until it cannot be broken down any further. Once one reaches that stage, choosing just one movement can be considered an afterimage.
It is mostly seen when one’s movement is beyond what the eye can track. Long after they are gone, their afterimage would finally be registered in one’s view.
So, for her to claim this version of her was merely an afterimage, Kent doesn’t even know what or how to feel.
"Are you for real?" Kent asked, clearly in denial.

Seeing this, Princess Pandora smirked. "You are still a rookie, Lex. Years ago, you asked me what the absolute peak looks like, and I said I have yet to see it." She smiled and added, "I have seen it, and it is beyond what your mind can comprehend.
So relax and stop even thinking about anything. My existence is not something you can fathom. That said, I am what you need right now, so tell me, are you ready to become the Ruthless Bandit again?"
Kent sighed, still in shock. However, knowing he cannot ask for answers just yet, he had to focus on something else.
Before giving his answer, he asked a question first. "You said I must awaken the evil in me so you can help me keep it under control. What if I have no way of remembering all of my memories?"
"This is not a problem. I can already tell you have a way to start, so I will just have to wait and let you finish that. The rest can be opened by me when you are ready..."
He nodded.
"Then how about you tell me more about the Tormented Chaos Abyss first, since the High Priestess brought me here to learn more about that place?"
Princess Pandora nodded and turned her focus toward the scrolls on the table. For a moment, she planned on telling him everything. However, after a quick thought, she told him what he needed to know.
"It is the most dangerous place in the Star Realm. It has three levels, each filled with all kinds of horror. The Tormented Layer mostly has Immortal-level Chaos Beasts and a few demigods.
The Chaos Layer is filled with demigods and gods. Even Universal Gods can be found there, and each is a force of nature.
As for the Abyss Layer, you have no reason to go there, so it would be best if you knew nothing about it. But you must know, even Celestials of today can easily die there."
She smiled weakly, seeing the expression on Kent’s face.

"Relax. Inside the Tormented Chaos Abyss, I hold 25% authority. In fact, you would be meeting my real body there. I have waited for your return, and so now that you are here, I believe it is time for me to awaken.
Also, you will only have to survive the outer layer since, once I awaken, I will come to you. Once I find you, you will have no need to kill to absorb Chaos Energy.
I have prepared enough resources to keep you fed for millions of years."
Kent smiled, already looking forward to the day he would meet Princess Pandora’s main body.
"That said, you must do your best to survive for as long as you can. Only by entering the Tormented Chaos Abyss holding the item hidden underground of this place would I start to awaken."
Kent nodded.
"Then do you have anything else to tell me before I start?"
She smiled and nodded.
"Indeed. During the memory extraction phase, if you feel like you are about to lose control, don’t resist. I will ensure no harm comes to you."
Kent had no reason to trust her; however, he nodded, knowing she would indeed protect him. Call it a gut feeling, but he can tell the Princess before him can be trusted.

In fact, he feels like being close to her is the safest he can be at the moment. Maybe because, deep down, he knew they had, at one point in his many lives, lived as master and disciple. Maybe they even went beyond that.
"I suppose I would need a quiet and private place to cultivate."
She nodded and stood up. "Follow me."
She led him to a spacious garden where, aside from green flowers and butterflies, everything about it reeked of love and affection.
"There is a Tier 26 formation around this garden. Without my permission, nobody can enter, so relax and handle your business well."
Kent thanked her, and after a few moments, she vanished from the garden.
After she was gone, Kent let out a deep sigh.
He doesn’t know what will happen once he starts reading the memory diary, but he knows for a fact that whatever happens over the next few days/weeks will change his life tremendously.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮

The memories he is about to examine are ones he never planned to face just yet. However, keeping them contained while learning was actually detrimental to his safety; he knew he must take that step while he still had the upper hand.
But before that, there is something else he must first do.
His mission may have changed into a much more difficult one, but that doesn’t mean he must forget the one he needed to complete if he wants to make it to Elina’s galaxy.
Tapping into his connection to the Soul Universe, his three Soul Warriors, [Calix], [Kenna], and [Bello], appeared in the garden.

The memories he is about to examine are ones he never planned to face just yet.
However, keeping them contained while learning was actually detrimental to his safety; he knew he must take that step while he still had the upper hand.
But before that, there is something else he must first do.
His mission may have changed into a much more difficult one, but that doesn’t mean he must forget the one he needed to complete if he wants to make it to Elina’s galaxy.
Tapping into his connection to the Soul Universe, his three Soul Warriors, [Calix], [Kenna], and [Bello], appeared in the garden.

chapters.title: Chapter 1569: Soul Warriors
paragraphs: Since the time inside the Soul Universe syncs with the time Kent experiences, whenever he is inside the tower, it also adapts to that time.
Thanks to that, when he spent over six years inside the tower with his wives, his three Soul Warriors had also spent that same time cultivating inside the soul universe.

Since the world’s limitations didn’t apply to them, they saw no restrictions and, knowing they would be embarking on a rather dangerous mission, they gave it their all to train and become better versions of themselves.
Their efforts, of course, paid off, since at the moment they were all very powerful, especially Bello, who was the strongest to begin with.
That said, even Calix had now become a force to be reckoned with.
After cultivating for six years, he moved from Root Immortal to True Immortal. This level-up was so great that everything about him had become overpowered.
His affinities had also become much more powerful than before. Now, his four affinities had upgraded from the Master stage to the Monarch stage.
Affinities: [Soul Monarch], [Shadow Monarch], [Battle Monarch], and [Forge Monarch]
While their use appears to be the same as before, they have become much more powerful in the sense that now, he can do more than manipulate, augment, or even transform souls.
It appeared his affinities had linked so closely that he could now use them as one.
Now, he can easily adapt to the attacks of an opponent, learn their battle style, improve on the copied battle style, and take it to the next level.
So if someone’s Saint battle style is copied by him, he can improve it and make it an Emperor battle style, thereby outclassing them in every aspect of understanding.

Aside from that, he can now transform the souls of those he killed into any weapon he desires with a mere thought. Previously, he would have had to use his Forge Master affinity to do that with the aid of his Soul Master affinity.
But now, he can easily transform Soul Spirits into anything he desires with a mere thought.

He can also transform into a shadow and attack his opponent through their shadows. This, however, links to his Soul affinity, allowing him to deal more damage on the soul level by merely attacking the shadow of his opponent.

As for the [Forge Monarch] affinity, he can create whatever he desires more quickly, easily, and with super precision. He can make weapons, ammunition, and all kinds of items without struggling as before.

Kent came to the conclusion that, with enough time, Calix could create a weapon strong enough to kill even a god. This thought came to mind when he learned that as long as Calix has Soul Spirits, he can create any grade of weapon.

Already, he had created some that Kent believed would be ideal for what he planned on doing next. Since he is going away for a while, he needs them to work behind the scenes to determine whether the mission to save Skull City would be harrowing or manageable.
But aside from [Calix], there is also [Kenna], who went from the Core Immortal stage to the Immortal King stage.

As for her, Kent is aware that her power comes into play when she slips into someone’s soul. Already, she had proved to everyone that she is lethal when it comes to Soul Arts, especially when she severed the slave links that the warlord used to bind his slaves.
Now, she has become even more dangerous.

She can enter the soul more quietly and easily compared to when she had to exert more effort. Her connection to souls has also grown to the point that, even without entering a soul, she can see its connections and sever them.
She is a Void Reaper, so her affinity for the Void has become much stronger. Now, she can use the Void more easily than before.
Just like Calix, she had also awakened more skills that would aid her in the long run.
The last of them, Bello, had now moved from the True Immortal stage to the Immortal Monarch stage.
Naturally, he remains the strongest simply because, after absorbing the soul of the Pseudo-God that Uncle Drake fought on Planet Skar, he had awakened some powerful abilities.
Now, aside from merely possessing the body of a slain enemy, he can take control over the body and abilities for 24 hours.
This means if he possesses the body of a demigod, he can use their demigod rank and abilities for 24 hours. He would have access to their memories and innate talents.
The best part is that if he manages to comprehend any of the abilities, he would be able to retain them after the 24 hours are exhausted.
Also, his connection to the River of Styx had now strengthened. He can summon resentful spirits more easily now. He can also send spirits over without much resistance.
Of course, with his connection to the underworld now stronger than ever, he had awakened a unique ability that Kent couldn’t help but wonder just how it would work in the long run.

[Call of the Grim Reaper]: Once every 66 days, you can call on a Grim Reaper from the underworld and ask of them a single favour. The Grim Reaper, provided it is within its abilities, would not deny your request.
Kent had no idea if this ability was broken or just plain insanity. However, he planned on finding out more soon enough.
Looking at all three of them standing before him, he nodded with a proud smile.
"I have a mission for you three."
They became eager to hear what he had to say. After becoming stronger, they all wanted to test their abilities, so a mission right now feels like a good thing.
"We are ready anytime, Master," Kenna said with a small giggle.
Kent nodded and started to speak.

"There is a city in this place called Stone City. They have two demigods and several Immortal Lords. Your mission is to infiltrate the city, find out just how deep their strength goes, and, if possible, kill as many Immortal Lords as you can.
Aside from them, it appears Lightning City and Flame City also want to rally behind them and attack this city. Do your best to either turn them against each other or kill as many as you can.

Lastly, find out whether other cities are rallying behind them in secret. To fight them, we must know who we are up against, so it is imperative to cover all bases and ensure no stone is left unturned."
They nodded.
"I suppose that means the Master won’t be joining us on this mission."

"Yes. I have to go somewhere, so you three must handle this mission. Use every means necessary to get results." Kent paused for a moment and said with a smile, "I would even be impressed if you three can take down a demigod or two."
His three Soul Warriors smiled weakly. "We might just surprise the Master," Calix stated, making Kent smile wider.
"Make it happen then."
They nodded, and before long, they vanished from the garden.
Kent watched them leave with a pleased smile. It appeared he wouldn’t be leaving Skull City unprotected. His Soul Warriors would make sure Stone City and its allies would have their hands full.
If only Kent realised that by unleashing his Soul Warriors, the three cities would soon know just how dangerous soul battles are.
