chapters.title: Chapter 1570: Tale of Evil (2)
paragraphs: Kent reached into his Soul Universe and brought out the book holding the Ruthless Bandit’s memories.
The last time he opened it to read, he learned about the early stages of Lex Morvane’s life. He learned that he began cultivating at the tender age of 13 rather than 16.

Because of his brilliance, he was invited to join the Nine Heavens Sect—specifically invited by the Immortal Council. That was a great achievement, one that made him a topic of discussion on the planets his father ruled over and other neighbouring planets.
After leaving home for 200 years, he returned only to meet the most chilling scene that forever changed him for the worse.

He came to see his father’s severed head hanging at the entrance of the city, his close friends and trusted aides of his family slaughtered, some sold into slavery, and the most chilling of them all—the chained, malnourished, and naked bodies of his mother and two sisters clinging on to life and their sanity.
He couldn’t bear to see them in this situation, so after rescuing them, they pleaded with him to end their suffering. Tears rolling down his face, he ended their lives, sending them away peacefully.
What finally made him lose it was discovering that his uncle, whom his father trusted and made his right-hand man, was the one behind it all.
Even more chilling, his Immortal Lord master back at the Nine Heavens Sect was a part of the betrayal, among others.
Lex swore to avenge his family, which he planned to start by wiping out the bloodline of all who betrayed his family and putting them through torture and humiliation.
*Sigh*

Kent let out a deep sigh, his expression calm as he stared at the book’s hard cover. He knew the moment he opened this book, he would be exposed to some of the horrors he had committed as the Ruthless Bandit.
He had no choice but to do so.
This was why, after a few seconds of hesitation, he resolved himself to read and be done with it.
"I guess here goes my sanity," he smiled faintly and opened the book. Flipping to the second page, he started to read.
[There is nothing more chilling than knowing the one you trusted the most would one day stab you in the back. My father trusted my uncle, and he ended up being the dagger he never saw coming.
I trusted my master, and he happened to be the one who colluded with—or, more like, manipulated—my uncle into betraying my father. Manipulated or not, they will both die a very painful death.
The question, however, is why they did what they did.

My father ruled over eight planets, each filled with billions of people and beasts. A few have rare minerals, and even Planet Biva has a Spirit Stone mine. However, I don’t think their betrayal had to do with any of these planets. In fact, I think there is something much deeper afoot, and that is what drove them to humiliate and kill my family.
Today, I have no intention of thinking about that, since I plan to get my revenge on a merchant from my uncle’s family.
I learned he and his family will be travelling to a city this evening, and I plan to end his entire bloodline before daybreak.]
A pale smile appeared on Kent’s face, something he never expected he would do, yet he did. He may not have realised it, but as he flipped to the next page, the smile lingered.

[So I did it, and it was breathtaking. You should have seen their faces when I sucked out their pitiful lives. The old merchant even had the audacity to plead for the life of his youngest daughter when she had already slipped into my baby sister’s closet.
I killed them all, including their guards, and hung their bodies—both him and his wives’ and all three daughters’ bodies—on the side of the road.

Next, I will visit my uncle’s second wife and her children and make sure they cease to exist. Afterwards, his restaurants will know my wrath, which I will exert in full, making sure even the cleaners feel my pain.
In this endeavour, I will not spare anyone linked to that bastard.
~10 days later~

The entire city is crying blood, and I know why, since I was the cause. Already, I have killed the bastard’s wives and their children, leaving only him and three of his sons. I have also killed his in-laws and their guards.
They dared to take a planet that once belonged to my father as a gift, knowing it had been obtained through betrayal and bloodshed.
None were spared, not even the next upcoming generation. They can only blame themselves for having that bastard’s blood running through them.
Next, I will visit my uncle, who had run to hide in a sect he is supporting. I learned the sect leader is a good friend. I will kill both of them and the entire sect if I have to.]
The smile on Kent’s face is a bit crooked now.
It looks a bit evil and a bit nonchalant, almost as if he doesn’t want to feel the thrill of the memories.

As he read, he found himself reliving those moments. It was like he was back in his life as the Ruthless Bandit. So while someone watching him would think he was reading, Kent was actually living—or reliving—his previous life.
That had, in a way, started to change him, as seen in the smile on his face and the aura surrounding him.
He flipped to the next page...

[It was a desperate yet futile struggle. After I was done with them, only an old sweeper was left alive. I spared him because when I was 12, he gave me a cookie after I ran away from home to join this sect, hoping to become immortal someday.
Also, by sparing him, I believe I still have sanity left in me. Maybe one day, after all of this is over, I will have a shot at living a normal life.
Of course, I can only hope.

I killed from the outer region to the core region, slaughtering every last disciple and elder in the sect. Some were away on a mission, but when they heard the sect was in danger, they came running to their deaths.
Naturally, I didn’t deny them the chance to go to the afterlife.
By now, my name had already spread across the planet and beyond, causing every soul to quake in fear when they learned what had happened.
This was also why nobody dared come to plead for his life when I marched my uncle on the street naked, his body littered with all kinds of cuts.

His death, as I had planned, was slow and excruciating. It took me 66 days to kill him. By then, I am sure his soul had been scarred for all eternity. In his next life, the pain would haunt him, for I made sure of that.
After exacting his kill, I realised I wasn’t living up to my potential, so I went further and hunted down everyone who had ever committed a crime against my family in the past.

It took 100 years, but I managed to kill over 1,560,000, all in some way linked to the downfall of my family. Now, I have to head back to the Nine Heavens Sect and make sure it ceases to exist in the coming years.]
"Hehe... this is going to be blood-curdling," Kent said with a grin, his expression twisting to mirror that of an evil demon king.
He flipped to the next page and, with cheer in his eyes, he continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 1571: Tale of Evil (3)
paragraphs: ~45 pages later~

Kent’s entire body gives off an aura of evil, the kind that seems to originate from deep within the soul. Before he started reading the memory diary, he had the aura of a dragon bathed in blood and Chaos Qi.
Now, however, he is likened to the incarnation of evil.
But that is not the chilling part. The most disturbing part is the smile on his face. It wasn’t an arrogant smile or the smile of someone having a good day.
His smile is twisted, filled with so much malice.
Kent had always had a smile on his face, but now he looked like whatever he was reading was filled with so much that made him enjoy every last page of it.
In his memories, he had already left the high world and was back in the immortal world. In fact, nothing good had happened since he left the High World.
Things only got worse after he left.
First, when word reached the Immortal Council of what had happened, instead of investigating, they sent powerful immortals to kill him the moment he showed his face in the Immortal World.

They wanted him dead, a clear sign that the downfall of his family wasn’t only from his uncle and master’s side. It went much deeper, and for that, he knew he had to get down to the root of everything.
So he did what had to be done; he resumed killing.
It got to the point where the pressure was just too much, so he formed a team of very bad people who called themselves the Evil Bandits.
Every last member of this group was, at one point in time, betrayed by the Immortal Council, so they gave their all to get revenge.
Some succeeded in avenging themselves and their loved ones; others failed. However, that was irrelevant, since after this bandit team was formed, the killing became too much.
The Immortal Council had many sects, businesses, and families. They supported many geniuses and even had a hand in many important events.
They had the power to oppose Lex. However, that also meant Lex had many targets to kill. He did, and for years, millions of people fell victim to his massacre.

Anytime he killed, things only seemed to get worse. It got to the point that his own team started to fear him. Eventually, they ran away. He didn’t blame them; however, he also didn’t put much effort into bringing them back.
By then, the name Ruthless Bandit had started to spread, giving Lex the moniker that would one day shake the universe.
Eventually, after years of killing millions of immortals, he finally got to his master...
[There is nothing better than a reunion between a disciple and his traitor master. Today, after knowingly walking into a trap, I managed to kill 20,000 immortals just so I could get to my master.
He never expected me to get to him, not when what blocked my path to him was 20,000 Immortal Lords, each a genius in their own right, while I was merely an Immortal King.

But then again, I started cultivating at 13, so what did they expect? By 16, I was a genius who caught the attention of immortals. Though now that I think about it, it seems their noticing me wasn’t for my talent but rather for something I will soon be learning from my master after I torture him enough.
I hate to say it, but I am a genius, one that appears once an era. As a result, I killed all who blocked me and reached my master.
Unlike my uncle, who suffered for 66 days, my master was an immortal, so I made sure he experienced an entire year of torture.
He tried many times to end his own life; however, before me, death is powerless, and so after breaking his body, mind, and soul, he finally spilt the beans.
Today, I finally learned who and why my family was targeted. Today, I was made aware of a force calling themselves the Universe Council, my next targets.]
Kent sucked in a cold breath, the look of evil in his eyes deepening, becoming darker and more furious. Clearly, the mention of the Universe Council had triggered him.
That is only natural.

While during his life as the Ruthless Bandit, none of his memories of his past lives came to him, deep down, the seed of hatred toward the Universe Council had already taken root in his heart, and so when he learned they were the masterminds behind his family’s downfall, that anger started to stir.
He flipped to the next page...

[The reason why they killed my family was because of a prophecy. It reads, "The life of the chosen would shine darker, illuminating all life with evil. His presence will shroud all, and when the third star shines, his arrival will herald the coming of evil."

My traitor master explained that this prophecy was given to the universe at the start of the Dark Era, and for years, seers, diviners, shamans, oracles, and clairvoyants worked to determine whom it referred to.
They failed many times until they found a trail that led to my family. Apparently, after I left for the Nine Heavens Sect, my mother got pregnant and was going to give birth to a baby boy.
However, the third star shone on her, and so they killed her, believing my unborn brother was the evil the prophecy spoke about.
When I heard this, I smiled weakly because I got what they were saying. They killed the wrong one, and now their actions had triggered the evil they feared.
My traitor master even blamed himself for not figuring it out earlier. Apparently, all forms of divination cast on me pointed to a future of good and justice.
I was the personification of benevolence, something that is impossible, considering we all have evil in us.
However, it is now too late for regrets. My baby brother died so I could be born, and now, I will become what they feared the most.]
*BOOM*
A dark aura exploded from Kent’s body, causing the green plants and flowers inside the garden to dry out. At once, his eyes changed colour, becoming completely dark.
His fingertips also turned black, and along the side of his face, tattoos of skeletal fingers ran down his neck, all the way to his legs.
The tattoo of a triangular eye called the "Eye of Evil" appeared on his forehead. Despite it being a tattoo, the red pupil within it kept shifting, looking all around.
His clothes changed into black, tattered cloaks, and a dark grimoire hung at his waist, its tattered, wood-like cover engraved with all kinds of eldritch symbols.
Behind him, the "Spear of Evil" hovered, waves of true evil Qi exploding with each of Kent’s cold heartbeats. His hair changed from purple to completely black.
In what felt like five seconds, he went from Kent Madson to the Ruthless Bandit, a transformation that had drawn the attention of two people—well, one person in two bodies.

Standing not far from the garden, Princess Pandora smiled and muttered, "Welcome back, Lex. I look forward to seeing what kind of evil you will unleash on this universe again." Her smile was filled with so much evil.
Far away inside the Abyss, a beauty whose strength far surpassed that of even the strongest Celestial, sleeping inside what looked like a sarcophagus, smiled, her eyes still closed.

Before he started reading the memory diary, he had the aura of a dragon bathed in blood and Chaos Qi.
Now, however, he is likened to the incarnation of evil.
But that is not the chilling part.
The most disturbing part is the smile on his face.
It wasn’t an arrogant smile or the smile of someone having a good day.
His smile is twisted, filled with so much malice.
Kent had always had a smile on his face, but now he looked like whatever he was reading was filled with so much that made him enjoy every last page of it.
In his memories, he had already left the high world and was back in the immortal world.
In fact, nothing good had happened since he left the High World.
Things only got worse after he left.

Every last member of this group was, at one point in time, betrayed by the Immortal Council, so they gave their all to get revenge.

The Immortal Council had many sects, businesses, and families.
They supported many geniuses and even had a hand in many important events.
They had the power to oppose Lex.
However, that also meant Lex had many targets to kill.
He did, and for years, millions of people fell victim to his massacre.
Anytime he killed, things only seemed to get worse.
It got to the point that his own team started to fear him.
Eventually, they ran away.
He didn’t blame them; however, he also didn’t put much effort into bringing them back.

I hate to say it, but I am a genius, one that appears once an era.

Unlike my uncle, who suffered for 66 days, my master was an immortal, so I made sure he experienced an entire year of torture.

Today, I finally learned who and why my family was targeted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1572: Tale of Evil (4)
paragraphs: ~122 Pages Later~
There is one thing to become aware that the Universe Council was behind the downfall of his family, and another to actually do something about it.

That was where the Ruthless Bandit had found himself. He had never expected that after learning the Universe Council had a hand in his family’s downfall, he wouldn’t have the means to do something about it.
He was merely an Immortal King, so naturally, he wasn’t at the point where going against demigods, gods, Supremes, and Celestials would be within his strength level.
So he had to pause and first raise his strength.
Because of the kind of reputation he held, he was feared by many. Already, he was being hunted, and so, using the thrill of the kills, he started training even more.
The motivation to kill had pushed him to train more. A few years after he killed his master, he stepped into the rank of an Immortal Emperor.
This greatly increased his strength, but it wasn’t enough for him to be arrogant. Naturally, he never tried to be that; instead, he paid more attention to his power.
He could tell that while he indeed allowed his anger to define him, there was something else at play. The power within him wasn’t something he could explain.

It took him 10 years to make sense of what had caused all this. When he did, instead of fearing for his life, he confronted it, and after a long struggle, he took control of his heart demon, enslaving it.

However, by doing so, he also cut off every goodness in his heart. His emotions were severed, and since then, an emotionless demon was born, one that doesn’t care what he has to do if it means he gets to have his revenge on the people who dared to kill his family.
Surprisingly, after he enslaved his heart demon, his strength started to surge. In less than 3 months, he moved from the Immortal Emperor stage to the Immortal Lord stage.
The day he became an Immortal Lord, the universe shed bitter tears. It was as if seeing a man devoured by his hatred made him fall even deeper into his evil intent.
The Ruthless Bandit accepted his name, and so he started what would be recorded in the forbidden records as the Grim Massacre.
As Kent continued to read the book, his appearance changed with it. In fact, the aura around him seemed to start to spill out of the garden, causing thousands in Skull City to tremble in sheer fear.
This drew the attention of the High Priestess, so she came back to Princess Pandora’s place to check, since she could tell the aura was coming from her place.
"What is happening?" she asked, approaching the garden where Princess Pandora stood guard.
"Nothing to worry about, Mother. Lord Kent is just cultivating because he mysteriously gained enlightenment after hearing about the Evil King."
"I see. I was scared there for a moment," hearing the reason, the High Priestess calmed down a bit.

She looked at Kent, currently facing her with his back, and something inside her stirred. She didn’t personally know the Evil King, but she had felt his presence, and now, as she looked at Kent, she felt as if she were staring at the man whose voice she had heard a few times.
Knowing that was impossible, considering the Evil King is long gone, she sighed and walked away. She had to calm everyone down first before they all ran away.
Kent had no idea what was happening around him. He kept reading for hours. Soon, only five pages were left to go.
By then, the Ruthless Bandit had already accumulated enough strength and had even started attacking the Universe Council.𝕗𝚛𝚎𝚎𝐰𝗲𝗯𝗻𝚘𝚟𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝕞
[Going against an organisation that had been around since the Primordial Era is not a joke. Already, I had clashed with ten gods and came close to death every single time.
However, no matter the horror, I always made it out alive.
Why? Because I want to live long enough to kill every last one of them. I may not be a Celestial, but I will kill a Celestial and keep killing until every last one of them is dead.
I have already gathered information revealing the hierarchy of the Universe Council. Apparently, I would need more than enough power to vanquish them.

They are monsters in human clothing, and that translates literally into their strength. So I will start somewhere and make sure that, when I am done, they will feel my wrath deep in their hearts even after I am gone.

I received news from a reliable source that the current Leader of the Universe Council has a daughter who is currently a demigod. The source revealed that she has five guards, who comprise four demigods and one god.
She would be the spark that would light the fire. In ten days’ time, she would die, and that would be my declaration of war against the Universe Council.]
Kent flipped to the next page...
[It ended in total annihilation. All five guards died after a grave battle that lasted for just an hour. In the end, however, I couldn’t bring myself to kill her.

She may be the daughter of a great evil who had the heart to issue the order to kill an unborn baby, but she is not her father. I hate him, but it turned out I don’t hate everyone. Yet again, I was reminded that I still have some goodness in me, something I hate very much.
Honestly, I wonder why I even spared her life when I had killed many for far less.
However, by sparing her, she got what she wanted—to live a life free of her father’s influence. I had set her free, and in return, she gave me a spear.
I honestly don’t know why I accepted the spear. It looks ordinary, and most importantly, it looks like it has reached the last leg of its durability.
I think I have been scammed by that lady. Though I promised not to pursue her, so I guess she had this one. I can’t win all, I suppose.]
Kent chuckled, for the first time, a genuine emotion of helplessness appearing in his eyes. It appears he found the ordinary nature of the spear very amusing.
However, he soon flipped to the next page, and that was when the aura around him and the spear hovering behind him changed.
At once, the entire city was enveloped in the malevolent aura of evil, the kind that caused many to go down on their knees and start praying to the Evil God.

Soon, the entire city entered a state of prayer. Every last one of them, including the High Priestess, entered this state. In their hearts, the Evil God had descended and was bestowing his protection upon them.
The only person who wasn’t in a prayerful state was Princess Pandora, who sat in a comfortable chair, sipping wine with visible ripples of boiling on its surface.
One could only wonder where she got the hell wine from.
As she watched Kent continue to read, a smile lingered on her face. Soon, the smile widened a little, causing her to smirk.
"Welcome back, Lex Morvane. Now, you reap what you sow, for you deserve it all."

To the ordinary eye, nothing extraordinary is going on. However, to those with a third eye, they can see that as the people pray, a change starts to take root in Kent, one that had been planted a very long time ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 1573: Rebirth of the Ruthless Bandit (1)
paragraphs: [Well, I suppose I might have spoken too early. It turned out the spear I was given wasn’t something I should have looked down on.
Lesson learned.
But now that I have seen the true nature of the spear given to me by the daughter of the Celestial Supreme, I can’t help but wonder just where she got it from.
That kind of weapon wasn’t something someone like her should have had in her possession to begin with.
It introduced itself as Ryoa, an eldritch evil born from the very essence of darkness. It claimed it was the first of its kind.
I was very shaken when I heard it speak. Later, I learned more about Ryoa and even started treating it as a person.
Ryoa is a living weapon born from the very essence of evil, and so when it linked with me, I finally broke free from the last shred of goodness I had in me.
The relief of finally being free of goodness was intoxicating. It was the best time of my life. Now, I have a weapon that grows with me and bestows on me all kinds of eldritch evil.

I honestly don’t know why that lady gave it to me, but I bet now, if she looked at what I had gained, she would cry tears of anguish. But then again, destiny and fate have their own way of doing things. Maybe I was meant to have this.
Now I do, and I plan on killing another set of gods who have come to seek revenge after news of me killing the daughter of the Celestial Supreme spread all over.]
Kent grinned, flipping to the next page.

Behind him, the Spear of Evil released waves of Evil Qi, the kind that would make even a demigod cower in fear. On its shaft, nine runes lit up one by one, each adding to the already powerful Qi in the air.
After the ninth rune lit up, the spear transformed, taking on the look of a bone dragon.
ROAR

It roared, causing the entire Skull City to tremble. Many felt their souls shaken, and for a moment, they entertained the idea of running. However, they changed their minds when a voice whispered into their ears.
’Mutsu mi o lo’

It wasn’t words they understood, but at once, they all felt a familiar force slip into their bodies. On their foreheads, a skull tattoo appeared, and at once, every last soul was cocooned in a dark, malevolent energy.
The only person who wasn’t affected was Princess Pandora, who sat drinking her hell wine.
Noticing what had happened, she smiled weakly.
It appeared she knew what had happened, and so she could only wait for the awakening of the First Evil Race.
"I don’t know what you saw the last time when you entered that place, Lex, but if this is the path you have chosen, then I will support you to the end."
She flicked her hand, and a red orb flew, merging with Kent’s forehead. He didn’t know something had entered his body just yet. Soon, however, he would be made aware.

[I killed 100 True Gods as an Immortal Lord and nearly died against a God King. People are in shock, but I am disappointed. All those 100 gods were powerful, but after Ryoa and I bonded, I had also become powerful.
Nearly dying against a God King was just humiliating for me.

Unfortunately for me, becoming a demigod is proving to be impossible. I’ve tried three times already but haven’t been able to break through. It feels like whenever I am about to break the barrier, something stops me.
Maybe they are afraid of me attaining divinity. Maybe they are scared of what I will become when I tap into the boundless power of Divine Qi.
I cannot let that happen. Now that I am in a God World, I believe it is imperative to have access to Divine Qi and be able to form my own domain, else next time, I will die.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
Since that is the case, I will use the method Ryoa gave me. I will use the souls of 1000 gods as a sacrifice to the Evil Dao and finally open the path that has never been tread before.]
Kent flipped to the next page, leaving only two more pages to go...
[The Universe Council is now afraid of me, so they didn’t send more gods after me. But they gave me ample time to hunt, and now that I have 1000 god-beast souls, the ritual will be performed today.
As to whether I succeed or not, the heavens will bear witness.]
Kent closed his eyes, but he still seemed to be reading. However, as he closed his eyes, the grimoire hanging on his waist moved and started to hover before him.
Just when his reading reached the part where the ritual started, it flung open, revealing three red diagrammatic symbols on the front page.
One looks like a star lined with three crisscross bones. The second looks like an eye pierced by an arrow, encased within a triangle. The last is a seal with nine arrays inside.
They glowed faintly.

Kent flipped to the next page, and with it, the three diagrams moved from the page and merged with his forehead. At once, his entire body exploded into waves of Evil Qi, so dense that Princess Pandora was shaken for a moment.
She stood up and walked forward, wanting to see what had happened.
"This..."
Her expression changed at once. The initial smile on her face was replaced by a stunned look, clearly shaken by what she had seen.
"True Evil Awakening... just how..."
She waved her hand, and a black stone appeared. Before she could do anything herself, the stone flew from her hand and vanished into Kent’s chest.
"Oh, how insidious." An evil smile formed on her face as she waved her hand, retrieving a mountain of that stone. They all vanished into Kent’s soul sea.
The black stones are called [Evil Heart Stones], minerals imbued with the power of True Evil. To non-evil cultivators, absorbing it greatly enhances their killing intent.
However, to Kent, something even more sinister had begun to take shape within his Soul Sea.
After a few minutes, he flipped to the last page, where a diagram could be found instead of text. The diagram glowed red and turned to mist along with the book, everything entering his forehead.
Behind him, the bone dragon shrank and entered Kent’s forehead, vanishing into his Soul Sea.

A few seconds later, a dark cocoon, much thicker and denser than the one surrounding the Velkharians, formed around him, encasing his evil self in what promised to be the awakening of the first and last Evil.
Princess Pandora stood guard, her expression back to normal.
Inwardly, however, she couldn’t wait long enough for Kent to emerge from his transformation.

She had only expected Kent to recover his memories and awaken his Evil Heart Seed. However, now it appears he has started his first awakening, one that would not only awaken his Evil Heart Seed but also form his Evil Core, making him a True Evil by all standards.
Many people walk the path of evil in this universe, but in the history of the universe, only two people ever walked the path of True Evil.
The first was an eldritch creature banished into this universe, known as the Queen of Evil.
The second was the Ruthless Bandit, who had died and now returned to reclaim what he had left behind—the Legacy of Evil, something the Unknown Race had been searching for aeons.

Behind him, the Spear of Evil released waves of Evil Qi, the kind that would make even a demigod cower in fear.
On its shaft, nine runes lit up one by one, each adding to the already powerful Qi in the air.
After the ninth rune lit up, the spear transformed, taking on the look of a bone dragon.
ROAR
It roared, causing the entire Skull City to tremble.
Many felt their souls shaken, and for a moment, they entertained the idea of running.
However, they changed their minds when a voice whispered into their ears.
’Mutsu mi o lo’
It wasn’t words they understood, but at once, they all felt a familiar force slip into their bodies.
On their foreheads, a skull tattoo appeared, and at once, every last soul was cocooned in a dark, malevolent energy.
The only person who wasn’t affected was Princess Pandora, who sat drinking her hell wine.
Noticing what had happened, she smiled weakly.
It appeared she knew what had happened, and so she could only wait for the awakening of the First Evil Race.
"I don’t know what you saw the last time when you entered that place, Lex, but if this is the path you have chosen, then I will support you to the end."
She flicked her hand, and a red orb flew, merging with Kent’s forehead.
He didn’t know something had entered his body just yet.
Soon, however, he would be made aware.
[I killed 100 True Gods as an Immortal Lord and nearly died against a God King.
People are in shock, but I am disappointed.
All those 100 gods were powerful, but after Ryoa and I bonded, I had also become powerful.
Nearly dying against a God King was just humiliating for me.
Unfortunately for me, becoming a demigod is proving to be impossible.
I’ve tried three times already but haven’t been able to break through.
It feels like whenever I am about to break the barrier, something stops me.
Maybe they are afraid of me attaining divinity.
Maybe they are scared of what I will become when I tap into the boundless power of Divine Qi.
I cannot let that happen.
Now that I am in a God World, I believe it is imperative to have access to Divine Qi and be able to form my own domain, else next time, I will die.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
Since that is the case, I will use the method Ryoa gave me.
I will use the souls of 1000 gods as a sacrifice to the Evil Dao and finally open the path that has never been tread before.]
Kent flipped to the next page, leaving only two more pages to go...
[The Universe Council is now afraid of me, so they didn’t send more gods after me.
But they gave me ample time to hunt, and now that I have 1000 god-beast souls, the ritual will be performed today.
As to whether I succeed or not, the heavens will bear witness.]
Kent closed his eyes, but he still seemed to be reading.
However, as he closed his eyes, the grimoire hanging on his waist moved and started to hover before him.
Just when his reading reached the part where the ritual started, it flung open, revealing three red diagrammatic symbols on the front page.
One looks like a star lined with three crisscross bones.
The second looks like an eye pierced by an arrow, encased within a triangle.
The last is a seal with nine arrays inside.
They glowed faintly.
Kent flipped to the next page, and with it, the three diagrams moved from the page and merged with his forehead.
At once, his entire body exploded into waves of Evil Qi, so dense that Princess Pandora was shaken for a moment.
She stood up and walked forward, wanting to see what had happened.
"This..."
Her expression changed at once.
The initial smile on her face was replaced by a stunned look, clearly shaken by what she had seen.
"True Evil Awakening... just how..."
She waved her hand, and a black stone appeared.
Before she could do anything herself, the stone flew from her hand and vanished into Kent’s chest.
"Oh, how insidious." An evil smile formed on her face as she waved her hand, retrieving a mountain of that stone.
They all vanished into Kent’s soul sea.
The black stones are called [Evil Heart Stones], minerals imbued with the power of True Evil.
To non-evil cultivators, absorbing it greatly enhances their killing intent.
However, to Kent, something even more sinister had begun to take shape within his Soul Sea.
After a few minutes, he flipped to the last page, where a diagram could be found instead of text.
The diagram glowed red and turned to mist along with the book, everything entering his forehead.
Behind him, the bone dragon shrank and entered Kent’s forehead, vanishing into his Soul Sea.

A few seconds later, a dark cocoon, much thicker and denser than the one surrounding the Velkharians, formed around him, encasing his evil self in what promised to be the awakening of the first and last Evil.
Princess Pandora stood guard, her expression back to normal.
Inwardly, however, she couldn’t wait long enough for Kent to emerge from his transformation.
She had only expected Kent to recover his memories and awaken his Evil Heart Seed.
However, now it appears he has started his first awakening, one that would not only awaken his Evil Heart Seed but also form his Evil Core, making him a True Evil by all standards.
Many people walk the path of evil in this universe, but in the history of the universe, only two people ever walked the path of True Evil.
The first was an eldritch creature banished into this universe, known as the Queen of Evil.
The second was the Ruthless Bandit, who had died and now returned to reclaim what he had left behind—the Legacy of Evil, something the Unknown Race had been searching for aeons.

chapters.title: Chapter 1574: Rebirth of the Ruthless Bandit (2)
paragraphs: The records of the Jade Emperor described some things and some people as beyond the realm of common sense. These people, no matter how closely one looks at them, just don’t make sense.

The records described the Primordial Chaos Dragon as an entity whose nature lies beyond common sense. It was said that his entire existence was so bizarre that making heads or tails of him was just not possible.
Years later, the Ruthless Bandit was born, an existence that also defied the laws of common sense. He stood at the peak of immortality and fought, killed, and slaughtered gods.
The forbidden records speak of him as one of the untamed ones, for he indeed exists outside the realm of common sense.
Many came and left.
Today, the rebirth of the Ruthless Bandit had already sent waves of shock everywhere, causing fear and panic to take root in the hearts of many.
[Infinity Universe - The Celestial Universe Garden]
Inside a lush garden where, aside from life, no other energy could be sensed, sat a man with flowing dark hair drinking tea from a jade cup.
Looking closely at him, he does not appear to be a day over 40, despite already having lived for billions of years. His handsomeness trumps that of many men.
At some point, he was known as the most handsome man in the entire universe.
While no beauty contest was held to determine whether those claims were true, given his perfect bone structure, there is no doubt that his handsomeness ranks among the top 10.
But while his good looks will score him some brownie points, it is the aura around him that would cause anyone to look at him with interest.

He has the aura of a Celestial, but hidden within it, a profound aura that can’t be explained lingers. This aura gives him a presence that would force even a Celestial at their peak to bow before him.

If Jest (Kent’s incarnation, known widely as Lord Genesis) were around, he would have recognized this aura, for in his final moments during the divine era, he felt it—the aura of a half-step Primordial.
This man’s name is Han Tan, the 14th Celestial Supreme, leader of the Universe Council.
Nobody really knows how the Celestial Supremes are selected, only that at the end of every era, a new one is revealed to the universe, every last one of them from the same lineage.
Han Tan has existed since the beginning of this era, and for billions of years, he has been preparing for the arrival of people he deemed a threat to the universe.
Today, he senses the emergence of perhaps the greatest of them all.
He lifted his teacup and was about to take a sip of his tea when a crack appeared at the bottom, and the tea started to spill out.
"Hmmm," he hummed, his brow tightening a bit.

Throwing his head to the left, his gaze penetrated space and time, looking beyond the borders of the universe. As someone blessed by the very heavens, he has special privileges that allow him to do more than the ordinary being.
So as his gaze penetrated the void, he knew he would be able to spot the threat and clip it in the bud before it sprouted and bloomed into a threat he could not handle.
This was not his first rodeo.

However, just when he was about to find the location of the threat, a golden eye with a red pupil opened, releasing a wave of unfathomable energy, the kind that rendered all forms of authority Han Tan had null and void.
The void and the very fabric of the universe shattered when this eye opened.
Seated inside the garden, Han Tan shut his eyes instantly, green blood coming from the corners.
"W-What was that?" he muttered, a frown appearing on his face.
"A dragon..." As someone who knows everything from the dawn of this universe, he recognized the eye immediately.
However, he just could not understand whose eye that was or why they protected the presence he believed was the Ruthless Bandit.
For a moment, the look of panic settled in his heart. He is among the beings who stand at the peak of the universe. He sees himself as an Absolute, but with a mere gaze, he was defeated.

The feeling of defeat and weakness washed over his heart, making him frown deeper. Suddenly, a subtle wave of red energy began seeping from his body, causing the green life in the garden to begin drying out.
After sitting inside the garden for a moment, he stood up, and with a simple step, he vanished into thin air
[Core of the Universe - Lady Universe’s POV]
Seated on her usual throne, Lady Universe watched everything happening to Kent inside the Star Realm with a calm expression.
Many years ago, she and every Dao in existence tried to prevent the birth of Ruthless Bandit simply because, from their perspective, that power was foreign and, as such, they had no hold over it.
The Dao of Evil originated from outside this universe, so it doesn’t fall under their laws.
However, after many attempts that ultimately ended in abysmal failure, they gave up and watched as the Ruthless Bandit emerged, bringing pain and horror to the universe.
They tried to raise many heroes to kill him; however, just when they were almost about to succeed, an existence locked in the void stopped them.
This existence was one none of them could comprehend, so when he intervened, they all stepped back.
To their shock, however, when the time came for the universe to face the ultimate trial, the one who stood at the vanguard was the same person they had tried many times to kill.
Today, watching as Kent undergoes his rebirth, finally reclaiming a part of his shattered soul, she could only sigh.
She knew the Kent she knew would change when this transformation was over. That, and the fact that the existence she just couldn’t understand had moved to shield him again, made her feel uneasy.
Turning away from the cocoon that would soon be hatching, her gaze landed on a slumbering dragon inside the void.

"Just who are you, and what do you want with him?" she asked in a hushed tone, perhaps afraid the figure would hear her. For a moment, her expression changed, but then she sighed and turned back to Kent’s cocoon.
"My existence is one even I don’t know. But rest assured, when the time comes, you will finally understand everything."
The reply entered her ear and mind, sinking deep into her heart.
Surprisingly, the voice was rather calm. It sounded distant and, for a moment, familiar. However, before she could digest everything, the cocoon cracked, and waves of evil Qi gushed out.
The cocoon cracked, and from within, waves of insidious energy poured out. It widened the next second, and this time a dark flame burst out, engulfing the garden.
ROAR
A loud roar came from the cocoon, shattering it instantly. From within, a bone dragon rose into the air and circled around. Wherever it moved, dark flames followed.
On the ground, Kent’s figure was revealed.
He looked pale, almost like all the blood in his body had been sucked out.

On his forehead, his dragon horns stood, now completely black in color instead of dark gold. His body was of the same size, but on his back, 12 metallic tendril extended from his tattered cloak armor.

His eyes were dark with white pupils. His hair had shortened, only touching his shoulders. Aside from that, around his waist, a dark silver belt remained fastened, a black wooden-covered grimoire hanging loose from it.
Finally, hovering four inches off his back, a skull-shaped diagram bathed in dark flames spun, every revolution causing the air to shimmer.
"HMMM"
Kent let out a sigh, then he lifted his gaze up.
"RYOA..." he called out, and lightning and thunder echoed in the clouds. His bone dragon, which had at one point entered the clouds, descended like a mountain toward Kent.
Just when he was a meter away, it transformed into a black spear decorated in all kinds of eldritch symbols and entered his waiting grip.

chapters.title: Chapter 1575: Quests Of Evil
paragraphs: There was nothing like a prophecy.
The only thing that was left behind was a promise, one that had been fulfilled.

All over Skull City, one cocoon after another started to dissolve, revealing one person after another. In the span of five minutes, over 90% of the cocoons dissolved, and in their place, beings with pitch-black hair and an aura of evil intent remained.
Every last one of them, even the babies, has this presence.
When Kent entered the city about a week ago, everyone he met had a calm, warm presence. However, looking at them now, one can tell they are far from the benevolent beings he came to meet.
A week ago, they were Velkharians; today, they have become beings born from the very essence of evil. Their race changed from Velkhar to Thal’Khang, the first of their kind.
Standing atop a mountain formed from the jawbone of the large skull, Kent gazed down coldly at the people now on their knees, praising him.
Standing beside him, Princess Pandora held a calm smile.
She said nothing, just stood beside him until Kent suddenly smiled.

"It feels all too familiar yet foreign," he muttered, sweeping his gaze across the city. "These people had, for billions of years, kept me in their hearts despite knowing I was nothing but pure evil. Makes me wonder just what they saw in me."

Princess Pandora smiled. "It seems you have forgotten the state you were in when you got here the last time. I quite remember you were this close to death when the High Priestess at that time gave her all to pull you back.

You survived, and to repay them, you gave them a promise. Today, you had to fulfill that promise. You made them the best version of themselves. The question, however, is whether you have the heart to abandon them, knowing they would always pray to you."
Kent sighed again and turned to look at the dragon standing on his shoulder. "What do you think, Ryoa? Should we abandon them?"
The bone dragon let out a low hum, causing black flames to come out of his eye sockets and maw.

"Lord Evil had promised to free them from the shackles binding their destinies. Lord Evil did, and so logic dictates we should let them rot. However, logic also dictates that having a reliable team on our side would come in handy, so I believe Lord Evil should give them a chance to redeem themselves."
"You really think they deserve a second chance, buddy?"

"I do. I can see that about 70% of them have the potential to be Supreme warriors. Ten percent are at the Celestial stage, and the rest are duds. Of course, with the Book of Evil in your possession now, there is no telling how many would survive the trial, but if Lord Evil can have his own legion, it would be great."
Kent sighed yet again and replied:
"But I already have the Night Riders."

"That is true, but Lord Evil seems to forget something. In the past, the Book of Evil wasn’t with us, so we had to make do with them. Now, we have it, and so we can create our own legion, one that wouldn’t pale to the riders.
You asked me why I chose you back then. The answer is simple: I see greatness in you, and so I believe that by taking the step to defy logic, we would survive this time and open the Legacy.
Although I don’t know when, I can feel them coming. Soon, the battle we all feared will be upon us, and so Lord Evil must think about the future and plan accordingly."
Kent nodded and pointed his finger up.
From the clouds, a large wooden gate descended and landed at the center of the city. Then, tapping into his power over them, he let his voice carry his words to every ear.
"Hear my decree. All who aspire to follow the Evil King into battle must prove themselves capable of wielding the power of evil. Behind this door are the gates of inheritance I have created.

Venture into it, challenge a gate, and earn the mark of evil. Everyone has one chance to challenge a gate. Failure means you would forever remain useless. But those who pass and earn my mark would have the opportunity to comprehend my Dao."
"Nicely done, Lord Evil."
Kent nodded and was about to address Princess Pandora when a message appeared before him.
There are already some messages he must review, but after his transformation, the Tower seems to have entered another upgrade mode, so he couldn’t review them.
Hearing the familiar ring made him narrow his eyes.
However, he chose to read.
[You have received two new quests]
[First Quest: Kill the Crimson Blood Demon General]
[Rank: SS]
[Description: The Crimson Blood Demon General holds the key to your destination. Only by killing him can you get to where you want to go. He must be killed by you alone...]
[Threat Profile:]
Title: Crimson Blood Demon General
Rank: Peak Demigod
Combat Power: True God
Soul Power: God King
Mental Power: God King
Body Strength: God King (Golden Emperor Body Art)
Sword Rank: Immortal
[Rewards:]
↠ Realm Ascension Pill (Dao Approved - Released)
↠ Nine Calamity Evil Eye Art
↠ Soul Bone Tempering Art

Kent may have changed from a monster to an absolute monster since, at the moment, he is the incarnation of the Ruthless Bandit. However, looking at the message inside the quest, he couldn’t help but wonder just why the hell he was given such a quest.
His mind spun, and for a minute, he couldn’t help but suck in a deep breath.
"Crimson Blood Demon General."
Princess Pandora’s eyes widened for a moment. "Uhm, where did you hear that name from?" she asked, causing Kent to turn and look at her.
"Do you know who that person is?"
"Of course I do. Though I wonder where you know him from and even dare mention his name when you plan on going to his domain soon."
"Oh, so he is inside the Tormented Chaos Abyss."
"Indeed. He is one of the Four Overlords of the Tormented layer. From what I know, he is the strongest of them and also the most dangerous being you would ever meet when down in the Tormented Layer."
"I see."
Kent turned his focus to the second quest.
[Quest Name: Legion of Evil (Chain Quest)]
[Rank: SS]

[Description: Venture into the Tormented layer of the Tormented Chaos Abyss and recruit those worthy to wield your banner into battle. The quest will update with further details when you set foot inside the abyss.]𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
[Rewards:]
↠ The Grim Contract (300 copies - 10 received)
A pale smile formed on Kent’s face. The second quest is vague, but as someone who had already completed a chain quest before, he knew it would be anything but simple.
In fact, he has reasons to believe this quest will be more difficult than the first one.

However, since it had been a long time since he received a quest, he believed this would be the best chance to test his abilities. The one standing now is no ordinary Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator.
In fact, he is far more deadly than even a True Immortal. However, because his cultivation base is limiting him, he cannot do more.
That, however, is about to change.
Kent reached into his soul universe and pulled out a purple pill.
*GASP*
The moment Princess Pandora and Ryoa saw it, they both gasped.

Hearing the familiar ring made him narrow his eyes.
However, he chose to read.
[You have received two new quests]
[First Quest: Kill the Crimson Blood Demon General]
[Rank: SS]
[Description: The Crimson Blood Demon General holds the key to your destination.
Only by killing him can you get to where you want to go.
He must be killed by you alone...]
[Threat Profile:]
Title: Crimson Blood Demon General
Rank: Peak Demigod
Combat Power: True God
Soul Power: God King
Mental Power: God King
Body Strength: God King (Golden Emperor Body Art)
Sword Rank: Immortal
[Rewards:]
↠ Realm Ascension Pill (Dao Approved - Released)
↠ Nine Calamity Evil Eye Art
↠ Soul Bone Tempering Art
Kent may have changed from a monster to an absolute monster since, at the moment, he is the incarnation of the Ruthless Bandit.
However, looking at the message inside the quest, he couldn’t help but wonder just why the hell he was given such a quest.
His mind spun, and for a minute, he couldn’t help but suck in a deep breath.
"Crimson Blood Demon General."
Princess Pandora’s eyes widened for a moment.
"Uhm, where did you hear that name from?" she asked, causing Kent to turn and look at her.
"Do you know who that person is?"
"Of course I do.
Though I wonder where you know him from and even dare mention his name when you plan on going to his domain soon."
"Oh, so he is inside the Tormented Chaos Abyss."
"Indeed.
He is one of the Four Overlords of the Tormented layer.
From what I know, he is the strongest of them and also the most dangerous being you would ever meet when down in the Tormented Layer."
"I see."
Kent turned his focus to the second quest.
[Quest Name: Legion of Evil (Chain Quest)]
[Rank: SS]
[Description: Venture into the Tormented layer of the Tormented Chaos Abyss and recruit those worthy to wield your banner into battle.
The quest will update with further details when you set foot inside the abyss.]𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
[Rewards:]
↠ The Grim Contract (300 copies - 10 received)
A pale smile formed on Kent’s face.
The second quest is vague, but as someone who had already completed a chain quest before, he knew it would be anything but simple.
In fact, he has reasons to believe this quest will be more difficult than the first one.
However, since it had been a long time since he received a quest, he believed this would be the best chance to test his abilities.
The one standing now is no ordinary Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator.
In fact, he is far more deadly than even a True Immortal.
However, because his cultivation base is limiting him, he cannot do more.
That, however, is about to change.
Kent reached into his soul universe and pulled out a purple pill.
*GASP*
The moment Princess Pandora and Ryoa saw it, they both gasped.

chapters.title: Chapter 1576: Realm Ascension Pill
paragraphs: Letting out such a gasp wasn’t out of context.
The pill in Kent’s hand demanded such a reaction, especially since it is something that can’t easily be achieved by even the best alchemist.
In the field of alchemy, there are all kinds of pills ranging from Tier 0 to Tier 100. The peak of pill-making is Tier 100, something only Pill Celestials can achieve.
A Tier 100 pill is stronger than even a Supreme. The reason being, at Tier 18 and above, pills gain sentience. So the higher the tier, the more intelligent they become.
However, while a Tier 100 pill can be comparable to a Celestial cultivator, there is one type of pill that can’t be placed on a scale.
These pills are known as Dao Pills.
They have no grade, nor pill rings.
However, to concoct a Dao Pill, one had to be well-versed in the art of that Dao, their understanding extending to a firm grasp of a major aspect of it.
The pill in Kent’s hand is the [Realm Ascension Pill].

Like its name, it allows one to ascend through the realms regardless of the limitations in place. Kent is stuck at the Heavenly Ascension stage, not because he cannot break through. He is stuck because he has yet to ascend to an Immortal World.

The moment he ascends, the seal keeping him at Tier 19 would break, and he would be able to push beyond his current rank. Already, he suspects that when he breaks through after ascending to an Immortal World, his cultivation will soar to at least the Core Immortal stage.

Although he cannot gain access to his soul sea now, simply because the Tower had blocked it to undergo the upgrade that would allow him to successfully absorb the power of the Ruthless Bandit, Kent knew his power had risen by leaps and bounds already.
So if he were to take the Realm Ascension Pill, he would be able to step into the rank of an Immortal, finally rising to the level where he can use his abilities better.
The two quests he had received aren’t ones he can handle as a Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator. So he wants to ascend beyond that and gain power.
Thankfully, the Realm Ascension Pill had been handed to him ahead of time.
"Just where did you get this pill from?" Princess Pandora asked, her expression filled with shock. If a Dao Pill were to appear in the universe, many Celestials would kill to have it.

In fact, in the history of the legendary Kevin Sage’s journey as a Pill Celestial, he had only concocted two Dao Pills, and each caused great battles, the kind that left the universe in chaos for several thousand years.
Kent turned and looked at Princess Pandora, his expression cold. "I am not the same Lex Morvane you once knew."
His answer was simple: I have no plans to tell you where I got it from, so shut up.
Princess Pandora smiled, not offended in the slightest. She knew what was happening to Kent.
Since Kent had only just recovered his memories, he hadn’t yet adjusted to them, so his personality was darker than it should be. It would take some time for him to get used to his new power.
Naturally, once the Tower is done upgrading, he would assimilate with his other persona, balancing things out for good.
"Whatever. Since you intend to break the limit on your cultivation, go ahead. I will go bring the item you need to take with you to the Tormented Chaos Abyss."
Princess Pandora smirked and left.
After she was gone, Ryoa transformed from his dragon form to a demi-human. He had the appearance of a pale dragon-man with flowing red hair and a tattooed body.

"Lord Evil, I suppose you plan to head to that place after breaking through to the Immortal stage. However, I have already scanned the twelve cities here and discovered some decent warriors. Maybe we should conquer all of them before leaving."
Kent smirked, hearing Ryoa’s plan. "That won’t be necessary, Ryoa. I have already sent my three subordinates to handle that. I have a feeling they would surprise me soon enough."
Ryoa nodded. "Then how about you go ahead and handle your cultivation? I will fly around and see if I can find something good in this dump."
"As you wish."

Kent turned away and teleported back to the garden that had completely dried up. All over Skull City, every able-bodied person with a good head on their shoulders started entering the Gate of Evil to see if they could earn the mark of evil.
They all wished to gain the power to rally behind their king. So they were doing everything in their power to get that done.
Kent sat down and looked at the purple pill intently for a few minutes before tossing it into his mouth and swallowing it.
Just when he did, a powerful energy burst out of his body.
For a moment, he felt his soul tremble. Then something ignited in his soul, causing his eyes to release waves of purple energy.
[Thanks for the help, Master. Allow me to finish my upgrade, then we can handle yours, making sure none of the energy contained in the pill is wasted.]
"How much time do you need to finish your upgrade?"
[80 days]
"Okay. I will wait for you."
[Thank you, Master.]
Kent hummed and closed his eyes. The next time he would open them, his strength would surge far beyond what anyone would have imagined.
According to the quest, only by killing the Crimson Blood Demon General can he leave this place and cross over to Elina’s galaxy.
Already, Kent felt a bit uneasy when he received the quest. However, after seeing the power of his opponent, he knew he must rise to the occasion somehow.
His power is on par with a True Immortal, meaning he can face Immortal Lords if he uses some trump cards like the Soul Universe.
Perhaps he can even run from a Demigod thanks to the Jade Void Wings. What he cannot do, however, even if he were the greatest monster in the universe, is kill a Demigod at his current stage.

That is impossible, so the quest gave him a way to at least raise the odds on his side by at least some 20%. That still won’t allow him to dominate, but he would also have the power not to run when they clash.
It would be the most dangerous battle he would face, and so preparing before going sounded like the most logical decision.
There is a chance he might even fail to kill the Crimson Blood Demon General. However, since there is no time limit on the quest, he can test the waters and come back later to finish the job.
’I am sure this is Karma doing his thing.’ Kent smirked, sending his mind back to the life he had lived as the Ruthless Bandit.
Seated somewhere, fuming because he lost to Kent, Lord Karma also smirked, his expression narrowing toward a certain direction.
"This punk. Even after you won, you are still looking for ways to anger me." He clenched his fist. "Just wait. What awaits you in that place, I pray you don’t die easily."
If Kent were present, he would have frowned at how Lord Karma spoke; it seemed he had nothing to do with the upcoming battle between Kent and the Crimson Blood Demon General.

chapters.title: Chapter 1577: Ascension Of The Ten Emotion’s Sword Supreme (1)
paragraphs: [Planet Brymrr - Ascension Field Prepared by Inaya for her ascension]
Since the time inside the Star Gateway is much faster than the outside, Kent may have spent 100 days already in there, but on the outside, it had been just 10 days.

Within those ten days, Vexthra made arrangements for her sisters and legion, making sure the dungeon mission continued, especially since Kaizo, who had now reached the Spirit Immortal stage, wouldn’t let her rest.
After the tower was upgraded, the dungeons inside the Legion Tower moved to the new tower. The tower calls it the Dungeon Tower. Aside from the 12 dungeons already in the tower, two more were added.
However, they remained locked, preventing anyone from entering.
Vexthra had already placed them as SS-grade dungeons with at least 24 floors. This means the last floor bosses are Demigods.
Once cleared, Kent would be getting two more demigod subordinates.

However, the other 12 dungeons had upgraded to S grade, making the final floor bosses, such as Veera, Shade King Nykali, and the rest, all rise to the Immortal stage, with Ankaara even reaching the Immortal Lord stage.

Due to this, they all wanted to head back to the Planet Killer Dungeon and finish clearing the floors before Kent returned. So Vexthra gave the command and system permission to Uncle Drew and sent them away, leaving only her, Miryssa, Inaya, Ainna, Umai, and Daliah.
They spent some time inside the tower, making sure Inaya was ready since her Supreme Tribulation is only a few days away.
After enough planning, they returned to Planet Brymrr, where she would face the heavens and prove she deserves to be a Supreme.

Naturally, Supreme ascension and Celestial ascension are regarded by many, since according to the rules set by the Universe Council, the birth of a new Supreme means the universe has gained one more strength.
The heavens recognized this, so whenever a Supreme was about to appear, they would resonate far and wide, making many aware.
Because of this resonance, the enemies also try to use the chance to strike when the one taking the tribulation is occupied.

So Kent left Baldy to protect her just in case. But even he is not enough, not if a high-ranking Celestial from the Soul Temple arrives. So before the tribulation, Vexthra made a gamble and used all of Kent’s Tower points and even borrowed some to purchase an item from Gaia.
She believes it would be enough to give Inaya the chance to successfully break through to the Supreme stage.
When they returned to Planet Brymrr, the first thing Inaya did was enter a vault buried deep in the ocean. Guarding the vault is a universe god-level beast called Green Horn Angel Unicorn.
It was her mount during the divine era and also one of the strongest beast gods in the universe.
Inside the vault is a slick sword, one that had been left there for billions of years. After the Divine Era, she hadn’t touched it.
So one could only imagine the excitement the sword spirit, which had been asleep, felt when her master came back for her.
The moment she retrieved her sword and mount, they moved to the ascension ground she had prepared several years ago.
They got to work immediately.
A few days later, the rainbow sky appeared, signaling the imminent ascension of a Supreme.
"Baldy, you should be on high alert."
As someone who had previously offended many powerhouses, they knew slacking even for a second would cost them. So Vexthra wanted everything to go well.
Baldy nodded and walked back, stopping 200 km away.
"We should also go to our positions," Vexthra suggested, and they dispersed, each going to a location where they believed would give them enough advantage to handle any threat.
"Good luck, Inaya."
In less than five minutes, clouds started forming, and with them, the arrival of some powerhouses.
Demigods, Gods, Supremes, and Celestials started appearing on the planet. While not all of them could make it because of the distance, they all felt it, and so those who were close came.
However, as more powerhouses started to appear, one question lingered on everyone’s mind.
"Who is the lady about to ascend?"

None of them recognized Inaya, as was to be expected, given that she had lived during the Second Era (the Divine Era). Beings from that era are known as Ancient Ancestors, since almost all of them had long become Celestials and the backbone of this universe.
A mere God cannot be from that era, so none even entertained that idea.
Soon, this question began to disturb many, to the point that even the Celestials wanted to command Inaya to reveal her identity.
Safe to say she did, and when those who knew of her existence recognized her, the shock left them all gobsmacked.

Just when the tribulation cloud was almost formed, Inaya opened her eyes, and when she did, ten identical copies of herself burst out from her body and flew into the air, each having a distinct aura and hair color.
The aura of Wrath, Sorrow, Joy, Fear, Love, Hatred, Despair, Hope, Calm, and Obsession surrounded them, each exuding the power of a Sword Supreme.
"Oh my, it is her... The Ten Emotions Sword Supreme, the second God to become a Sword Supreme, and the partner of the legendary Lord Genesis."
The moment her identity was revealed, many gasped in shock.
Up until today, many of them had only heard of her from their ancestors or read about her in ancient records.
Seeing her in person left all of them wondering just what they were about to witness.
A Supreme who had tried to follow the path of the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme but failed looked at her idol with a look of delight.
"I only managed to master four emotions, yet my swordsmanship is on another level. I can’t believe I am about to witness the real deal."
She retrieved a recording device and started recording everything. She wasn’t the only one; some Celestials even began secretly recording.
Even before the tribulation was revealed, word had spread far and wide, reaching both friends and foes. Soon, Planet Brymrr would witness the gathering of the universe’s greatest.
However, the main event soon revealed itself.
*RUMBLE* *RUMBLE*
From the tribulation cloud, seven banners engraved with the heads of seven different beasts appeared and hovered just below the cloud, releasing terrifying Supreme Qi.
*GASP*
Yet again, everyone gasped, including some of the Celestials.
"The Seven Ancient Beast Banners... just how..."
Many recognized the banners, for in the history of Supreme ascension, all who faced it failed to ascend, many dying in the process.
Because it had claimed the lives of many supreme candidates, it was named the Seven Supreme Omen.
Facing it in an Ascension Tribulation is the unluckiest one can be. In fact, everyone present felt a sudden pity for Inaya, for in their hearts, she had already failed.

"Such a pity." A Celestial shook his bald head. "From what I know, nobody had ever passed the Seven Ancient Beast Banners trial. The universe will again lose yet another powerhouse because of them having bad luck."
"You are wrong, Tankhak. Someone passed this trial before," another Celestial by the name Bloj said, his hand passing through his beard.
When he spoke, many who heard him turned and looked at him. Many recognized him as an elder from the Cult of Wisdom, so they could tell he knew something.
"Who?" Celestial Tankhak asked.
"A very long time ago, a madman known by all as the Ruthless Bandit faced the Seven Ancient Beast Banners and passed it with easy, becoming the first Supreme to achieve that."
RUMBLE

paragraphs: "The Ruthless Bandit. I have only heard of him vaguely from my master. From what I knew, he was the master of the Night Riders during the Dark Era," a Supreme who heard what Celestial Tankhak said chimed in.
"Same here. The only thing I knew of that person was his affiliation with the Night Riders. I wonder why that is."
If someone who once passed the Seven Ancient Beast Banners isn’t known by many, it means there is something preventing their fame from spreading.
Aside from that, he was associated with the night riders, which is another factor. Someone of that caliber is just too powerful for nobody to know much about him.
This got them thinking.
Celestial Bjok smiled and answered the question on their minds:

"His name had been wiped from the records due to many factors. What you all need to know is that his existence was on par with that of Lord Genesis, the Divine Beast Tamer, and other legendary figures from the past.

If you want to know more, then wait for the Trial of Wisdom four years from now. I learned that a forbidden record would be put on display, which I believe will contain some knowledge about that person.
As to whether the candidates could decipher the locks, only time would tell. But for now, let’s all watch what we came here for. Perhaps, we might just witness history as it happens."
They all nodded and returned their attention to the tribulation...
Inaya stood up, her sword in her firm grip as she gazed at the seven banners.
’That bastard be raising red flags,’ she smiled, replaying a conversation she had with Kent during their six-year sex marathon after he formed his Chaos Heart.
"So tell me, what kind of tribulation do you think would be triggered for me?" Inaya asked, her hands stroking Kent’s cock as they relaxed in a bathtub.

Kent smiled silently and answered, "Considering it had been a very long time coming for you, the heavens would want to challenge you. This is not your era, so don’t expect them to go easy on you. If I were them, I would send either the Grim Road Trial, the Endless Pagoda Challenge, or the Seven Ancient Beast Banners trial."
Inaya glared at Kent for a moment before she smirked, "Good thing you aren’t the Heavenly Dao."
’Ahh, why did I even ask him?’ She lifted her head and watched as one banner with the face of a tiger on it moved away from the rest.

"From what I have read, the Seven Ancient Beast Banners trial is a seven-day trial. I have a day to kill the beast contained inside each banner. Failure to accomplish that within the designated time means I would have to face two beasts at the same time.
Also, the last beast is the strongest, while the first is the weakest."
Inaya sighed and prepared herself mentally.
"It is just a beast. How hard can it be to kill it?"
Just when she said that, the banner trembled and expanded, becoming a giant banner spanning several meters wide.
On the surface, a portal formed, and from within, the giant head of a dark-blue tiger emerged, sending waves of Supreme Qi crashing down on Inaya.
The moment she felt it, the expression on her face changed.
Every Supreme around also felt their bodies tremble. The beast is a Supreme beast, but with the power that would make even an Early Supreme tremble in their shoes.
It took just a moment for the tiger to fully emerge. When it did, it let out a powerful roar before turning to face Inaya.
"Human bug, give up while you still have some dignity left. Defeating me with that strength of yours is impossible," the beast spoke, and Inaya smiled.
She rose slowly into the air and flew up until she was on the same level as the giant tiger.
"Is that so?" she asked, the smile on her face widening.

"I have lived since the Primordial Era, human. Do you really think defeating me is something you can achieve?" It wasn’t just Inaya who could hear the beast. Everyone could, and so hearing that the tiger came from the Primordial Era, left many shaken.
Why?
Because during the Primordial Era, the beast race was considered the strongest. Humans weren’t that strong back then, so they reigned supreme.
They had access to all kinds of cultivation resources, so they grew stronger than the beasts of today.
"Defeating you is simple, my friend. The only question is how much time it would take me to get it done," Inaya smirked, and then the smile on her face bloomed.
"In fact, to make it fun, how about we play a game?"
The tiger said nothing, waiting for Inaya to speak.
All around, everyone paid close attention to what she wanted to say.

"Defeating you alone is not fun. So how about we play the ancient game?" Inaya paused for a moment, then she spoke, "Standing in the authority of the Primordial Chaos Dragon, I invoke the Beast God Trial."
*RUMBLE*

The tribulation cloud churned, and from within, the silhouette of a hooded figure appeared and hovered over the seven banners. In his hand were seven jade tokens, each matching the color of the banners.
The dark-blue one flew, and under everyone’s stunned and confused gaze, it merged with the black tiger.𝒇𝓻𝓮𝓮𝙬𝙚𝒃𝒏𝓸𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝓬𝓸𝒎
"You... How did you know the ancient game, and who gave you the permission to use the authority of Lord Chaos?"
Inaya smiled and pointed her sword forward. "I suppose by defeating you, I will become your master, huh?"

The black tiger stood there for ten good minutes before nodding. "I don’t know who you are, or where you received that permission from, but you would have to prove yourself worthy of being the master of the Legendary Black Fang Demon Tiger King..."
Inaya said nothing but started channeling her energy into her sword. Faint Supreme sword energy snaked around her sword and body, a sword concept of ten-colored rainbow appearing behind her.

Inwardly, she kept thanking Kent for giving her a loophole to the tribulations. While he may have played a part in her getting such a dangerous trial, he also helped invoke a trial that, if she wins, would see her become the master of seven legendary beasts.
"Remember, if the Seven Ancient Beasts Banner trial is triggered, you merely have to invoke the Beast God Trial using my name. I have already granted you permission to use it eight times."
’Thank you, Kent. I owe you one.’ The smile on her face vanished, replaced by a red mask.

Black Fang roared and lunged forward, sending waves of Supreme Qi in Inaya’s direction. She lifted her sword to her eye level and, using her left hand, brushed her finger along the length of her sword, causing a reddish rune to appear on it.
"Wrath."
The emotion of wrath was activated, causing her power to surge. Suddenly, she vanished, and in her place, a large reddish jagged sword appeared.
Black Fang’s eyes narrowed, raising a defense immediately.

The sword moved, and before the defense could fully materialize, it slipped through it and lunged at his neck. Black Fang moved back and evaded. However, just when he did, Inaya appeared behind him and attacked, a large cut appearing on Black Fang’s lower body.
She drew first blood, and with it, the battle that would announce the return of the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme had started.
