chapters.title: Chapter 1579: Ascension Of The Ten Emotion’s Sword Supreme (3)
paragraphs: Many had only heard stories of the legend of the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme. In those stories, she was always compared to Lord Genesis.
Many saw that as plain silliness and unfair treatment, one that wasn’t needed, not when one of them went ahead to reach the peak, and the other didn’t.
However, to be measured against someone like Lord Genesis, it might mean that the person in question was no simple person.
Naturally, as everyone watched Inaya battle the Tiger Beast, they all could tell that perhaps the stories didn’t do her justice enough.
Her figure blurred and appeared three meters away from Black Fang.

Her sword moved with a precise arc, one that caused the air to tremble. Just as the sword arc was about to land on the tiger, however, it moved, turning into pure darkness, allowing the sword arc to pass through its intangible form.
The moment the sword arc passed, it reformed, and its tail whipped through the air, followed by a claw strike.
Three arcs shot toward Inaya with deadly intent.
She retreated and, using her left hand, formed a seal while striking with her right hand. The arcs were severed completely, and in their place, a blue energy burned in the air.
As for the tail attack, Inaya evaded and moved further back.

It had already been four hours since the battle started, but aside from the first cut Inaya landed, she hadn’t had any opportunity to leave a wound of that magnitude again. Even so, she had held on quite steadily, her expression calm as the battle raged on.
A few more hours passed, and aside from constant roars and sword flashes, nobody seemed to be on the winning side. That was until the twelfth hour came.
Inaya distanced herself from the tiger and paused, her gaze narrowing at its sheer mountainous bulk. The tiger also seemed to have had enough, so it moved back and also gazed at Inaya.

"I have to give it to you, human. You have lasted longer than I had hoped, even succeeding in injuring me. However, your moment of reign is over. The next move I will make will be the end of the battle."
Already, people were fascinated by how fierce the battle was, yet none came close to dying. Hearing the tiger speak, they both could tell the end of the battle was here.
Inaya smiled behind her mask and used her finger to trace along the blade of her sword.

"It had been billions of years since I last touched my sword. Though I am still the same person who cultivated the Ten Emotions Sword Dao, I have to say that my brilliance had died down after years of not wielding my sword." The smile on her face bloomed behind the red mask.
"However, while I hadn’t touched my sword for a very long time can be deemed my disadvantage, I see it as the best decision I have ever made."
Through the sockets of the mask, a red eye flashed, causing waves of energy filled with wrath to descend on the battlefield.
"You know, Lord Genesis once told me, to cultivate emotion is to experience it first. I never truly understood it until I experienced true wrath. Today, allow me to show you what wrath looks like."

Just when she said that, the space behind her turned red, and boom, black flames ignited in the air. The flames rose high into the air and formed a large mask, one that caused many to step back despite the danger not being directed at them.
Black Fang, who stood proudly, suddenly felt a sense of danger. Black mist formed around his body, and soon, a silver armor materialized, his eyes narrowing at Inaya.
Just when the danger in the air reached its climax, the air stopped moving, and all sound was swallowed.
Then Inaya muttered coldly and swung her sword.
"Wrath: Hellscar Annihilation."
The skull dissolved into her sword, and when she unleashed the attack, a wide arc that cut apart the void was unleashed.
Black Fang roared and mounted a five-layered defense, its previous confidence wiped from its eyes, mind, and soul. Right now, the black sword arc coming was the priority.
Standing on the ground 200 meters from the tribulation ground, Baldy shook his bald head and smiled.
"Futile."
Just when everyone thought the sword arc would be held back by the five-layered defense, something very shocking happened.

The moment the attack touched the defense, it cut it in half like a sharp knife through thin paper. The other layers were the same. The sword arc moved through them, and in what felt like a flash of a second, a large tiger head flew into the air.
Gasps and shock spread among the onlookers, everyone’s backs breaking into a cold sweat.
"What was that?" many wondered, some even looking toward some of the renowned swordsmen around. However, watching the stunned looks on their faces, they realized that even they didn’t know.
In fact, of everyone gathered around, only one person knew what had happened.

Baldy smiled weakly. "Looks like master is going to have a competition this time. To think Lady Inaya had already mastered True Qi and had even brushed the surface of Absolute Qi. Hehe... master is going to be struck dumb when he learns this."
Kent had already mastered True Qi (true sword energy) and was tasked with mastering absolute sword energy before he could ascend to the Sword Divine stage.
To think Inaya had already glimpsed that realm, if the Sword Council learned of this, she would become their priority.

Just when the tiger was falling from the air, the figure who appeared when Inaya invoked the Beast God Trial waved their hand, and both the body and the severed head turned into misty energy and flew into Inaya’s forehead.
Since she had defeated her opponent, as per the rule, he became her contracted beast.

She looked up and stared at the second banner. This one is green and has a serpent’s head on it. Knowing it wouldn’t be for another 12 hours before that one activated, she tapped into her space ring and retrieved a pill and swallowed it.
She sat in a lotus posture and waited for the second trial. Already, she felt like she had taken a step into the realm of Supremacy after defeating the Black Fang Demon Tiger King.𝙛𝓻𝒆𝓮𝒘𝙚𝙗𝒏𝙤𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝓬𝒐𝙢
With that step, she could also feel her strength rise by leaps and bounds.
If she can take on the second beast and win, then there is no telling just how much stronger she would become.
Twelve hours later, a large green serpent with scales that shimmered like a galaxy came from the second banner and hovered in the air, its gaze aimed at Inaya.
During the Primordial Era, his humanoid name was Tharos, the Azure Scale Void Serpent. It once fought against the Flame King and lost only after the Flame King used a secret bloodline art.
Today, as he gazed at his opponent, calm could be seen in his void-like eyes.
"I suppose the trial of the Beast God still stands," he asked, his voice sounding distant, almost as if the void kept swallowing his words.
"That is right."
"Good."
The next second, Tharos vanished from sight, and the void exploded open.

chapters.title: Chapter 1580: Ascension Of The Ten Emotion’s Sword Supreme (4)
paragraphs: The Azure Scale Void Serpent was one of the most dangerous god beasts to ever wield the energy of the void during the Primordial Era. Back then, there were only a few beasts who could contend with him in the aspect of Void Mastery.
One of them was the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
Because of this, his respect for Chaos was on another level. It was even said that, at one point during the Primordial Era, he studied under the Chaos Dragon.
In fact, regardless of whether or not he studied under the Chaos Dragon, the fact that he fought side by side with him during the great war shows the kind of beast he is.
Legends even have it that the Primordial and Great Records contain accounts of legendary beings who lived during the Primordial Era, and that his name is among them.

Many don’t recognize the kind of legend Inaya had found herself locked in battle against at the moment. If they knew, perhaps they would have seen Inaya in a new light, for there is just no telling what kind of talent one needed to be able to contend with a beast whose entire existence is linked to the void.
Her understanding of the sword is indeed deep.

After five hours locked in fierce battle, the two of them paused, and under everyone’s stunned gaze, Tharos transformed into his humanoid form, taking on the appearance of a 6’4 slightly muscular man with short dark hair and a void tattoo on his forehead.
It was when he turned human that many realized he was a Peak-Level Early Supreme.
This left some of the Real and True Supremes wondering whether they would have survived an hour against Tharos.
Their shock, however, had just begun.
Tharos took a deep breath and regarded Inaya, his gaze focused on the grey mask on her face.
"The energy of despair," he muttered, his eyes narrowing a bit. "This is my first time seeing someone wield despair as sword intent."
Inaya smiled behind her mask. "There is a first time for everything."
Against the first beast, Black Fang, she used Wrath, but against Tharos, she is using Despair.

The reason for this decision was because of the void-like nature of the Despair Sword Dao. Going against someone who had mastered the void to the point they could become one with it means she must also have a way to mitigate that boon.
Thankfully, the Sword Dao of Despair helped her.
Tharos nodded at her reply. "I suppose you can say that. As you live and experience many things, you are bound to meet those who don’t make sense. I met a few in my days, but one of them stood out."
"The Primordial Chaos Dragon," Inaya said, knowing full well where Tharos was going with his words.

She had already had a heart-to-heart conversation with Kent before he left for the Star Gateway mission. When Kent told her to use his name to invoke the Beast God Trial, she knew people would wonder and want to know where she got his permission from.𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮
When she asked what she should say, Kent smiled and said:
"Just tell them I am back and that you met me. Already, forming my Chaos Heart had drawn the attention of many, so hiding my rebirth is of no use. Of course, don’t tell them who I am and where I am."
"What if they threaten me?"
Kent chuckled. "If they threaten you, then you have my permission to use my name as many times as you want until I run out of energy. But for my soul’s sake, only use it eight times."

"I only have a question, and depending on your answer, the outcome of this battle will be determined. Also, before you feel overconfident, know that just like how Black Fang used only 25% of his full strength, I’ve also done the same. But that can change soon depending on your answer.."
Hearing his words, many sucked in a deep breath, wondering whether he was merely bragging or if the power he had shown over the past five hours was indeed only 25% of his total strength.
Inaya willed the mask of Despair to vanish from her face and smiled.

"No need to bother, senior. I know you want to ask where I got the permission to use the Primordial Chaos Dragon’s name from." She paused and scanned the entire environment, now filled with thousands of powerhouses, some already at the peak of the Celestial stage.
Clearly, judging by the looks on their faces, they all wanted to hear what she was about to say.
The Chaos Dragon is an idol to every living soul. His sacrifice gave the universe a second chance, so they all wanted to know where she got his permission from.
"Actually, the truth of the matter is, the Primordial Chaos Dragon is still alive, and I am his disciple."
"WHAT?!"
Gasps spread everywhere, many feeling their bodies tremble with sheer delight.
"T-the Primordial Chaos Dragon is alive."
"The Primordial Chaos Dragon is alive!"
Cheers followed, and before long, many started spreading the word. The Chaos Dragon is alive, and the fact that Inaya confirmed it was enough to tell that it is indeed true.
The Supremes and Celestials who came with nefarious reasons took a step back, some even wiping the insidious ideas they came with from their minds.
If Inaya is indeed the disciple of the Primordial Chaos Dragon, then going against her is akin to going against that monster. Anyone who had ever crossed him during the Primordial Era felt his wrath.
So staying away from her was the only logical thing to do.
Of course, there are those who just can’t take a hint.

On the ground, Vexthra gave Inaya a thumbs-up. She knew Inaya lied just so she could protect herself from the bad guys. Attacking Chaos’s disciple is just plain stupidity bundled in a cloth of craziness.
Tharos stood there for a few minutes, his gaze never leaving Inaya. After he had stared enough, he took a deep breath and slowly bowed.
"In that case, I accept defeat."
A wise man once said, "It is better to accept greatness when it is being offered than to stupidly try to prove yourself when greatness is free."
By becoming Inaya’s contracted beast, he would be one step closer to meeting Chaos again. That is what a smart person does, and Inaya knew that, so she didn’t argue.
"I accept your defeat and restraint during the battle."

Tharos smiled. "It wasn’t my doing, my lady. But invoking the name of the Primordial Chaos Dragon, you had inadvertently made it so we all can use just 25% of our power. I was merely bluffing when I said I would use my full strength later."
Inaya nodded, but inwardly she finally understood why Kent wore that shameless smile when he told her to invoke his name during her tribulation.
’Ah, why do I always fall for the shameless ones... well, he is the same person, so... ahhh, what am I even thinking about?’

Struggling to pull her mind back, she watched as a green rune flew from Tharos and merged with her forehead. She was about to send Tharos into her soul sea when the five remaining banners trembled and expanded, each forming a portal.
Soon, five legendary Primordial Beasts appeared, each carrying an aura that left many wondering if they were indeed using just 25% of their total power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1581: End of Tribulation
paragraphs: If only the powerhouses gathered on planet Brymrr knew they were in the presence of legendary beasts, perhaps all of them, regardless of their cultivation, would be on their knees, bowing to their majestic selves.
Celestial Bjok and a few who had heard of some of these beasts were all left with their jaws hanging loose as they gazed at the line-up now facing Inaya.
Nobody knew why all five remaining beasts appeared when the rule stated that a new beast would come once every 24 hours.
All five of them appearing at the same time wasn’t part of the rules.
However, as they appeared and assumed their humanoid forms, one could tell something significant was about to happen.

If the rules were followed, then the beast to come after Tharos was the Violet Wing Storm Roc, one of the fastest beasts in the sky. In the Great Records, they said that during the Great War, her speed rivaled Celestial-level Void Beasts.

Her self-created skill, called [Sky Splitter Dive], is rumored to hold so much power that, at her descent, stars, moons, and even planets can split open, shattering asteroids as if they were made of limestone.

Now, as she stood with purple hair falling down her back, five pairs of metallic angel-type wings, and a refined athletic body, one could only admire her beauty, forgetting that the most attractive thing about her is her speed.
Her personality is cold, embodying the essence of both danger and distance.
Shockingly, as she looked at Inaya, a smile appeared on her beautiful face. Her human name is Zephyra.
Beside her stood perhaps one of the most handsome men in the universe.
During the Primordial Era, he ruled over an island of lions called the Divine Island. He was respected and revered by many, especially by the beasts he ruled.
They called him the Golden Mane Celestial Lion, and among humans, he was known as Lios. Because he stayed away from battles and chose to live a life of peace, many regarded him as weak.
For years, he was ridiculed and called all kinds of names by his rivals until some became bold and poked the hornet’s nest.
A team of 25 god beasts tried to hunt on his island and ended up killing one of his people.
By the time the Primordial Chaos Dragon reached there, the heads of all 25 gods were hanged on spikes, acting as scarecrows for all who dared come close to his domain.
Since then, nobody has dared to call him weak or look down on him. Today, Lios stood with his hands clasped behind his back, a calm look on his face as he regarded Inaya.
His golden hair and perfect cheekbones made him the center of attention for many women around.
Beside him stood another dangerous beast, the Crimson Shell Flame Tortoise, or as humans called him, Moltros.

The Crimson Shell Flame Tortoise embodied the essence of endurance and defense. His defense rivaled that of even the Primordial Chaos Dragon, and he was also one of the few beasts to become Monarchs during the Primordial Era.

Legend has it that whatever strikes that lands on his ultra-hard, flame-rich shell, it bounces back with ten times the strength. Even if he chose not to fight and decided to lie there, no attacks below the True Supreme stage can penetrate his defense.
Moltros had now transformed into a muscular, shirtless man with reddish, metallic skin, the kind that shows the defensive monster he is.
Standing beside him are the legendary White Horn Moon Kirin and Shadow Talon Chaos Qilin.
Many called them twins, for as far as one could remember, they had been together, despite one being a unicorn and the other a Qilin.

Nareth was the unicorn who wielded control over Ice, Light, and Time. The records describe her as a support-type warrior, for they say she can speed up time to see the next few seconds, paving the way for Xarion, known for his control over Chaos and Destruction, to do his thing.
They were the dynamic duo, the kind of beasts you want on your side, not against you.
Nareth has long hair and a beautiful body, while Xarion has bluish-purple hair and a handsome appearance.

Among all seven beasts, Xarion was the strongest of them since he was already at the Peak-Level True Supreme stage. But even with that power, as he took a step forward, a smile could be seen on his face.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚

"The first time I saw him, he was locked in battle with a Celestial-stage Forbidden King. From the start to the end of the battle, he dominated the Forbidden King until he killed him," Xarion smiled...
"As someone who wields the power of Chaos, I saw him as my mentor, and so I followed him around until the day he noticed me and, to my shock, approached me.
That encounter changed my life for good and also awakened a sense of respect that I, Xarion, would honor one day." He turned and looked at his friend, or more like a twin, Nareth, before adding.

"I am saying all this simply because my sister Nareth has the power to tell when someone is lying. If what you had said now was a lie, I would have killed you in a heartbeat, for I would not allow anyone to tarnish the image of Lord Chaos." He grinned, causing Inaya to feel her legs grow weak.
"Luckily for you, what you said wasn’t a lie, meaning you had indeed met Lord Chaos and even became his disciple."
Nareth stepped in. "The disciple part can be debated later. However, I have reasons to believe you share a close relationship with Lord Chaos, so all five of us decided to make things short for you."
Lios’s smile caused his already handsome appearance to glow. "Since you are Lord Chaos’s disciple, we have no reason to judge your worth. You qualify to become a Supreme, so accept our defeat."
All five of them bowed, and with that, the tribulation came to an end. However, despite the tribulation cloud receding, no one present said a single word.
What they came there to witness didn’t happen; rather, something even more shocking happened.
First, it was made known that Lord Chaos is back and that he shared a close bond with the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme.

Second, seven legendary beasts from the Primordial Era became contracted beasts of the one they were meant to challenge. Not once in the history of tribulations had something this wondrous ever happened.

But as everyone gazed at the six beasts standing before Inaya, the tribulation cloud and the humanoid silhouette now gone, it became clear that she had indeed become the master of this legendary figure.
"Hahahahaha..." Suddenly, a loud laughter came from the clouds, followed by a voice only a few recognized. "What a spectacle. To think I would witness something this unexpected."
A man with flowing black hair appeared from the clouds, seated inside a wooden-like throne. Behind him, the concept of a garden was visible, spreading and commanding absolute respect.
When many set eyes on this Celestial, their expressions changed. Most of the Supremes and Celestials bowed their heads.
"We greet the Garden Master."

Seated in his chair, a smile appeared on his face, and he nodded at how well he was received. He turned and looked at Inaya, then at the six beasts, and was about to speak when the sky suddenly turned red.
"Oh, looks like I made it here on time..." A different voice was heard, and everyone tensed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1582: Universe Monsters
paragraphs: The arrival of the one Celestial was well within expectations. The Garden Master was one of the few people who personally knew Lord Genesis and, by extension, knew Inaya.
In fact, he was once a disciple of the Whispering Wind Sword Sect when Inaya was the sect master. So his appearance could be taken lightly.
However, the second arrival was what made many frown, some turning pale.
A terrible pressure filled with blood and killing intent descended on everyone, causing even some Celestials to grit their teeth.
"Sangreos, what are you doing on this side of the Universe?" the Garden Master asked, a frown appearing on his otherwise handsome face.
"Hahahahahaha, Matthew, what makes you think I can’t come here when clearly something historic is happening? All you think I will miss the rebirth of the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme."

At the mention of Inaya’s title, a crimson river tore from the clouds and descended on the planet, causing it to tremble. Had it not been for the Garden Master anticipating this and already taking measures, millions would have died.
From the clouds, a man with black hair streaked with deep crimson descended. He has pale skin with veins that glow visibly beneath it.
His eyes are made of liquid rubies, dripping faint blood tears. As he descended, many instinctively took steps back, some moving to hide behind the Garden Master.

When the 100th Elder of the Soul Temple appears, nobody needs to be told to run. So they ran, and now, as they hid behind the Garden Master, the killing intent filling the place seemed to have receded a little.
Sangreos, or as many called him, the Crimson Sovereign of Eternal Veins, turned and looked at Inaya with a twisted smile.
Xarion stepped forward, shielding Inaya from the danger. His expression narrowed, but he said nothing to the Celestial, whom, deep down, everyone present knew was the strongest currently present.

Even the Garden Master had to acknowledge the strength of one of the 1000 elders of the Soul Temple. He ranked 200th, and he is a Celestial King. One can only wonder how strong the master of the Soul Temple would be.
"Isn’t it funny how we all seem to have ended up at the same place?" Celestial Sangreos said, his twisted smile widening. Looking past Xarion, his gaze landed on Inaya.

"The last time we met, you and that monster killed my brother and best friend, leaving me to die in that godforsaken den. Now, look at me, living the best time of my life, and you are about to die before you have the chance to even form your Supreme Platform."
The six supreme beasts standing before Inaya unleashed their aura, every last one of them ready to fight to the death. As long as Inaya is alive, even if they die, they can be brought back.
"Stay behind me, my Lady," Moltros said, his defense already activated. Being the one with the strongest defense, his duty would be to protect Inaya with his life.
"How funny. It appears the Heavens Faction has been so peaceful that now mere Supremes think they can contend against a Celestial."
Celestial Sangreos laughed and turned to the Garden Master. "Haven’t you told them what happened the last time we fought?"
BOOOM

The Garden Master stood up, and his aura exploded, pushing back the red aura that had appeared in the air. "Becareful, Sangreos, you are far from home, so tread carefully, else it won’t end well for you."
"Very confident of you, Matthew. However, we both know killing me is impossible, not when there is blood running through everyone’s veins here."
"What if you don’t have blood but ice?" Before the Garden Master could reply, a lady spoke, and the temperature suddenly dropped.
A large bluish star appeared and enlarged, taking up a vast space. Then, from within, a beauty with blue hair and an hourglass shape walked out, her expression cold like ice.
In her hand is a staff made of a mystical material found only in the Celestial realm.𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
"What if there is no blood running through my body but ice?"
"I never expected the Azure Star Sovereign to also make an appearance here," Sangreos remarked, his expression shifting from delight to caution.
While before the Garden Master, he seemed relaxed and even arrogant, the person who had appeared was someone he could not mess around with.
The cold look on the Azure Star Sovereign’s face broke as a pale smile appeared, illuminating her beauty. "A bit bold of you to come all the way here without backup, don’t you think?"
Sangreos didn’t respond; instead, he looked at Inaya and smirked. "Knowing you are back fills me with joy. Now, I will do everything in my power to ensure you don’t live to see another day."
"Hahahahaha, the exact same words I wanted to say," another voice filled the space, followed by lightning infused with killing intent.
The lightning surge caused many to block their ears and close their eyes. Just looking at it was like staring death in the face.
BOOOM

A bolt tore from the sky and crashed down, raising dust into the air. When the dust settled, a green-haired, three-eyed man holding a metallic fan was revealed, and the air in the space suddenly turned electric.
All three Celestials recognized the new arrival, and so did many others.
Obviously, seeing nobody smile was a clear indication that this person is no good news.
"Rueno, what are you doing here?" the Azure Star Sovereign asked, ice radiating from her form, her hold on her staff tightening.

The reason for this apprehension was that the new arrival is someone she can’t even fight. Rueno attained Celestialhood during the Dark Era and had joined the Universe Council for the better part of the next few eras.

However, after a lady he had taken a fancy to died in a battle against a Primordial Beast that mysteriously appeared on a planet she was living on, he became cold, and over the last billion years, he started walking the dark path, using the pain and suffering of others to temper his killing intent.
Wherever he appears, pain and suffering follow.
Today, his presence clearly meant something bad would soon be going down.

"Relax, Xuane, I am here to kill these primordial beasts. As for the lady, I will leave her to Sangreos." He paused and narrowed his green eyes at the Azure Star Sovereign and added, "Of course, if you try to be a hero, I will have no choice but to permanently disfigure your face."
SLAP
Before anyone could process the threat Celestial Rueno threw at the Azure Star Sovereign, a slap from a very small hand landed on his face, sending him crashing down.

In his place, a bald kid holding candy straws stood, his expression filled with anger. "You four are very chatty. Right now, my big sister is about to form her Supreme Platform, so if you don’t want trouble, stand on the side and watch or leave."
Baldy’s eyes flashed with cold sharpness. "If not, I would be forced to put you down... permanently."
His words dropped on everyone’s heart like cold steel.
As his words hung in the air, a clapping sound came from an ordinary-looking man seated on a large sword. Everyone, including Baldy, turned to look at the person who had clapped.
"Big Brother..."
Under everyone’s stunned gaze, the brat who dared to slap a Celestial King teleported and dived into the arms of the ordinary-looking man.
On the ground, Celestial Rueno, with a tiny handprint on his cheek, stood up and channeled his energy, killing intent surging from his form.

"Sangreos, what are you doing on this side of the Universe?" the Garden Master asked, a frown appearing on his otherwise handsome face.
"Hahahahahaha, Matthew, what makes you think I can’t come here when clearly something historic is happening?
All you think I will miss the rebirth of the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme."
At the mention of Inaya’s title, a crimson river tore from the clouds and descended on the planet, causing it to tremble.
Had it not been for the Garden Master anticipating this and already taking measures, millions would have died.
From the clouds, a man with black hair streaked with deep crimson descended.
He has pale skin with veins that glow visibly beneath it.
His eyes are made of liquid rubies, dripping faint blood tears.
As he descended, many instinctively took steps back, some moving to hide behind the Garden Master.
When the 100th Elder of the Soul Temple appears, nobody needs to be told to run.
So they ran, and now, as they hid behind the Garden Master, the killing intent filling the place seemed to have receded a little.
Sangreos, or as many called him, the Crimson Sovereign of Eternal Veins, turned and looked at Inaya with a twisted smile.
Xarion stepped forward, shielding Inaya from the danger.
His expression narrowed, but he said nothing to the Celestial, whom, deep down, everyone present knew was the strongest currently present.
Even the Garden Master had to acknowledge the strength of one of the 1000 elders of the Soul Temple.
He ranked 200th, and he is a Celestial King.
One can only wonder how strong the master of the Soul Temple would be.
"Isn’t it funny how we all seem to have ended up at the same place?" Celestial Sangreos said, his twisted smile widening.
Looking past Xarion, his gaze landed on Inaya.
"The last time we met, you and that monster killed my brother and best friend, leaving me to die in that godforsaken den.
Now, look at me, living the best time of my life, and you are about to die before you have the chance to even form your Supreme Platform."
The six supreme beasts standing before Inaya unleashed their aura, every last one of them ready to fight to the death.
As long as Inaya is alive, even if they die, they can be brought back.
"Stay behind me, my Lady," Moltros said, his defense already activated.
Being the one with the strongest defense, his duty would be to protect Inaya with his life.
"How funny.
It appears the Heavens Faction has been so peaceful that now mere Supremes think they can contend against a Celestial."
Celestial Sangreos laughed and turned to the Garden Master.
"Haven’t you told them what happened the last time we fought?"
BOOOM
The Garden Master stood up, and his aura exploded, pushing back the red aura that had appeared in the air.
"Becareful, Sangreos, you are far from home, so tread carefully, else it won’t end well for you."
"Very confident of you, Matthew.
However, we both know killing me is impossible, not when there is blood running through everyone’s veins here."
"What if you don’t have blood but ice?" Before the Garden Master could reply, a lady spoke, and the temperature suddenly dropped.
A large bluish star appeared and enlarged, taking up a vast space.
Then, from within, a beauty with blue hair and an hourglass shape walked out, her expression cold like ice.
In her hand is a staff made of a mystical material found only in the Celestial realm.𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
"What if there is no blood running through my body but ice?"
"I never expected the Azure Star Sovereign to also make an appearance here," Sangreos remarked, his expression shifting from delight to caution.
While before the Garden Master, he seemed relaxed and even arrogant, the person who had appeared was someone he could not mess around with.
The cold look on the Azure Star Sovereign’s face broke as a pale smile appeared, illuminating her beauty.
"A bit bold of you to come all the way here without backup, don’t you think?"
Sangreos didn’t respond; instead, he looked at Inaya and smirked.
"Knowing you are back fills me with joy.
Now, I will do everything in my power to ensure you don’t live to see another day."
"Hahahahaha, the exact same words I wanted to say," another voice filled the space, followed by lightning infused with killing intent.
The lightning surge caused many to block their ears and close their eyes.
Just looking at it was like staring death in the face.
BOOOM
A bolt tore from the sky and crashed down, raising dust into the air.
When the dust settled, a green-haired, three-eyed man holding a metallic fan was revealed, and the air in the space suddenly turned electric.
All three Celestials recognized the new arrival, and so did many others.
Obviously, seeing nobody smile was a clear indication that this person is no good news.
"Rueno, what are you doing here?" the Azure Star Sovereign asked, ice radiating from her form, her hold on her staff tightening.
The reason for this apprehension was that the new arrival is someone she can’t even fight.
Rueno attained Celestialhood during the Dark Era and had joined the Universe Council for the better part of the next few eras.

However, after a lady he had taken a fancy to died in a battle against a Primordial Beast that mysteriously appeared on a planet she was living on, he became cold, and over the last billion years, he started walking the dark path, using the pain and suffering of others to temper his killing intent.
Wherever he appears, pain and suffering follow.
Today, his presence clearly meant something bad would soon be going down.
"Relax, Xuane, I am here to kill these primordial beasts.

As for the lady, I will leave her to Sangreos." He paused and narrowed his green eyes at the Azure Star Sovereign and added, "Of course, if you try to be a hero, I will have no choice but to permanently disfigure your face."
SLAP
Before anyone could process the threat Celestial Rueno threw at the Azure Star Sovereign, a slap from a very small hand landed on his face, sending him crashing down.
In his place, a bald kid holding candy straws stood, his expression filled with anger.
"You four are very chatty.
Right now, my big sister is about to form her Supreme Platform, so if you don’t want trouble, stand on the side and watch or leave."
Baldy’s eyes flashed with cold sharpness.
"If not, I would be forced to put you down... permanently."
His words dropped on everyone’s heart like cold steel.
As his words hung in the air, a clapping sound came from an ordinary-looking man seated on a large sword.
Everyone, including Baldy, turned to look at the person who had clapped.
"Big Brother..."
Under everyone’s stunned gaze, the brat who dared to slap a Celestial King teleported and dived into the arms of the ordinary-looking man.
On the ground, Celestial Rueno, with a tiny handprint on his cheek, stood up and channeled his energy, killing intent surging from his form.

chapters.title: Chapter 1583: Baldy’s Big Brother
paragraphs: From how the slap came to how it ended, everyone wondered just who the bald kid is. There was no Celestial energy around him, so they couldn’t tell if he was also a Celestial King or even higher.

However, to succeed in slapping a Celestial and even leaving a handprint, all four Celestial Kings—Rueno included—felt some sense of danger as they watched Baldy dive into the ordinary-looking man’s arms.
A few gods who were present when Baldy appeared and saved Kent months ago recognized him. However, they did not expect the bald kid to be this brave.
Baldy rested his head on the man’s chest, a smile on his face.
The ordinary-looking man wore a smile, a clear sign that he was happy to meet Baldy. He patted the kid on the back.

"Big brother, I miss you so much," Baldy said, pulling his head back. "Where have you been all these years? I learned you appeared during the Flame Era briefly; after that, nobody ever saw you again. Where did you go?"
The ordinary-looking man smiled and brushed Baldy’s head. "I have been here and there, experiencing the life of mortals over and over again."
Baldy said nothing; that was because he sensed a killing intent directed at him. Turning around, he pointed up and muttered, "Cleaving the Heavens and Earth."
With a simple slash of his finger, a sword arc separated the clouds and descended on Celestial Rueno, whose expression grew tense in an instant.
Without hesitating, he slapped his bag of holding, and a red scale appeared. Pouring his energy into it, he made it float over his head and expand.
BANG
The sword arc slammed onto the red scale, sending Celestial Trueno to drop to his knees, his left arm shattering.
Gasps spread all over the place.

Inaya and her sisters felt like they had underestimated Baldy. While it was perfectly normal for them to assume he wasn’t strong enough to face a Celestial King, now that he had shown his power, they finally realized the kind of monster Kent left behind to protect them.𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮
As the sword arc dissipated, a ragged Celestial was revealed, his clothes torn in more than one place.
"I know all four of you are here with motives. While I wouldn’t care much about that, I am under strict orders from my Big Brother to protect Big Sister, so go back and come when my master returns.
Trust me, taking a step back now would be the most logical decision any of you would ever make. But then again, you can try your luck and see if you won’t end up more miserable than him."
The three Celestials said nothing, but the look on their faces made it clear they had taken Baldy’s offer. They wouldn’t want to throw their lives away.
As Celestials, they had gone through Early Celestial, True Celestial, and Celestial King, yet they had never met a monster like this kid.
In fact, in their honest opinion, even a Celestial Emperor or Celestial Monarch would find it hard to contend against this bald kid.

"As my little brother said, it would be good to take a step back. Our big brother would not take kindly to any of you if he returned and found out you four made it so Big Sister Inaya didn’t have a smooth ascension."
The ordinary-looking man stood up and lifted Baldy onto his shoulder. The sword he sat on transformed into a mist of energy and merged with his body.
Perhaps to make everyone aware of the danger they were in, he allowed them to sense a wisp of the energy as it merged with his body.
"Sword Will."
"He is a Sword Celestial."

Shock filled the place as many finally understood where the danger was coming from. It wasn’t that Baldy and the ordinary-looking man were weak; it was more like they were too strong for anyone to sense their power.
At least, that was what they all thought when, in fact, calling the ordinary-looking man a Sword Celestial was actually downgrading him, to say the least.
If a True Sword Celestial were to appear now, they would tremble in sheer terror, for the man is no simple person.
"Big Brother Han, create a formation for Big Sister to form her Supreme Platform," Baldy said, and Han nodded. He took one step forward and appeared only a few meters from Inaya.
"Pleasantries later. For now, let’s make sure you become a Supreme."
Inaya nodded and sat down. She had seen enough to know she was in good hands.

Baldy jumped down from Han’s shoulder and glared at the Celestials, and a few others he suspected were there to cause trouble. In his eyes, even if ten more Celestial Kings were to appear, with his brother around, nothing would happen to Inaya.
Vexthra and her sisters moved to Inaya’s side. Now that they did not have to worry anymore, Vexthra knew she had to be extra careful, too.
The last thing she wanted was someone slipping their intent into Inaya’s soul sea during the critical phase of her cultivation.

If she had to guess, the motive some of the Celestials came with had to do with the seven primordial beasts she had contracted. They wanted to hold her Supreme Platform hostage as a way to pressure her to give them up.
However, now that Han and Baldy were standing guard, they had nothing to worry about.
"Are you ready?" Vexthra asked, holding a triangular-shaped item.
"I am ready."

She nodded and retrieved a green stone from her space ring. "This is a Dao Stone. I planned to use it when becoming a Supreme; however, it is not needed now. You can have it." She handed the stone to Inaya, who didn’t argue and received it.
It would be weird if she rejected such a gift. If she used it well, she might just gain insight into her ten emotions.
"My Supreme Platform was 100,000 km wide and had five layers. If yours is not at least three times mine, I will be very angry, Inaya," Ainna said, giving her friend and sworn sister a hug.
"I will do my best," Inaya smiled and returned the hug.
"Don’t worry, Master, we will share our Dao insight with you. It would help you see much deeper into the Dao and make good use of the Dao Stone in your possession."

Because Black Fang wasn’t around, since he was reforming inside Inaya’s soul sea, the six Supreme Beasts formed hand seals, and six concepts of the Dao moved from their foreheads and merged with Inaya’s.
"Thank you, guys. I will be sure to live up to your expectations." They all nodded with smiles.

Han pointed his finger up, and a formation materialized over Inaya’s head. "This is a Tier 98 formation. Unless ten Celestial Supremes attack it at the same time a thousand times, not even a crack would form in it."
Inaya nodded and closed her eyes.
Han smiled. ’Absolute Intent, huh. Looks like there is someone capable of achieving that in this universe,’ he thought to himself, feeling a familiar energy inside Inaya’s body.

As someone born from a strand of Eternal Sword Intent, his understanding of every aspect of the sword is absolute. Baldy failed to tell Kent that he, too, can use Absolute Sword Energy. If he did, Kent would have trouble teaching him.
However, Baldy believes his big brother has what it takes to accomplish that on his own.
BOOM
A minute after Inaya started the Supreme Platform formation process, a powerful energy burst out from her body, and a ten-colored sword dao concept appeared behind her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1584: Tower’s Upgrade + Big Reveal
paragraphs: [Skull City - 60 days later]
While barely 6 days had passed in the outside world, inside the Star Realm, 60 days had already passed.
It had also been 60 days since the Tower had entered upgrade mode.
After Kent had recovered his memories of the Ruthless Bandit, something within him started to awaken, prompting a sudden upgrade of the tower.
While before entering the star gateway, the Tower had stolen some of the soul essence to undergo a partial upgrade, this time, things were different.
This upgrade differs from the previous ones because it wasn’t scheduled, unlike when the Tower said her complete upgrade after the partial one would happen when Kent ascends and becomes an immortal.
This upgrade had to do with something neither Kent nor the Tower had any idea of.
Even the cosmic beings keeping tabs on him had no idea where this upgrade came from.
All knew was that when this upgrade was done, the Tower would become something else entirely.

Kent may have become emotionless because his personality had turned evil after he absorbed the Ruthless Bandit’s memories, but even he was looking forward to when the Tower successfully completed her upgrade.
While he was waiting, he kept tabs on all of the Thal’Khangs, formerly known as Velkharians, who had seriously taken the offer he gave them.
Every able-bodied man ventured into the Gate of Evil to try their luck and see if they could get the Mark of Evil and become a warrior under the Evil King.
It was their dream to become devoted followers of the evil king.
At first, Kent wore a sneer, since in his eyes, all of them were weaklings.

Recovering the Ruthless Bandit’s memories and turning him arrogant. Unfortunately, he is a dragon, so arrogance came naturally to him. Even so, adding the coldness of the Ruthless Bandit to that arrogance had worsened everything.
So he expected nothing from them.
However, despite his initial view of them, that changed on the 10th day when one of the first to enter the gate of evil succeeded.
His shock came when the first person succeeded; he felt a part of his power rise. It was a small rise, but it became more shocking as more people started to succeed in acquiring the Mark of Evil.
By the 40th day, over 700,000 out of the 3.5 million who entered had succeeded.
By then, Kent felt like he had become a monster in human clothing. Even now, more keep succeeding, and with every success, his strength increases.

He could only wait and see what happens after the Tower succeeds in her upgrade, and he finally assimilates his personality and fully integrates his strength before breaking through to the Immortal stage.

One thing, however, is certain: after this seclusion, Kent would have nothing to worry about when he goes against average Immortals. His current strength puts him against monsters that just dont make sense, like the demigod he would be facing soon.
Thankfully, 60 days later, the moment he had been waiting for came.
[Time Left for Tower Upgrade: 5 minutes]

Kent took a deep breath and waited. Eventually, the time came, and just when it did, he felt his mind go blank for a moment. Then, as if a dam had burst, unknown information started pouring into his mind.
In less than five seconds, Kent felt like his mind had expanded endlessly, yet every part of it was now filled with so much information he just couldn’t bring himself to comprehend.
He did, however, decipher some, and what he saw was just too mind-bending.
He saw how the tower was created.
Where she originated from.
Who created her?
These three pieces of information got him thinking about just what kind of existence the tower is.
However, he never got the chance to think about it since, before he could digest it, something else entered his mind, causing him to blink a few times, shock riddling his face.
’Origin of the True Primordials’

Kent tried to open this knowledge, but he was soon overwhelmed with other memories. It was like there was no shape to how the knowledge was coming. At one point, this would surface, like how to forge a dagger, and the next, how to swing a sword, would add to it.
But one thing was certain about all this, the knowledge he was receiving had nothing to do with his past lives, at least from what he had observed so far.
One could even say the knowledge came from the Universe itself, yet somehow, he could tell it also came from somewhere else.
One thing was certain, though: after this upgrade, he was going to have so much knowledge that even the Celestials at the Cult of Wisdom would appear like bugs before him.
[Three days later]
Three days later, Kent opened his eyes, a sigh escaping his lips.
Just when he did, he felt his soul sea stir.

He quickly sent his mind there, and what he saw when he appeared there made him shudder in fear. In fact, what he saw made him snap his eyes shut for a moment, hoping none of it was true. However, upon opening them, he felt his back break into a cold sweat.

There, standing on the Primal Blood Platform, is a cloaked figure dripping a true evil aura. Kent had seen the Ruthless Bandit several times in his memories, and when he met him before entering the Star Gateway.
However, he had not seen him as a Celestial clad in such a cloak before.
Today he did, and that terrified him. Because of the shock he was in, he failed to see the changes that had happened inside the first Blood Gate or the other changes.
"Well, well, looks like we have had quite the adventure of several lifetimes." Turning slowly, Lex Morvana smiled at Kent.

"This was me the day I died and also the day I awakened true evil," he added, the smile on his face showing genuine happiness, something Kent never knew he could do back when he was the Ruthless Bandit.
He had already seen all of Lex’s memories up to the point he was about to go into the last battle. He never got to see him awaken True Evil, so his shock was genuine as well.
"I am so happy right now."
"Oh, why is that?" Kent asked.
"Because I have been thinking about something my entire life, but only now have I finally had an answer for it." He paused and let a smile spill from the corner of his lips.

"Up until today, I have wondered why I was able to comprehend the True Dao of Evil and succeed when many failed. The laws of this universe prohibit the Dao of Evil from reaching the True stage. They fear that it would cause the universe to fracture and get out of hand, so they tried to kill me several times to stop me.
However, while the thrill of always being at the death’s edge of a weapon or spell sounded promising and felt enticing back then, I never truly understood their intention.
Now, I can tell you that I only managed to cultivate it thanks to something we did in the past."

Lex waved his hand, and a projection appeared before him. Inside the projection, Kent saw thirteen moons, each having a different color. They were arranged in a circle, and at the center rested a golden moon.
Threads from the other moons latched onto it.
"Look at the moon at the center; that is us in a complete form. In other words, the moon at the center is you, the current you in your complete form, and all 13 moons surrounding it are us."
The projection zoomed in on two moons, one black, the other purple.
"The black moon is me, and the purple one, I believe you already know. Now, look closely and tell me what you see."
Kent narrowed his eyes at the projection, and for a moment, he wondered what he was meant to see. Soon, however, he saw it, and that was when his expression changed.
"Impossible..."

Lex Morvana smiled. "Oh, but it is possible. You see, from the start, we have always been one incomplete entity. Somehow, we came about as the ultimate being yet an incomplete one, so we have to make ourselves complete."
Kent stomped on the ground, and a chair formed from blood appeared, allowing him to sit for what Lex was about to say.
"I had always wondered why the universe just couldn’t kill me with its own hands but had to use others. They had already killed many threats in the past, so why couldn’t they touch me?
The answer, however, came from this Thirteen Moon Primal Diagram. I believe this universe is scared of us to the point that it couldn’t bring itself to do anything drastic."
Lex paused and smiled before adding,
"I believe that somewhere out there, our main body, the one you would one day merge back with, is just too monstrous that even the universe doesn’t dare mess with us."
He lifted his head back and let out a resounding laughter, the kind that came from the heart. Kent, however, felt his heart tremble for a moment, causing him to take several breaths.
"Relax, buddy, we have yet to unleash our true power. For now, it is time for you to awaken your true self by merging your evilness with your goodness. I will be on my way for now.
One day, when you are ready for the Key, we will meet again. By then, I expect you to comprehend [Absolute Evil] or even [Extreme Evil]."
The Ruthless Bandit left, and the blood sea surged. Kent sat there, his expression blank.
On the outside, the Tower fed him the [Realm Ascension Pill].

Even so, adding the coldness of the Ruthless Bandit to that arrogance had worsened everything.
So he expected nothing from them.
However, despite his initial view of them, that changed on the 10th day when one of the first to enter the gate of evil succeeded.
His shock came when the first person succeeded; he felt a part of his power rise.
It was a small rise, but it became more shocking as more people started to succeed in acquiring the Mark of Evil.
By the 40th day, over 700,000 out of the 3.5 million who entered had succeeded.
By then, Kent felt like he had become a monster in human clothing.
Even now, more keep succeeding, and with every success, his strength increases.

He could only wait and see what happens after the Tower succeeds in her upgrade, and he finally assimilates his personality and fully integrates his strength before breaking through to the Immortal stage.
One thing, however, is certain: after this seclusion, Kent would have nothing to worry about when he goes against average Immortals.
His current strength puts him against monsters that just dont make sense, like the demigod he would be facing soon.
Thankfully, 60 days later, the moment he had been waiting for came.
[Time Left for Tower Upgrade: 5 minutes]
Kent took a deep breath and waited.
Eventually, the time came, and just when it did, he felt his mind go blank for a moment.
Then, as if a dam had burst, unknown information started pouring into his mind.
In less than five seconds, Kent felt like his mind had expanded endlessly, yet every part of it was now filled with so much information he just couldn’t bring himself to comprehend.
He did, however, decipher some, and what he saw was just too mind-bending.
He saw how the tower was created.
Where she originated from.
Who created her?
These three pieces of information got him thinking about just what kind of existence the tower is.
However, he never got the chance to think about it since, before he could digest it, something else entered his mind, causing him to blink a few times, shock riddling his face.
’Origin of the True Primordials’
Kent tried to open this knowledge, but he was soon overwhelmed with other memories.
It was like there was no shape to how the knowledge was coming.
At one point, this would surface, like how to forge a dagger, and the next, how to swing a sword, would add to it.
But one thing was certain about all this, the knowledge he was receiving had nothing to do with his past lives, at least from what he had observed so far.
One could even say the knowledge came from the Universe itself, yet somehow, he could tell it also came from somewhere else.
One thing was certain, though: after this upgrade, he was going to have so much knowledge that even the Celestials at the Cult of Wisdom would appear like bugs before him.
[Three days later]
Three days later, Kent opened his eyes, a sigh escaping his lips.
Just when he did, he felt his soul sea stir.
He quickly sent his mind there, and what he saw when he appeared there made him shudder in fear.
In fact, what he saw made him snap his eyes shut for a moment, hoping none of it was true.
However, upon opening them, he felt his back break into a cold sweat.
There, standing on the Primal Blood Platform, is a cloaked figure dripping a true evil aura.
Kent had seen the Ruthless Bandit several times in his memories, and when he met him before entering the Star Gateway.
However, he had not seen him as a Celestial clad in such a cloak before.
Today he did, and that terrified him.
Because of the shock he was in, he failed to see the changes that had happened inside the first Blood Gate or the other changes.
"Well, well, looks like we have had quite the adventure of several lifetimes." Turning slowly, Lex Morvana smiled at Kent.

"This was me the day I died and also the day I awakened true evil," he added, the smile on his face showing genuine happiness, something Kent never knew he could do back when he was the Ruthless Bandit.
He had already seen all of Lex’s memories up to the point he was about to go into the last battle.
He never got to see him awaken True Evil, so his shock was genuine as well.
"I am so happy right now."
"Oh, why is that?" Kent asked.
"Because I have been thinking about something my entire life, but only now have I finally had an answer for it." He paused and let a smile spill from the corner of his lips.
"Up until today, I have wondered why I was able to comprehend the True Dao of Evil and succeed when many failed.
The laws of this universe prohibit the Dao of Evil from reaching the True stage.
They fear that it would cause the universe to fracture and get out of hand, so they tried to kill me several times to stop me.
However, while the thrill of always being at the death’s edge of a weapon or spell sounded promising and felt enticing back then, I never truly understood their intention.
Now, I can tell you that I only managed to cultivate it thanks to something we did in the past."
Lex waved his hand, and a projection appeared before him.
Inside the projection, Kent saw thirteen moons, each having a different color.
They were arranged in a circle, and at the center rested a golden moon.
Threads from the other moons latched onto it.
"Look at the moon at the center; that is us in a complete form.
In other words, the moon at the center is you, the current you in your complete form, and all 13 moons surrounding it are us."
The projection zoomed in on two moons, one black, the other purple.
"The black moon is me, and the purple one, I believe you already know.
Now, look closely and tell me what you see."
Kent narrowed his eyes at the projection, and for a moment, he wondered what he was meant to see.
Soon, however, he saw it, and that was when his expression changed.
"Impossible..."
Lex Morvana smiled.
"Oh, but it is possible.
You see, from the start, we have always been one incomplete entity.
Somehow, we came about as the ultimate being yet an incomplete one, so we have to make ourselves complete."
Kent stomped on the ground, and a chair formed from blood appeared, allowing him to sit for what Lex was about to say.
"I had always wondered why the universe just couldn’t kill me with its own hands but had to use others.
They had already killed many threats in the past, so why couldn’t they touch me?
The answer, however, came from this Thirteen Moon Primal Diagram.
I believe this universe is scared of us to the point that it couldn’t bring itself to do anything drastic."
Lex paused and smiled before adding,
"I believe that somewhere out there, our main body, the one you would one day merge back with, is just too monstrous that even the universe doesn’t dare mess with us."
He lifted his head back and let out a resounding laughter, the kind that came from the heart.
Kent, however, felt his heart tremble for a moment, causing him to take several breaths.
"Relax, buddy, we have yet to unleash our true power.
For now, it is time for you to awaken your true self by merging your evilness with your goodness.
I will be on my way for now.
One day, when you are ready for the Key, we will meet again.
By then, I expect you to comprehend [Absolute Evil] or even [Extreme Evil]."
The Ruthless Bandit left, and the blood sea surged.
Kent sat there, his expression blank.
On the outside, the Tower fed him the [Realm Ascension Pill].

chapters.title: Chapter 1585: Leveling Up
paragraphs: Kent had already planned to face this mission across the star gateway with his Heavenly Ascension stage strength. However, when the stakes rose, he had to adapt.
Going against demigods with his Heavenly Ascension stage strength is suicide.
Thankfully, the Realm Ascension Pill came to him when he needed it the most.
As he sat there, both outside and inside his soul sea, the changes were immediate. The air grew thick, filled with an oppressive energy.
The effect of the Realm Ascension pill started to show. His energy grew stronger, and with it, his strength rose.
The first change was that the blood sea within his soul slowly grew denser and, most importantly, vast. It expanded, and from within, mountains rose, shooting up several kilometers.

In no time, his 100,000 km-wide soul sea expanded to 600,000 km. An average person would have a soul sea of the size of 30,000 km to 50,000 km when they move from Tier 19 (Heavenly Ascension) to the Empyrean stage (Tier 20).
Geniuses sometimes go as far as 100,000 km, while prodigies and monsters can even reach 200,000 km to 350,000 km.

The concept is like this: a person with a vast soul sea has more potential and power. Having a vast soul sea contributes to so many things, and Kent might have just become the first person ever to reach a 600,000 km-wide soul sea at the Empyrean stage.
From his memories, Chaos’s was 400,000 km when he went from Tier 19 to Tier 20. Jest (Lord Genesis) was 380,000 km, and the Ruthless Bandit was 450,000 km.
So his soul sea, expanding as far as 600,000 km, was a clear sign that he was no ordinary person.
But that was smaller compared to what happened when he leveled up to the Life stage (Tier 21). His soul sea expanded, covering over 1.5 million km, the blood sea surging with energy.

His entire presence felt as if he were ascending to the God stage. The energy exuding from him and the aura surrounding him were all dense and potent to the point that a True Immortal would collapse before him.
But that didn’t end there. As the Realm Ascension Pill continued to break the limits and push his cultivation up, the Primal Blood Platform inside his soul sea started to expand.

At first, it was a 40,000 km-wide platform. However, when his soul sea started to expand, so did the Primal Blood Platform. When he moved from the Heavenly Ascension stage to the Empyrean stage, it grew vast, expanding to 140,000 km in width.
But that wasn’t the only change.
The Blood Core, Flame Core, Chaos Heart, and Evil Core inside his first core gates started to expand too, making it so he would have to saturate them all over again.
Naturally, Kent had no plans of thinking about that now.
He knew the power contained in the cores is what keeps pushing him toward the Immortal stage, so once they run out, he would have to saturate them if he wants to level up.
His brow knitted, knowing he was in for a wild one.
Why?
Because while having many cores would surely come in handy during battles, saturating and leveling up would be a headache.
"Ah, I am going to be stuck at the Immortal stage for a while if no miracle happens after these breakthroughs," a pale smile formed on his face.
Just then, his soul sea had reached 3 million km, and he had also leveled up to the Death stage (Tier 22). The next step would take him to the Root Immortal stage.
On the outside, the Tower now looked much more beautiful, but still tiny. Even so, her smile is radiant as she extends her hand, summoning a green rock.
The moment the green rock appeared, Kent’s body released a powerful burst of blood, chaos, flame, and evil qi, the kind that swept across Skull City, causing many to drop to their knees and bow.
"Time for you to take a bold step, Master. Time for you to upgrade your Primal Blood Platform to the Immortal grade."
Just as she said that, strands of green energy began to move from the green stone and enter Kent’s forehead, appearing within his soul sea.
In there, he snapped his eyes open, the look of fascination and shock appearing in them.
"True Dao Energy." Kent recognized it simply because he had seen it in both Jest’s and the Ruthless Bandit’s memories. This energy is only observed when one is forming their Supreme Platform.

Of course, to sense it more clearly, one must either gain insight from others—like the six primordial beasts did for Inaya when she started her formation process—or be extracted from what many call Dao Stones.
Naturally, both are hard to come by, since giving someone insight by letting them experience your Dao is akin to revealing your weaknesses to them.
So, unless the person involved can be trusted completely, that option is not something anyone would do.
The second, and perhaps the hardest to come by, is using Dao Stones. These stones can be obtained through various ways, the easiest being from the remains of Celestial beings.
When a Celestial dies, their core transforms into a Dao Stone, sealing within it the Celestial’s complete understanding of their Dao. When used, one gains some understanding of it.
Of course, there are several other ways to obtain Dao Stones. However, they are hard to come by, and so having a large chunk like the green one before Kent is just plain impossible.
Somehow, the Tower managed to get one, and, even more shocking, Kent is using it even though he was only just stepping into the Immortal stage.
That had never happened before, not in this universe at least. So, for him to have such an opportunity, even without the Tower saying anything, he knew he had to grab this chance.

"The Master has 6 hours to comprehend at least something small from this Dao. It came from a Celestial who cultivated the Life Dao. If the Master can comprehend it, then perhaps when you finally become an Immortal, your health would become monstrous."
Kent nodded, his heart beating faster.

He forced himself to calm down, then reached out and gently touched the green energy. The moment his hand touched it, his consciousness was pulled away from his soul sea and body, and he was taken through a temporal channel that passed through the past, present, and future at once.
Kent didn’t know what kind of power was able to move him through such a portal, but he didn’t allow himself to be drawn into the euphoria.
The thrill he felt moved deeper into his body until he was no longer moving through a channel. Instead, he found himself falling without any resistance.
When he entered the atmosphere, he found himself falling to a green surface that at first looked like a vast sea. However, as he drew closer, he saw it was snow.
This made him sigh in his heart because, from what he knew, snow at some point can be soft, which, if he calculated well, would soften his landing.
Safe to say, when he finally landed on the ground, he went splat.
However, something peculiar happened, leaving him stunned. He expected to feel pain, and he slammed into the ground. However, when he landed, he felt nothing.
His bones were shattered, and his skin was almost peeled off, yet he felt no pain.
However, when he stood to examine himself, he was shocked to see that his injuries had healed and, most importantly, that his body had never felt better.
"What in the Willy Wonka craziness is happening here?"
His expression changed, and for a moment, a chill ran down his spine.𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎

chapters.title: Chapter 1586: The Three Life Dao Celestial
paragraphs: He clearly went splat, yet he felt no pain. Aside from that, his injuries healed. Even more shockingly, after he went splat, he still managed to stand up, which, from what Kent could think of, didn’t make sense.
Life without pain is meaningless, in his opinion.

Life cannot be fully experienced without pain. So, rising to his feet like it never happened clearly didn’t feel right. But that was to be expected, when the moment he stood up, all injuries were healed.
This got him thinking:
"Where am I, and why does it feel like I have walked into something I cannot easily escape from?" Kent sucked in a deep breath, his expression turning calm.

Moments like these, he knew he must remain calm and first explore his options. If he panics just yet, he might miss something that would completely shatter his chances if he intends to find a way back home.
So he calmed his trembling heart down and asked the questions that needed to be asked.
"Where am I?"
"What is this place?"
"Why am I here?"

These questions gave him three objectives, and the first concerned where he is. The answer, of course, is related to the green energy he touched. Somehow, it had pulled him over to this place instead of merely allowing him to experience it.
In the past, his mind would be drawn into a realm where he saw the Dao manifest and tried to comprehend it. Never had he appeared in a world like this.
"But what if this world is the Dao I am meant to comprehend?" His brow knitted, and for a moment, he sucked in a deep breath.
"How does one even go about comprehending the Dao of an entire planet? Where do I even start, and most importantly, would I even be able to do that in 6 hours?"
The question hung in the air.

This brought him to his second question: what place is this? The answer, of course, revolved around whether this place is a realm housing the Dao he was meant to comprehend or if the Dao itself is the entire world.

He tried to scan the planet, but he couldn’t. The only thing he could do was use his eyes to look. Thankfully, his eyes could see very far, thanks to tempering them during his seclusion on Planet Rainy.
However, while his eyesight was rather sharp, he saw nothing that would give him even a faint understanding of what this place is.
This got him to ponder on his third question: why he was here. He is there to comprehend the Dao contained in the green energy he touched. But the most important question is, where should he start?
Kent turned to his left and looked into the distance, then started walking that way.
"It is just 6 hours. If I stand in one place doing nothing, my life chance to become powerful would sleep away from me. I might as well try and find something that would explain things for me."
So he started walking, and for an hour, he saw nothing. Two hours passed in the blink of an eye, but nothing came into sight. Aside from snow, there was nothing else.
Four hours into it, Kent started to become depressed. He had 6 hours to comprehend a Dao and benefit from it; however, here he was, unable to even find where to start.
Soon, he was left with only a minute before the 6 hours ended. This made him sigh deeply in his heart and close his eyes, knowing that when he opened them again, he would be back in his soul sea.
However, after 5 minutes with nothing happening, he snapped them open, his brow furrowing.
The 6 hours were over, and so he should be back in his soul sea or the outside world. Why then is he still inside this place?
"This is getting out of hand really quickly." He stood there for a few minutes before taking another step forward.

"Since that is the case, I might as well make good use of it." He understood that the time difference might be playing a part in all of this. He had no idea how much the gap was, but he wasn’t about to find out standing there and doing nothing.
So he started walking, at times skating on patches of snow that had solidified into an ice field.
A day soon passed, and before long, a week went by, but he hadn’t found anything.

A month came by, and before he knew it, half a year had passed, yet he never stopped to ask questions. He kept going in a straight line, knowing even if he hit a dead end, he would just go in another direction.
So, as stubborn as he was, he continued to walk.
A year passed.
Two years.
Three years.
Six years.
Before Kent knew it, 60 years had passed on the green planet, yet he didn’t stop walking. Maybe he had forgotten he was walking, or perhaps he didn’t want to give up.

However, even if he had that kind of patience, walking for 60 years would have worn it away at some point. Yet as the years flew by, he continued to walk until, 600 years later, he finally came to a halt.
A pale smile formed on his face as he gazed into the distance.
Before him, a large tree stood, its leaves glistening in the dim sunlight. Even from afar, he could sense a welcoming feeling coming from the tree.
So he took one step after another, approaching the tree. As he drew closer to the tree, he started to see things more clearly.
First, the tree appeared much smaller as he drew closer, a clear sign that what he saw and what actually was are two different things.

But that wasn’t the only thing he noticed. He also saw that not all the leaves are green. Others are yellow, blue, gold, and even red. Aside from that, he also saw fruits hanging, some ripe in different shades of color.
These things intrigued him; however, what caught his attention the most was the figure seated under the tree.
Even without seeing the person’s face, he knew from the look of their flowing green hair that they were female.
"Don’t just stand there. Get over here." Before Kent could make sense of anything, he sensed his body pulled forward, appearing in front of the lady.
Their gazes met, and for a moment, Kent felt like all his secrets were laid bare for her to see. Thankfully, the lady had no interest in his secrets, or more like she failed to see anything.

"Interesting. I have met many people in my days, but never have I met an Immortal whose soul is this protected. Tell me, child, who are you, and how did you come into contact with my true Dao energy?"
Kent took a deep breath and answered, "My name is Kent Madson, and I am here because I touched a green Dao Energy."
"I see. I suppose that means you are here to comprehend my Dao."
"If this senior would allow me, I would indeed love to comprehend her Dao."
The lady looked at Kent for a few seconds before a nod came from her.
"My name is—or at this point, I should say was—Kenzie MayDay, famously known as the Three Life Dao Celestial. Pleasure meeting you, Kent Madson."
