"Since that is the case, I might as well make good use of it." He understood that the time difference might be playing a part in all of this.
He had no idea how much the gap was, but he wasn’t about to find out standing there and doing nothing.
So he started walking, at times skating on patches of snow that had solidified into an ice field.
A day soon passed, and before long, a week went by, but he hadn’t found anything.
A month came by, and before he knew it, half a year had passed, yet he never stopped to ask questions.
He kept going in a straight line, knowing even if he hit a dead end, he would just go in another direction.
So, as stubborn as he was, he continued to walk.
A year passed.
Two years.
Three years.
Six years.
Before Kent knew it, 60 years had passed on the green planet, yet he didn’t stop walking.
Maybe he had forgotten he was walking, or perhaps he didn’t want to give up.
However, even if he had that kind of patience, walking for 60 years would have worn it away at some point.
Yet as the years flew by, he continued to walk until, 600 years later, he finally came to a halt.
A pale smile formed on his face as he gazed into the distance.
Before him, a large tree stood, its leaves glistening in the dim sunlight.
Even from afar, he could sense a welcoming feeling coming from the tree.
So he took one step after another, approaching the tree.
As he drew closer to the tree, he started to see things more clearly.
First, the tree appeared much smaller as he drew closer, a clear sign that what he saw and what actually was are two different things.
But that wasn’t the only thing he noticed.
He also saw that not all the leaves are green.
Others are yellow, blue, gold, and even red.
Aside from that, he also saw fruits hanging, some ripe in different shades of color.
These things intrigued him; however, what caught his attention the most was the figure seated under the tree.
Even without seeing the person’s face, he knew from the look of their flowing green hair that they were female.
"Don’t just stand there.
Get over here." Before Kent could make sense of anything, he sensed his body pulled forward, appearing in front of the lady.
Their gazes met, and for a moment, Kent felt like all his secrets were laid bare for her to see.
Thankfully, the lady had no interest in his secrets, or more like she failed to see anything.
"Interesting.
I have met many people in my days, but never have I met an Immortal whose soul is this protected.
Tell me, child, who are you, and how did you come into contact with my true Dao energy?"
Kent took a deep breath and answered, "My name is Kent Madson, and I am here because I touched a green Dao Energy."
"I see.
I suppose that means you are here to comprehend my Dao."
"If this senior would allow me, I would indeed love to comprehend her Dao."
The lady looked at Kent for a few seconds before a nod came from her.
"My name is—or at this point, I should say was—Kenzie MayDay, famously known as the Three Life Dao Celestial.
Pleasure meeting you, Kent Madson."

chapters.title: Chapter 1587: Pride, Trust & Deceit
paragraphs: Kent sat down in a lotus posture directly across from the green-haired lady. He was a bit shaken to learn she had died.
As the Three Life Dao Celestial, Kent understood that her status meant she could not be killed. Someone with that deep understanding of life should be a literal immortal.
In fact, someone like her should be invincible, considering she managed to comprehend the Dao of Life to the Celestial stage.
However, from what she sounded like when she introduced herself, it was plain as day that she was killed, or more accurately, she had died.

Kent had yet to establish whether she was killed or died a natural death. Of course, as a Celestial, Kent recognized that she shouldn’t have died a natural death. So, in hindsight, it meant she was killed, and that alone was a reason to pay more attention to her.
If someone who had managed to comprehend the Dao of Life was killed, then who or what was able to kill her? What could even kill life?
Kent’s focus snapped away from his thoughts, and he decided to admire her beauty. Her figure is graceful. She has high cheekbones, green eyes, and a leaf tattoo on her forehead.
Her body is covered in a translucent green robe that barely covers 50% of her body. Those slender legs, coupled with her hips, gave her a figure that would cause heads to turn.
"Are you done admiring my body yet?" Just as Kent thought he was being sneaky, a voice reached his ear, making him smile slightly, a guilty expression appearing on his face.
"Sorry about that, Senior. My father once said it is no crime to admire beautiful things."
"Your father sounded like a terrible advisor."
"Can’t deny that. But I am inclined to side with him on this one." The smile on his face felt shameless in ways that cannot be explained.
"Whatever. Just don’t go gawking at other Celestials that are not me. Trust me, us Celestials can be unreasonable sometimes."
"I will take that to heart, Senior."

"You’d better do that. That said, since you are here to comprehend my Dao, how about we start with me telling you the true nature of my Dao? Afterwards, you will have a chance to ask any questions you have."
Kent nodded and paid close attention to whatever she had to say.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
"I cultivated the three life Dao named: Regeneration, Rebirth, and Resurrection.

The Dao of Regeneration focuses mainly on absolute healing. The feeling you experienced when you first arrived here was Regeneration. It allows me to regenerate faster than I take damage. This, in turn, makes it so I don’t even feel the pain like I am supposed to. I regenerate faster than my brain can register the damage at all.

Rebirth has to do with the three cycles: Life ↠ Death ↠ Life Again. I never reached the absolute form of this Dao, but the idea was to control life and death so that both could cancel each other out. Life can cancel death, and death can do the same. At my peak, I could easily switch off someone’s life, ending their existence for good. Aside from that, I could raise a living person, granting them a full life.

Resurrection follows the same principles as Rebirth; however, it violates the principle of Death in all forms. You can even say that Resurrection is the taboo of the Life Dao. The reason I said that is because, unlike Rebirth, where life taken from someone is granted to another, Resurrection has to do with complete rebirth in the sense that a person escapes death entirely."
Kent narrowed his eyes, his expression turning solemn. His mind snapped back to the Primordial Era when he used the Spell of Origin.
He had yet to experience how he comprehended it, but he knew it followed the principle of Resurrection to some extent.

"When a person dies, their soul returns to the universe. This soul is then judged, and if deemed worthy, they undergo rebirth. This rebirth happens in a different body, sometimes even a new state of being. A human can come back as a bird, and a butterfly can return as an angel.

However, with the Dao of Resurrection, instead of a new beginning, that soul can be retrieved and returned to the same body. It isn’t what should be done, and so it goes against the Dao of the Heavens.
However, Resurrection isn’t always about defying the Heavens. Resurrection can go either way. Some use it to defy the Heavens. I used it to support the Heavens."
"How so?" Kent asked.

"When Resurrection is paired with Fate, the results are something else. First, you have to know that in this universe, there are those whose fate can be changed from better to worse. Some are meant to do great things, but a change in their fate can cause them to die before their time.
Some even end up in the worst situations.
Whenever that happens, the tapestry of fate becomes wounded, and as such, there is a need for correction. That was where I came in."
"You used your power to bring them back and set them on the path they were meant to follow." Kent finished her sentence.
She nodded and even smiled.
"If that is the case, then why didn’t you bring yourself back? Most importantly, how could someone kill you when your understanding of the Life Dao is this deep?"
As someone whose understanding of the Life Dao is this deep, why didn’t she just bring herself back and be done with it?. Clearly, something doesn’t add up.
This question bugged Kent, so he asked.
"A good question. However, the answer is rather heartbreaking." Lady Kenzie smiled and sighed. "The answer has to do with pride, trust, and deceit.

At my prime, I was the center of attention for most people. At one point, I was even noticed by the legendary Nine Underworld Flames Blacksmith. However, my pride wouldn’t let me lower myself to any of my suitors.
That was until I met him, a Celestial whose understanding of the Fate Dao had reached a level similar to my understanding of Life.
We became Dao partners, and for millions of years, we worked to restore balance to the tapestry of fate. Along the way, my trust in him reached a level where we couldn’t help but fall in love.
If only I had learned I was the one who fell in love and not the other way around." A pale smile filled with rage appeared on her face.
"Life is a funny thing if you truly understand it. You asked why someone was able to kill me when I could just regenerate or even revive myself. The answer is simple, really.
If someone has access to your Dao Body, Dao Seed, Dao Heart, and Dao Soul, then finding out what your Fate Line looks like is very simple.
Once that is discovered, simply cutting it would erase your Dao Imprint from the Grand Dao Tablet, and the rest, you can already guess."
Kent sucked in a deep breath. "So your Dao partner severed your Fate Line. That took away your Dao, and so killing you was easy."
She nodded.
"But why?" Kent couldn’t wrap his mind around why someone would go through all this trouble just to do something so despicable.
In his mind, none of this made any sense. Going as far as making someone fall in love with you just so you could betray them is the darkest thing a person could do.

"Isn’t it obvious? All of this was because of love. I had to die for his one true love, who Fate dealt a bad hand, to be resurrected. My Dao Body, Seed, Heart, and Soul were what he needed, and he got them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1588: Request and Offer
paragraphs: Kent hates many things, but at the top of his list, those he hate the most are traitors who betray and backstab those who trust them completely.

Maybe this had something to do with his incarnation as the Ruthless Bandit. When he found out his uncle was behind the attack that claimed the lives of his parents and entire family, that betrayal ate away at his humanity, making him bitter.
So now that he learned Lady Kenzie died because of a lover, he was overwhelmed with so much anger that the space around him started to change color.
However, that soon vanished when, with a casual wave of her hand, the dark aura that had started to appear around Kent was vanquished.
"Sorry about that. I usually have a good grip on my emotions."
"No need to explain yourself, Kent Madson. I have lived for billions of years, yet I never managed to balance my emotions despite cultivating such a peaceful Dao."
Kent nodded, though deep in his heart, he was still angry.

Perhaps all of this was due to his recent emotional instability, stemming from memories of the Ruthless Bandit. Even so, he was well within his rights to be pissed at the one who dared kill such a beautiful lady.
Naturally, Kent soon realized he was overreacting, so he calmed down.
Seeing this, Lady Kenzie smiled and continued to speak.
"Enough about me. Why don’t we focus on you instead?" The moment she said that, the air around them changed...
"I know you are here to comprehend my Dao, of which I have revealed to you what they are. Now, it is up to you to decide which one to comprehend in the 5,400 years you have left."
Kent furrowed his brow. "I suppose an hour on the outside is a thousand years here."𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
She nodded.

The Tower had already informed him that he had six hours to comprehend the Life Dao and gain something. However, he had been walking for 600 years, something even he was shocked by now that he understood what had happened.
So learning that there is such a time gap, he could only nod and smile.

"Of course, as you can already see, this tree is no ordinary tree. In fact, trees can be considered my skill trees. Every leaf or fruit is a skill I once created from comprehending the Life Dao. Of course, hanging on its branches are several fruits, of which only five are ripe for picking.

I have lost access to 90% of my skills after I lost my body, seed, soul, and heart. However, in total, I have 24 skills and three Daos intact that I can bestow on you for free. I only request one thing from you."
Kent paid close attention to her.

"In my long life, I never truly loved anyone until I met him. He showed me a part of life I had never experienced before. Due to that, I have nothing but thanks for him. However, for betraying my trust, I ask that one day, when you become a Celestial, you get revenge for me."
Kent said nothing and just sat there.
In his mind, this request was within limits. She offered something extremely valuable, and in return, he would render his services.
One thing Kent didn’t understand was why she was taking such a risk when the uncertainty in the vast universe out there was immense.
What if he never made it to the Celestial stage? What if he failed to become a Celestial? What if, after reaching the Celestial stage, he chose not to honor his promise?
"Why take the risk? I am merely a mortal. Compared to a Celestial, reaching the True Immortal stage is not even guaranteed. Why place so much trust in me?"

To his surprise, Lady Kenzie smiled and formed a cloud ball. Bringing it closer to Kent, she clenched it slowly, causing it to burst into a mist of smoke. The smoke spread loosely, forming webs that extended a few meters wide.
Eventually, they formed a spiderweb, with several spiders crawling across its fragile strands.
"In the tapestry of fate, there are countless fate lines, each linking either to another or to the core of the web. These lines are designed to go a certain way.
The spider attached to one line of fate is destined to walk that fate line forever. No matter how much the entire web sways, they always find their way back to the line meant for them."
She snapped her fingers, and a few green spiders appeared. As they moved, they kept jumping from one line to another, moving over the original spiders traversing that line.

"There are those who don’t follow the rules. To them, they can pass anywhere and, in the end, arrive at their destination. No matter the hurdle before them, they will always find a way to get to their destination.

When I look at your fate, I see none of these people. You walk neither of these lines. In fact, you do not even have a single string attached to you. This can only mean you are not within the tapestry of fate."
She paused and snapped her fingers, reforming the web into one where a large spider was weaving it. Instead of crawling across it, the spider was weaving it.
"You are the weaver of your own fate, and as such, I know with absolute certainty that someone like you would not fall short against those walking the path created for them."
Kent sighed in his heart, his expression turning solemn.
He was already aware of the kind of fate he wielded, so it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that when it came to handling his own fate, nobody dared oppose him.
But trusting him this deeply felt a bit desperate.
"Rest assured, I wouldn’t be disappointed if you fail to get revenge for me. After all, after I hand over the root of my Dao, I will forever cease to exist.
So do not become pressured. Since you are here now, I might as well hand over what I have kept away from the universe. Hopefully, it will come in handy for you one day."
Kent nodded and said:
"I will get revenge for you, my lady. One day, those who made you cry will pay for their sins." His words were absolute.
"Good." Lady Kenzie smiled and waved her hand, summoning three tomes. On the first tome, the word ’Regenerate’ was boldly written. The second had ’Rebirth,’ and the last had ’Resurrection.’
"You have 5,400 years to comprehend all three. While I have no high expectations, given that we are talking about the Dao, you are only required to comprehend 0.5% of each Dao.

If you can accomplish that for all three Daos, you will have my complete knowledge and life memories when you leave here." Lady Kenzie flashed Kent a beautiful smile and asked, "Do you think you can do that?"
Kent smiled weakly, a part of him wanting to tell Lady Kenzie he once went above the Grand Dao and comprehended the Origin Dao. However, he kept his mouth shut and thanked her instead.
"Thank you for granting me this opportunity, Senior. I will fully comprehend it, and when done, I will use the knowledge to rise above others and one day get revenge for you."
After he said that, Kent focused his attention on all three tomes and took a deep breath. Then he began to comprehend all three at once.

chapters.title: Chapter 1589: True Immortal
paragraphs: [6 Hours Later]
From the moment the Tower brought out the green-colored Dao Stone, Kent’s cultivation had started its ascension to the Root Immortal stage.

By then, his soul sea had expanded to 5 million km in diameter, and aside from the mountains and other natural constructs, red and black clouds began to form, showing that the soul sea itself is evolving.
Even so, it never stopped expanding.

Thirty minutes into the Dao energy absorption process, a wave of terrifying aura burst from his body, spreading all over Skull City and extending to the other cities, sweeping across the entire low level of the Star Realm.
All who felt it trembled, their backs breaking into cold sweats.

The energies contained within that aura left them all trembling like they were bugs. However, things didn’t slow down at all. Even after he stepped into the Root Immortal stage, his aura continued to rise.
In less than ten minutes, he moved from Low-Level Root Immortal to Peak-Level Root Immortal. Most importantly, when he reached the Peak-Level Root Immortal stage, a strand of Immortal Qi formed.
From there, his aura only continues to surge. In no time, he entered the Spirit Immortal stage and quickly rose through the ranks until he reached the Peak-Level Spirit Immortal stage.
By then, his soul sea had reached 35 million km wide.

It must be known that in the vast universe, God Ascension-stage cultivators are meant to have a minimum soul sea width of 30 million km. So, for a mere Spirit Immortal to have 35 million, one can only wonder the kind of monster he is.
If put into logical measurement, he soon transcended the rank of a monster when, by the time his realm reached the Peak-Level Spirit Immortal stage, it had expanded to 50 million km.
When he finally stepped into the rank of a Core Immortal, his soul sea reached 100 million km wide.

Naturally, this put him at the same level as an average True God. But Kent is no ordinary person. He had accumulated so much blood qi that even after becoming a Core Immortal, he still had enough energy to push him further.
By then, five hours had passed.

Soon, he managed to push past the Low Level to the Mid Level Core Immortal. But that was where his blood essence started to run out. Even so, before it ran out, it managed to push him to the High-Level stage.

By then, his soul sea had reached 300 million km wide, and his Primal Blood Platform had reached 50 million km wide. Shockingly enough, the two Blood Gates had grown so tall and vast that, inside them, the cores looked like giant suns.
The blood core hung loose, primal blood qi oozing from it. Within it, a feeling of dread could be felt.
Before stepping into the rank of an Immortal, his strength was a bit tamed. Now, it felt like a dam had been opened, waves of terrifying energy exploding out of his body.

If an Immortal Lord were present now, they would not be able to look Kent in the eye. Everything about him had become so powerful that even at the High-Level Core Immortal stage, he could contend with the best Immortal Lords.
However, while things calmed down a bit, just when the six hours were about to end, a small green core slowly rose from Kent’s chest.
The moment the green energy appeared, a smile appeared on the Tower’s face.
"Master had succeeded,"

Just as she said that, a calm yet powerful healing aura exploded from Kent’s body. In an instant, his energy rose, and his high-level ranking moved to the Peak, and before long, he broke through to the True Immortal stage.
Inside his soul sea, Kent opened his eyes, a wave of life energy pouring out of his body. Just as he did, three tomes and seven red fruits appeared before him.
He ignored them all and gazed at a mountain standing 40 million km away. With a single step, he appeared on top of it and gazed down, his eyes landing on a small green sprout.
"No way." Kent covered his mouth with his hand, shock appearing on his face.
As he hovered in the air, the sprout of a tree rapidly started to grow. In a few seconds, it rose a few inches. Soon, it rose two feet and continued to grow.
Kent stood there, his gaze filled with shock as the tree rose. In less than 30 minutes, it bloomed into a green, lush tree. Kent remained in place, every passing second adding to his shock.
Soon, however, he could no longer contain his shock and let out a deep sigh.

By then, he felt his cultivation had broken through to the High-Level True Immortal stage and finally halted. He didn’t care much about that. Instead, he stood there for several minutes before calling out to Tower, who appeared instantly in the air before him.
"Congratulations, Master... Huh," she paused and stared intently at the tree growing visibly before her eyes.

"Oh, so you also seem to be taken aback, huh?" Kent asked, his mind spinning as he tried to make sense of what was happening before him. A lot had already happened; however, none of it mattered at the moment.
The tree growing before them had taken the spotlight.
"Master, I want you to tell me everything you saw when you touched the green energy. Don’t omit even the smallest detail."

Kent nodded and began narrating everything from his arrival on the green planet to walking nonstop for 600 years, meeting Lady Kenzie, learning about her Dao, how she died, the request and the offer, and finally spending thousands of years comprehending her Dao.
"Hold on a minute, Master, did you just say you had comprehended 5% of the Life Dao?"
Kent smiled and nodded. "It was much more complex than I expected, but I did."
"Unbelievable. This is just too crazy even for someone as monstrous as you, Master."
"Why did you say that?" Kent asked, a smile forming on his face.
"In comprehending a Dao, one can compare it to comprehending the laws. Only that, when it comes to comprehending the Dao, you would have to traverse three levels every time you make progress.
For example, if you attain weak comprehension of the Life Dao, before you can move to the medium stage, you must first attain Tier 1 Weak Comprehension, Tier 2, and Tier 3.
In the grand Dao, comprehending 5% of the Dao is akin to Tier 1 High-Level Comprehension."
"Is that so?" Kent grinned. "I guess I am a monster then."
"Oh, trust me, you are the greatest monster. But let’s not focus on that. What we should be concerned about now is the tree." The Tower pointed at the tree that now stood two meters tall.
"I have no idea what this tree is, Tower. Just that I can sense an overwhelming might of the Life Dao coming from it."

"That is because the tree was born from a Dao Seed. I have no idea how you managed to transport a Dao Seed into your soul sea, Master. But what you have to know is this: soon, this tree will bloom, and there is a chance it will gain sentience.

Once it does, it will try to take over your soul. I would advise the Master to be ready by then to go into combat mode, for I am afraid the greatest battle you will ever fight at this stage is slowly growing inside your body."
Kent sucked in a cold breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 1590: Terrifying Changes (1)
paragraphs: Kent clearly didn’t expect a growing threat right inside his soul sea. From what he could sense from the tree, the aura of life coming from it was filled with an abundance of health and peace. Such a power shouldn’t be a threat, right?
Kent didn’t think that was the case, so he just took a deep breath and decided to examine the changes that had happened to him. Perhaps that would help him prepare for what was coming.
Turning away from the tree, he scanned the vast expanse of his soul sea, and all he could see was power, an untamed power.

His soul sea had expanded to 700 million km after he reached the True Immortal stage. Now, his strength is comparable to that of a medium-level demigod. However, in the grand scheme of things, one can tell that sometimes the power of a cultivator is not determined by their cultivation stage.

Kent is a clear example of that. He is now a True Immortal, but he can contend against a demigod. That is because he has more energy, experience, and skills that would come into play when he faces such an opponent.

The second example is the Crimson Blood Demon General, who is merely a demigod but possesses the power of a God King. So while Kent may have become powerful, there are opponents even he would have to go all out against.
Thankfully, he could see various ways to accomplish them without being severely disadvantaged.
His attention was first directed at the grand platform now standing several million km wide. The Primal Blood Platform had upgraded, and with it, the two Blood Gates had become more monstrous.
One stood several million km tall and wide. In fact, looking at the first Blood Gate, Kent felt a terrifying sensation wash over him.
"Is this thing even normal? I mean, if it scares me, who happens to be the owner, then what about my foes?" Kent scoffed, his expression brightening up.
Inside the first Blood Gate, he had four cores: the Blood Core (red), Flame Core (green), Chaos Heart/Core (purple and gold), and now the first Evil Core (Black).
While only the Blood Core affected his cultivation, the other three strengthened him in ways even he couldn’t bring himself to understand just yet.

The changes that had happened to him were just too many to comprehend. Though he knew that with these changes, he could go into battle knowing full well that even after 100 days, he wouldn’t run out of energy.
He turned and looked at Tower, who was hovering right beside him. "Tower, so how much energy do you think I have contained inside my first Blood Gate alone?"

"The master has roughly 200 billion years’ worth of energy contained in just the Evil Core alone. If all four are put together, you are looking at 1.5 trillion years’ worth of energy. Now, while the master may think this is small, consider the possibility that in battle, you can unleash a million years’ worth of energy every time you attack.

Even if you go all out, you wouldn’t run out of energy. That said, you have the potential to run out of energy, so maybe review the changes first before we make that assumption." Kent nodded and turned to the next Blood Gate.

In there, only two cores hovered: the second Blood Core (red) and the second Flame Core (red). He had yet to form the second Evil Core and Chaos Heart. But that was also fine. As a True Immortal, he could do more than he could when he was still a mortal.
"Tower, pull up the messages about my Primal Blood Platform."
Tower nodded and did as she was told.
[Congratulations. Your Primal Blood Platform has undergone an upgrade: Immortal Grade]
[Your Primal Blood Platform has expanded to 200 million km wide. Because of this expansion, your Blood Gates have expanded too, and the same applies to your cores.]
[Because of the expansion, you now have more energy to use in powering your attacks. However, your cores are not saturated yet.]
[Current Saturation: First Blood Gate]
↠ Blood Core: 40%
↠ Flame Core: 50%
↠ Chaos Heart: 5%
↠ Evil Core: 60%
[Current Saturation: Second Blood Gate]
↠ Blood Core: 60%
↠ Flame Core: 50%

Kent smiled weakly, his expression mirroring that of a helpless cat. The information displayed before him was not something he expected at all. While he was already aware that his Chaos Heart was lacking, he never expected the others to be this low.
Now, to saturate them, he must absorb a large sum of Blood Essence, Flame Essence, Chaos Essence, and Evil Essence.

The first three, in his opinion, could be obtained. The Evil Essence, however, was where the problem started. In the past, the Ruthless Bandit replenished his energy by killing and absorbing resentment. Now, however, Kent understood that unnecessary killing wouldn’t be the way forward this time around.
So he must find another way if he intends to use his Evil Core. While it could, over time, replenish what it lost, he knew that would be too slow.
So finding a way to go about that would be the next best thing.
"Huh." Just when he was about to close the status page, something caught his attention.
Snapping his attention back to the Blood Core, his expression narrowed.
[Current Saturation: First Blood Gate]
↠ Blood Core: 45%
↠ Flame Core: 50%
↠ Chaos Heart: 5%
↠ Evil Core: 60%
"Five percent, where did that come from?" Kent asked, his head turning to face Tower.

"The master had awakened many abilities that even I don’t understand yet. However, it appears the master gains energy from the deaths of his subordinates and friends. This means your wives and legion."
Kent blinked once or twice and threw his head back, a resounding laughter escaping his lips. Five percent Blood Qi was akin to 200 million years’ worth of energy.
If, in a span of mere seconds, he had earned that, perhaps he had nothing to worry about.
"Tower, where did that energy come from?"
"Part of it came from the Soul Warriors, and the other came from the legion currently clearing the dungeons." Kent nodded, his expression brightening up.
"Then this is nothing to worry about after all. I will let them replenish my Blood Core while I focus on the other cores."
This discovery had improved Kent’s mood. Now, he just had to saturate the other cores. Going to the Tormented Chaos Abyss would surely help him handle the Chaos Heart.
Then, once he ascended to the Immortal Realm, he would find a way for his Flame Core and Evil Core.
Kent turned away from the Primal Blood Platform and looked at the [Underworld Soul River]. Even from afar, he could sense terrifying beings hidden just behind those giant doors.
The entire nature of the [Underworld Soul River] had changed, and now, he could tell it had become much more powerful.
"Tower, pull up the messages on the [Underworld Soul River]."
[Your Underworld Soul River has undergone a significant upgrade from Tier 1 ↠ Tier 2]
[Underworld Soul River]
[Rank: ???]
[Tier: 2]

[Description: Open the gate to the Underworld River and summon the resentful power straight from the River of Styx. The longer the gate remains open, the more vast and powerful the resentment becomes.]
[You have unlocked a Unique skill]
[Unique Skill: Summon (locked)]
[Description: For every threshold reached, you can summon a resentful being of your choosing. To unlock this ability, you must consume 10,000 resentful souls using the Underworld Soul River.
Thresholds:
1. 10,000 Resentful Souls = 1 Resentful Being
2. 50,000 Resentful Souls = 2 Resentful Beings
3. 100,000 Resentful Souls = 5 Resentful Beings
4. 1,000,000 Resentful Souls = 10 Resentful Beings
"Damn..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1591: Terrifying Changes (2)
paragraphs: "What is even a Resentful Being?" Kent asked, lost as to what to even think. He had lived many lives, but this was his first time seeing something called a Resentful Being.
He knew of Resentful Spirits, but this was his first time learning about Resentful Beings.
The Tower moved and hovered before him.
"Resentful Souls are beings created from Resentful Spirits. I hope by now the master is aware that Resentful Spirits are carried away through the River of Styx by the Grim Reapers."
Kent nodded, already aware of this information.

"Resentful Beings are those who didn’t make it to the Underworld. It has been said that when the Grim Reapers come for the souls to be ferried to the Underworld, not all make it. In fact, the number of Resentful Souls that get stuck in the River of Styx is even more than those sent to the Underworld.
Due to this, the River of Styx became so dangerous over time that aside from the Grim Reapers and the Lords of the Underworld, nobody dared cross it.
Of course, the only reason they can do that is because of the Authority they have from the Queen of the Underworld.

The truth of the matter is, when it comes to the River of Styx, it is one of the most dangerous places in the universe. Those Resentful Spirits that are left behind—some manage to evolve by devouring other Resentful Souls.
In fact, it can be said that those who survive evolve using the power of the River of Styx, becoming overlords of the river that has no beginning or end.
Legends even have it that one Resentful Being is enough to face an army of an entire planet and walk away stronger and more resentful.

However, because of their abominable nature, they have been imprisoned in the Underworld River for all eternity. No matter how you look at it, Resentful Beings are enemies of this universe. They cannot be tamed, and they most certainly cannot be commanded.
I wonder why you can summon them now."
"This..." Kent’s expression turned a bit serious. He knew some things were meant to be kept in check because peace and prosperity depended on their containment.𝐟𝕣𝗲𝕖𝕨𝗲𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝗲𝚕.𝗰𝚘𝐦

Examples of such beings were those monsters hidden in the Seven Calamity Zones and the Three Primal Regions. They could not be allowed to leave. If they were allowed even a small passage, the entire universe would be in chaos.
"Does this have something to do with the Book of Evil...?" Kent asked, turning his gaze to the book hovering beside the Underworld Soul River.
After recovering all his memories, he saw that during his time in the Star Realm, he and the Queen of Evil talked about that book.

From what she told him, it was one of the Primal Treasures of the Unknown Universe, where she came from. According to her, that book contains many things that every last person who cultivates the Dao of Evil will cherish.
This conversation happened a few years before he entered the Trial of Evil and became a Celestial. So while he knew of its existence, he had no idea what was contained within it.
All he knew was that the power contained within it was forbidden and could not be taken lightly.
"I believe the master is worried for nothing. This Underworld Soul River is yours, so if it allows you to harness its hidden powers, then you can easily use it without worrying about anything."
"But there is one thing I don’t understand, Tower." Kent cast his mind back to the small parts of his memories that covered the kind of teams he created.
Chaos formed the Void Legion. It was the strongest team during the Primordial Era. They played a huge role in the Great War.
Jest also created the Sword Pagoda, a place where the greatest swordsmen gathered to exchange ideas and improve the Dao of Swordsmanship.
Faceless also created the Midnight Shadows, the most elite assassin organization in the entire universe.
Finally, while the Ruthless Bandit wasn’t the one who formed the Night Riders, he played a part in their growth.

All these teams coming together are already a menace. However, he is also aware that he was the master of the Undead Legion, meaning at some point he was a Necromancer, and also the Eternal Wrath Legion, of which he had no idea which of his incarnations formed that.
He is also aware that he was a Beast Tamer at some point, so there is a Beast Legion on the way.
All that, coupled with the fact that he himself is a menace, points to a battle coming, one that he perhaps had seen during the Primordial Era and started to work towards.
But the question here is, what kind of battle requires one person to use thirteen lives to prepare for it?
"Where does all of this lead, Tower? I can say that already, with the subordinates I have, if they all rise to the Celestial Level one day, there is no threat that can stop them.
So why do I keep getting more assistance, or, more importantly, what did my past selves do that seems to be starting to manifest in this life?"
There are some parts of his memories that are blank. For example, when he went into the Trial of Evil, what happened there is blank to him.

The same can be said for when he entered the Infinity Sword Library. Whatever he did there remains a mystery to him. So while he knew none of these powers were harmful, he had no idea what was coming that would require him to have this much power.
"I also don’t know why the master needs all this. But I do know that this universe is in severe danger, and so the master is going to need all the help he can get."
Kent sighed again.
"Resentful Beings, huh?" A grin formed on his face. "Maybe I do need them for when I face the Forbidden Race and finally put an end to their evil existence."
Tower nodded her small head. "You see, the master always has use for his subordinates."
Kent smiled and nodded. "That I do. However, what is with these coffins?"

Turning away from the Underworld Soul River, Kent turned toward the direction of twenty-four dark coffins, each constructed from metallic bones, with the aura of pure darkness and evil pouring out of them.

All twenty-four look very scary. However, for some reason, he felt like they were right where they should be. The feeling he felt toward them resonated with his Evil Core, a clear sign that they were linked to that part of him.
Tower answered him by pulling up the messages on the twenty-four coffins.
[You have awakened the 24 Grand Arcane Coffins.]
[24 Grand Arcane Coffins]
[Type: Soul Item]

[Description: The 24 Grand Shaman Elders were banished since the dawn of time, never to be heard from ever again. Many say their existence is an abomination that can alter the course of an entire universe.
Some say their existence was so terrifying that nobody could keep them in check. So they slept for eternity, waiting for the one true Overlord to awaken them.]
[Mission: Find the 24 Marks of True Evil and awaken the 24 Grand Shaman Elders.]
Kent nodded, expecting something this universe-altering.

chapters.title: Chapter 1592: Terrifying Changes (3)
paragraphs: "So, how many Innate Talents do I have left to awaken?" Kent asked as he turned to the Bloodline Skill Tree. Looking at the many fruits hanging off its branches, he couldn’t help but wonder how many he is eligible to awaken.
"The master is now eligible to unlock 12 Innate Talents. It was 25 initially, but as you continue to level up, some of them are unlocked automatically to aid your cultivation.
So for now, the master can unlock 12. You can unlock 4 for your Dragon side, 2 for your Evil side, 2 for your Flame side, and the last 2 for your Blood side."
"I see." The last time he used the skill fruits, he unlocked two Innate Talents: [Blood Calamity Fist] and [Chaos Scale Shield].
Right now, he could tell that both skills had become extremely powerful. The [Chaos Scale Shield] was now on another level.
In fact, as he pulled up the details of the newly upgraded [Chaos Scale Shield], something caught his attention. He could now sense that his Innate Skills had something new attached to them.
Each had a section called Rating, with stars acting as the level.
On the [Chaos Scale Shield], he saw three stars, while the [Blood Calamity Fist] had two stars. Shockingly enough, the [Dragon Gaze] and [Dragon Tail Whip] each had a four-star rating.
"Tower, what are the ratings attached to the Innate Skills?"
Tower giggled and puffed her flat chest out. "I know the master can already tell the Innate Skills have become stronger. That happened because of the rating.
Every star represents a 10,000-times boost in all aspects of the skill. Once the stars reach 5, the skill can be upgraded to the next level. So 3 starts means 30,000 times stronger."
"Oh, that is a bit convenient then. How can I increase the stars?"
"The master needs Innate Points. You can earn those by completing quests or leveling up."
Kent smiled, his expression filled with satisfaction. He never truly expected this breakthrough to the True Immortal stage to yield this many rewards.
Not only had he become stronger, but everything else around him had also become much stronger.
Just beyond the Bloodline Skill Tree, he could see the concepts of his innate realms: the Genesis Sword Realm, the Faceless Shadow Realm, and the Evil Realm.

While he had yet to even reach the Sword Divine stage, his understanding was already comparable to a Sword Legend. So with his strength as an Immortal, no swordsman below the Sword Legend stage could contend with him.
He had already been informed that a sword competition would take place in three years’ time. By then, he would be at the Sword Divine stage, which would qualify him to participate.

The second realm, being the newly awakened one—the Evil Realm that was once called the Negative Zero Ruthless Realm—had now become part of Kent’s collection of realms, and so he could easily wield it.
Aside from that, the Faceless Shadow Realm had become much stronger compared to when he first awakened it.
Kent knew something had changed about it, since it had become much more potent.
However, he held back from checking it out and instead walked to the location where Gaap sat in a lotus posture, a demonic-looking figure seated across from him.
Channels of resentful energy could be seen coming from the demonic being and entering Gaap. Kent smiled faintly, knowing full well that soon, his Living Sword would become monstrous.
The moment they ascended to the Immortal World, they would start clashing with the gods. It is a known fact that he is someone many are interested in, so battles aren’t out of the equation.
Ascending from Immortal to the God World was not a strict requirement, so he knew it wouldn’t be long before he and the gods started clashing.
Having a powerful sword alongside his Spear of Evil would surely come in handy.
After standing there for a few minutes, he moved to the last place.
He appeared before a red rune oozing a mixture of terrifying Chaos and Blood Qi. One could sense a terrifying pressure coming from it.
The first time Kent touched this, he nearly died.
Today, as he sighed and reached out, a smile appeared on his face.
His first-ever Primordial-grade technique, the [Claw Art], was finally within his grasp.
Already, Bhaalzhar (Slaughter King) had told him that before he could learn that technique, he must first form and saturate his Blood Cores.

He did that when he was at the Heavenly Ascension stage. He saturated both at the Tier 19 stage. While he is still required to saturate them after becoming an Immortal, he has already completed the requirement.
The second requirement was for him to absorb at least ten Blood Life and Death Seals each. Kent had already formed 25 of each, so he was secure.
The third required him to awaken all Blood Runes/Seals, which he did and even added more. Instead of 105,000 Blood Seals, he had formed 250,000. That, in a way, had pushed him even further.
Funny enough, Kent knew that as he formed more Blood Cores, more Blood Runes would keep forming. He couldn’t wait to meet Bhaalzhar again and brag to him.
As for the fourth requirement, Kent knew it was unnecessary, not when he had already become an Immortal.
If he were still a mortal, he would have tried cultivating the second form of the [Bone Tempering Art], where he would have had to create Blood Tattoos.
Now, he didn’t have to do that.
While he is required to form blood tattoos, he doesn’t need them to learn the technique.
The remaining requirements were all basic, so with a smile on his face, he reached for the rune, and the next second, he was back in the desert.
"Alright, let’s see what you are made of," Kent said in a serious tone as he focused his eyes ahead.
Just when he did, the clouds churned, and the ground trembled. Kent felt his body shake; however, he stood his ground and continued to stare at the attack coming from the clouds.

The clouds suddenly parted, and a dragon claw appeared, a terrifying intent coating it. Then, with a simple swing, four devastating claw arcs flashed out, and before Kent could react, the dunes of sand parted and lava gushed out.
The entire world he was in was shattered, debris flying far and wide.

"Oh my..." Kent felt his body tense, and for a moment, the thought of running appeared in his mind. However, just before he could act, his body appeared in another world identical to the destroyed one.
Just when he appeared, a voice he recognized all too well entered his head.

"You seek to learn my first-ever Primordial grade Technique. To be worthy of my legacy, you must endure five attacks..." The voice hadn’t even finished when the claw appeared again and swung, producing the same devastating result.
A few seconds later, he was back in the same place, and the claw appeared again. By then, Kent started to feel his body growing heavy.
He didn’t allow the sluggishness to overwhelm him, not when he still had attacks to endure. Just then, another strike came, and the results were even more devastating.
However, Kent endured, waiting for the final attack. When the claw descended, it carried an overwhelmingly oppressive force, the kind that left Kent pale like a sheet.
Even so, he endured, channeling his will to survive. In the end, he survived, and before he knew it, billions of runes flew and entered his head.
[You have obtained your first Primordial-grade technique: Claw Art]
When he appeared back inside his soul sea, he felt more energized.
He knew it would take some time to master the first form of the technique. However, with the technique now in his hands, he had nothing to worry about.
The question now was, what exactly is Dragon Intent?

chapters.title: Chapter 1593: Dragon Intent
paragraphs: To unleash the [Claw Art], Kent is required to master Dragon Intent.
Back when Chaos used this technique, he wasn’t required to have Dragon Intent before he could unleash it. He merely combined Chaos Qi and Blood Qi to power the technique.

Now, he must have Dragon Intent before he can use it. The problem, however, is that he has no idea what Dragon Intent is. He had been a dragon before, but today was his first time hearing that there was something called Dragon Intent.
Turning to Tower, he expected her to have an explanation.
But to his shock, she smiled and pointed at the purple cocoon 20 million km away. With a single step, Kent appeared before it.
His [Heavenly Jade Eye] scanned it, and what he saw made him wonder if he was lucky or just fortunate.
[You have discovered Dragon Intent.]
[Your Dragon Intent is currently in the process of forming. Absorb more Chaos and Blood Energy to speed up the process.]
[Current Progress: 23%]
Kent smiled and nodded. "It isn’t like I need this technique right now anyway. Once I am out of this place, I will make sure it awakens fully by absorbing Chaos and Blood Essence."
Seeing everything worked out in the end, Kent smiled and turned to Tower. "What was it you wanted to show me?"
Tower waved her hand, and seven red fruits appeared before Kent. "This came with the three tomes. I believe they are skills you must learn."
Kent nodded and reached for the first red fruit. He examined it for a few seconds before tossing it into his mouth. The moment it entered his mouth, it dissolved, spreading all over his body.
Kent felt his body become stronger and more energetic. A few seconds later, messages appeared before his eyes.
[You have consumed a Life Dao Skill Fruit.]
[You have awakened a new skill: Absolute Healing.]
[Absolute Healing]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: As long as your heart and soul are not completely crushed, you can heal from any injuries. The more energy you have, the faster the healing process.]

Kent furrowed his brow, a wave of happiness surging through his body. He can already be likened to someone with rather superior healing abilities. However, this new skill has elevated the process to a whole different level.
Reaching forward, he grabbed another fruit and tossed it into his mouth. Like before, the same thing happened, and before long, the messages appeared.
[You have consumed a Life Dao Skill Fruit.]
[You have awakened a new skill: Demon Master Regeneration.]
[Demon Master Regeneration]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: You now regenerate your lost energy and injuries 10,000 times faster.]
"Damn..." Kent felt his soul sea surge, and then waves of energy started pouring into his body. All of a sudden, he felt his Blood Core and Chaos Heart growing stronger.
His [Primordial Chaos Eternal Body] and [Primal Chaos Art] made it so that his body can convert all kinds of energy, provided there is enough in the atmosphere.
So while there is no Blood Qi or Chaos Qi in the air, the Spiritual Energy is being converted. Initially, Kent sensed he was growing stronger just by being there.
However, this new ability has sped things up.
While the process is still a bit slower, the mere fact that his Blood Core has already increased by 1% saturation shows it is only a matter of time before the Chaos Heart does as well.
"I know demons have high regeneration abilities; however, I never expected a Demon Master to possess this much regeneration."

Tower smirked, hearing what Kent had said. "The master is overestimating demons. While it is indeed true that True Demons possess high regeneration abilities, a Master Demon can boast only 1,000 times regeneration.
The fact that the master has 10,000 times that shows he is no ordinary person. In fact, the master can be compared to a Demon Saint or even a Demon Sage."
Kent smiled, feeling like he had looked down on himself. But with more fruits left to eat, he reached forward and grabbed a third one.
[You have consumed a Life Dao Skill Fruit.]
[You have awakened a new skill: High Regeneration.]
[Because you have already awakened Demon Master Regeneration, a mutation has occurred. Demon Master Regeneration has merged with High Regeneration.]
[A new skill has been formed. You have unlocked a new skill: Demon Saint Regeneration.]
[Demon Saint Regeneration]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: You now regenerate your lost energy and injuries 250,000 times faster. You can regenerate lost limbs and organs in seconds.]
Kent looked at the message and smiled. Ignoring the surge of energy pouring into his body, he grabbed the second fruit and tossed it into his mouth.
[You have consumed a Life Dao Skill Fruit.]
[You have awakened a new skill: Great Regeneration.]
[Because you have already awakened Demon Saint Regeneration, a mutation has occurred. Demon Saint Regeneration has merged with Great Regeneration.]
[A new skill has been formed. You have unlocked a new skill: Demon King Regeneration.]
[Demon King Regeneration]
[Rank: Celestial]

[Description: You now regenerate your lost energy and injuries 500,000 times faster. You can regenerate lost limbs and organs in mere seconds. As long as you have a body part left, you can regenerate your entire body.]𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
"This is getting out of hand."
Kent laughed and tossed the fifth fruit into his mouth. Before long, a similar mutation happened, and so he continued to the next, and before long, all seven fruits were consumed.
By then, the wave of energy pouring into Kent’s body had reached a whole new level.
His regeneration ability had also reached a new level that even a Demon Lord would cry tears of anguish if they learned a mere dragon had obtained such regeneration.
[Your Demon Lord Regeneration has undergone both a mutation and an upgrade.]
[Your Demon Lord Regeneration has mutated and become Demon God Regeneration.]
[Your Demon God Regeneration ability has been upgraded from Celestial grade to Innate.]
[Demon God Regeneration]
[Rank: Innate]
[Ranking: 4 Stars]
[Description: You can now regenerate your lost energy and injuries 5 million times faster.]
"Hmm, I never knew a day like this would ever come. With this, I can go all out and wouldn’t have to worry about running out of energy," Kent laughed, his expression showing how happy he had become.
The kind of power in his hands now is just beyond what he had expected. Not even Chaos at his demigod stage possessed such power.
"Congratulations, Master. Looks like trading the Life Dao Stone from Gaia was a good trade," Tower giggled, very happy for her master.
While Kent was taken aback to learn that the stone came from Gaia, he had no idea he had already paid for it and was even in debt.
Aside from Vexthra using all of his Tower Points and even borrowing some to buy the [Void Null Shield], Tower, after her upgrade, was able to contact Gaia and inform her of the latest development.
Of course, since she is a cosmic being, giving something as valuable as the Life Dao Stone would break the balance of the universe, so she sold it for a staggering 100 billion Tower Points.
This price offset the karma involved.
Tower bought it, and now that Kent had benefited from it, she had no regrets.
"Time for the master to go back to his mission. A lot had happened while you were locked up in here."
Kent nodded and opened his eyes on the outside, meeting Princess Pandora’s gaze.

sentences.text: To unleash the [Claw Art], Kent is required to master Dragon Intent.
Back when Chaos used this technique, he wasn’t required to have Dragon Intent before he could unleash it.
He merely combined Chaos Qi and Blood Qi to power the technique.
Now, he must have Dragon Intent before he can use it.
The problem, however, is that he has no idea what Dragon Intent is.
He had been a dragon before, but today was his first time hearing that there was something called Dragon Intent.
Turning to Tower, he expected her to have an explanation.
But to his shock, she smiled and pointed at the purple cocoon 20 million km away.
With a single step, Kent appeared before it.
His [Heavenly Jade Eye] scanned it, and what he saw made him wonder if he was lucky or just fortunate.
[You have discovered Dragon Intent.]
[Your Dragon Intent is currently in the process of forming.
Absorb more Chaos and Blood Energy to speed up the process.]
[Current Progress: 23%]
Kent smiled and nodded.
"It isn’t like I need this technique right now anyway.
Once I am out of this place, I will make sure it awakens fully by absorbing Chaos and Blood Essence."
Seeing everything worked out in the end, Kent smiled and turned to Tower.
"What was it you wanted to show me?"
Tower waved her hand, and seven red fruits appeared before Kent.
"This came with the three tomes.
I believe they are skills you must learn."
Kent nodded and reached for the first red fruit.
He examined it for a few seconds before tossing it into his mouth.
The moment it entered his mouth, it dissolved, spreading all over his body.
Kent felt his body become stronger and more energetic.
A few seconds later, messages appeared before his eyes.
[You have consumed a Life Dao Skill Fruit.]
[You have awakened a new skill: Absolute Healing.]
[Absolute Healing]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: As long as your heart and soul are not completely crushed, you can heal from any injuries.
The more energy you have, the faster the healing process.]
Kent furrowed his brow, a wave of happiness surging through his body.
He can already be likened to someone with rather superior healing abilities.
However, this new skill has elevated the process to a whole different level.
Reaching forward, he grabbed another fruit and tossed it into his mouth.
Like before, the same thing happened, and before long, the messages appeared.
[You have consumed a Life Dao Skill Fruit.]
[You have awakened a new skill: Demon Master Regeneration.]
[Demon Master Regeneration]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: You now regenerate your lost energy and injuries 10,000 times faster.]
"Damn..." Kent felt his soul sea surge, and then waves of energy started pouring into his body.
All of a sudden, he felt his Blood Core and Chaos Heart growing stronger.
His [Primordial Chaos Eternal Body] and [Primal Chaos Art] made it so that his body can convert all kinds of energy, provided there is enough in the atmosphere.
So while there is no Blood Qi or Chaos Qi in the air, the Spiritual Energy is being converted.
Initially, Kent sensed he was growing stronger just by being there.
However, this new ability has sped things up.
While the process is still a bit slower, the mere fact that his Blood Core has already increased by 1% saturation shows it is only a matter of time before the Chaos Heart does as well.
"I know demons have high regeneration abilities; however, I never expected a Demon Master to possess this much regeneration."

"The master is overestimating demons.

The fact that the master has 10,000 times that shows he is no ordinary person.
In fact, the master can be compared to a Demon Saint or even a Demon Sage."
Kent smiled, feeling like he had looked down on himself.

[You have consumed a Life Dao Skill Fruit.]
[You have awakened a new skill: High Regeneration.]
[Because you have already awakened Demon Master Regeneration, a mutation has occurred.
Demon Master Regeneration has merged with High Regeneration.]
[A new skill has been formed.
You have unlocked a new skill: Demon Saint Regeneration.]
[Demon Saint Regeneration]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: You now regenerate your lost energy and injuries 250,000 times faster.
You can regenerate lost limbs and organs in seconds.]
Kent looked at the message and smiled.
Ignoring the surge of energy pouring into his body, he grabbed the second fruit and tossed it into his mouth.
[You have consumed a Life Dao Skill Fruit.]
[You have awakened a new skill: Great Regeneration.]
[Because you have already awakened Demon Saint Regeneration, a mutation has occurred.
Demon Saint Regeneration has merged with Great Regeneration.]
[A new skill has been formed.
You have unlocked a new skill: Demon King Regeneration.]
[Demon King Regeneration]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Description: You now regenerate your lost energy and injuries 500,000 times faster.
You can regenerate lost limbs and organs in mere seconds.
As long as you have a body part left, you can regenerate your entire body.]𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶

[Your Demon Lord Regeneration has undergone both a mutation and an upgrade.]
[Your Demon Lord Regeneration has mutated and become Demon God Regeneration.]
[Your Demon God Regeneration ability has been upgraded from Celestial grade to Innate.]
[Demon God Regeneration]
[Rank: Innate]
[Ranking: 4 Stars]

chapters.title: Chapter 1594: Shadow Fiends
paragraphs: "Congratulations on becoming an Immortal. How do you feel in general?" Princess Pandora asked the moment Kent opened his eyes on the outside.
"Pretty good. I don’t feel like abandoning these people anymore."
A pale smile formed on his lips. When he had only just recovered the Ruthless Bandits’ memories, he considered abandoning them. However, now, he doesn’t feel the need for that anymore.
If anything, he feels more like he must protect them.
In a way, they are the first race of people who cultivate true evil energy like him.

Their presence gives birth to natural evil energy, so they are unique and perfectly align with his evil path. If one day he becomes a god and inherits the power of faith, they would be his source of power.

Hearing his response, Princess Pandora smiled. "Good you said that. I was about to tell you to keep them protected because guess what, the entire Star Realm is about to change now that you have returned."
"Good for me, I suppose. In any case, how are they doing?"
"Those who had inherited the Mark of Evil have been pulled into a unique Trial of Evil that even I don’t know where it came from. Some have already passed it, including my mother.

She is now different and very dangerous. You would have to see for yourself what kind of monsters you have, in a way, created. Honestly, even I am in shock after seeing the kind of people they have become."
For someone who is stronger than a Celestial at the peak to be shocked by something Kent had created, that can only mean the thing in question is impossible.
"I will see them later. For now, I have to examine a few things before leaving for my mission."
Princess Pandora nodded.
She herself had to leave.
Now that Kent had returned, she had no reason to keep waiting for him in her afterimage. Her real body is hidden somewhere in the Tormented Chaos Abyss, so soon, they will reunite properly.

"Take this. It is the item you must take with you to the Tormented Chaos Abyss. The moment you get there, it will take roughly 66 days for me to awaken, so you must do your best to survive that long."
"I will."
After handing over the item to Kent, she vanished.

Kent examined the metallic item in his hand for a few minutes before tossing it into his space ring. He stood up and examined his body. Feeling the power surging through his body, Kent smiled and clenched his fist.
"I wonder how long it would take me to kill the Crimson Blood Demon General," he muttered, already anticipating the battle he would be fighting before moving to Elina’s Galaxy.
Kent examined more of his body before shifting his attention to the change he noticed inside his Faceless Shadow Realm.
The moment he activated the Faceless Shadow Realm, the entire space was covered in darkness. If someone were present, they would think the god of darkness had appeared in the space.
Meanwhile, Kent, who happens to be at the center of everything, smiled upon seeing three figures standing inside the shadow realm.
They are humanoids clad in dark cloaks that seem to ooze shadowy energy. Two of them are Immortal Monarchs, and one is an Immortal Lord.
"Since any shadow fiend is three realms above me, then this means the two Immortal Monarchs were True Immortals when they were awakened, and the Immortal Lord was an Immortal King.
This also means wherever the kill came from, they had killed 200 True Immortals and 10 Immortal Kings. Just which of my legion was responsible?"
The tower appeared and hovered before Kent. "It appears your soul warriors are doing better than expected. I just checked, and it appears they are itching to take down Stone City.
Honestly, I think the master shouldn’t worry about them at all. They will handle everything as it should, so the master should go to the Tormented Chaos Abyss and handle his mission there."
"So that was why, huh. Good to know." Learning his soul warriors were doing better than he expected, his expression brightened. As long as they are fine, he has nothing to worry about.
Turning his attention back to the three shadow fiends, he spoke, "Can you three talk?"
They turned and looked at Kent but said nothing. This told him they might not be able to speak. However, he could tell they understood what he said, so he issued a command.
"Go to Stone City and aid my subordinates in subjugating it. Make sure they are protected from all kinds of harm."
They nodded and vanished from the shadow realm. After they were gone, Kent deactivated the realm and focused his attention on his mission.
He now has a chain quest that requires him to be inside the Tormented Chaos Abyss first before it would activate.
Knowing it would lead him to his final opponent, the Crimson Blood Demon General, he smiled and decided to go see the High Priestess again before leaving.
Meanwhile, standing atop a mountain 30 km from Stone City, Bello, Kenna, and Calix gazed at the towering fortress.
"So what did you two find?" Kenna asked, her focus rooted on a towering stone tower standing at the center of the city.
Calix was the first to answer, "It appears the King of Stone City had prepared well. Aside from him and his general being a demigod, there is another demigod hidden inside an underground chamber.
I don’t know where he came from, considering he looks nothing like any of the beings in the other cities. However, I can tell he is a bit stronger than the Stone King."
Bello took over, "I have also determined the meeting point of the three armies. The warriors of Wind City and Lightning City would meet the stone warriors in a forest 40 km away from Skull City.
They would each be sending 50,000 Immortal Lords and 400,000 Immortal Monarchs and below. If we don’t intercept them early, we might just miss the window."

Kenna smiled, her spear trembling beside her. "No need to worry, I have already killed over 200 important warriors and weaponized them in place. I was just waiting for you two to return so we can start the assault."

Bello and Calix turned and looked at each other. They never expected Kenna to have made this much progress already. However, upon hearing what she had done, they could only smile and give her a thumbs-up.
Just as Kenna was about to tell them her plan, three shadows appeared and transformed into dark-cloaked humanoids.
"Who are you guys?" Calix asked, his scythe poised for an attack.

One of the shadow fiends, the Immortal Lord, bowed slightly and spoke in a formal tone, "Greetings, fellow hunters. I am by the name Clipper. My companions and I were sent by Lord Faceless to come aid you in your conquest."
"Oh, so the master sent you," Kenna and her friends said, dropping their guard.
Just when she was about to introduce herself and her friends, Kent’s voice entered their heads,
"Guys, I will be going away for a while. While gone, use the time to subjugate all 11 cities and bring them under the control of Skull City.
I have sent three deadly assassins to your aid and will probably send more later. In a few days, you will receive 400,000 warriors to aid in your expedition.
I will leave 11 contracts inside the Soul Universe. Whenever you capture a city, they must sign that contract.
Lastly, make sure all warriors are sent to Skull City to undergo the Trial of Evil. A subordinate of mine will add more context when she meets with you."

chapters.title: Chapter 1595: Tormented Chaos Abyss
paragraphs: [An Hour Before Leaving for the Tormented Chaos Abyss]
Kent stood before ten demigods, each oozing a power far beyond their rank.

Among the ten of them, the High Priestess oozed the most potent aura. After receiving the Mark of Evil, she went ahead to pass the Trial of Evil, awakening a unique bloodline that had turned her from a priestess into an enchantress.

She had become very powerful and even more beautiful. In fact, if she were to engage in a battle with someone like Lene or even Avotha, there is no telling whether they could last 10 minutes against her.
Well, while Avotha may be able to last a while against her, the mere fact that she now possesses the power of a Pseudo-God shows she is a monster.
The other nine demigods aren’t weaklings either. Each has a unique class that makes them terrifying warriors. If one were to say a few months ago that they were pacifists, nobody would believe them.
"Congratulations on passing the Trial of Evil."
They nodded, the look of respect deep-rooted in their eyes.
"It was all thanks to Lord Evil’s blessing," the High Priestess, who goes by Adwubi, replied, her head bowing in a show of respect to the Evil King.
"No need for the politeness. After all, you all have been my committed followers and believers, so granting you the power to follow in my likeness is only right.
That said, now that you have tasted the fruit of greatness, you must work to ensure the power of the Evil King spreads as far as the heavens will allow."
"We will do whatever the Evil King commands."
Kent nodded.
He is already aware that, when it comes to the universe’s original inhabitants, he cannot turn them into evil beings as he did with the Velkharians.
These people were star beasts, beings from outside this universe, so turning them into evil beings was even a boon to the Heavens.
They had one less threat to worry about.

While Kent possessing such power can be considered dangerous, they know he would never use it to suppress the universe. If anything, Kent being the leader of such a dangerous race is a good thing for the universe.

"You must lead 400,000 warriors to aid my subordinates in subjugating all the cities in this domain. You have my permission to use any means necessary to make sure they are all brought under the banner of the Evil King.
Once they are brought under control, make sure they all earn the Mark of Evil, and those strong enough must undergo the Trial of Evil.
Do not force the weak and unwilling to take the Trial of Evil, but it is imperative they earn the Mark of Evil, else they will be left behind when I return.
Once all cities are conquered, find a way to open the portal to the other six domains. It is time for the Star Realm to become the Evil Realm, and I am going to need all of you to make that happen."
"We will do our best, Lord Evil."
"I know you will. Now go and make me proud."
They bowed and left to form the army. So far, over 500,000 warriors are ready to match up. However, knowing the city needed protection, Kent only asked for 400,000.
He knew just this number would be more than enough to handle the mission. Up against millions, just 400,000 of his evil warriors would be more than enough.
After they left, he allowed himself to take a breather before turning into mist and flying away. A few minutes later, he appeared atop a small mountain 40 km away from Skull City.
"Ryoa, time to go, buddy," Kent called out to his spear, who had been away exploring the world while he was in seclusion.
A few seconds after he said that, a dark beam came from a distance and stopped a meter from him. The beam transformed into a demonic, pale-skinned dragon-man.
"Finally. I have already been to the entrance of the Tormented Chaos Abyss, so we can teleport without having to waste time flying."
Kent nodded.
"Then let’s go."
Ryoa snapped his finger, and a dark portal opened. Kent walked forward and jumped inside. Ryoa followed, and when he too entered, it closed behind them.
A few seconds later, they appeared in a valley somewhere in the Star Realm.
"This is the Grim Valley. Apparently, it is home to three deadly Immortal Lord-level star beasts. I could have taken care of them myself, but I figured Master could use them to test his strength."
"Okay then." Kent smiled and started walking forward without a care in the world.
A few minutes after walking over a dozen kilometers, he sensed a presence moving toward him. Sensing danger, he stopped and turned toward the source.
There, just beyond the bushes, a green-eyed hyena locked its dangerous gaze on him. Sensing Kent’s gaze, it growled and then lunged forward, its forelegs poised for an attack.
Kent smiled faintly and channeled his Blood Core, tapping into the Blood Sea. "Time to test the Blood Calamity Fist."
Just as the hyena was a few meters away, he punched forward, sending a large, metallic blood fist toward the approaching predator.
Kent furrowed his brow when he saw the blood fist had now become much more solid and was even coated with what appeared to be metal.
The giant red fist landed and exploded on the hyena’s chest, sending it crashing back. Its body slammed into the ground, and while it growled, trying to rise back up, Kent knew it was all futile.
The strike may have contained only 20% of his power; however, thanks to the buffs he had received, it was more than enough to end the poor beast that picked a fight with the wrong target.
Controlling the blood that started spilling from its body, Kent formed a dagger from it and stabbed it into its neck, ending its misery.
"That was easy enough," Kent muttered and looked ahead, sensing two more Immortal Lord-level beasts watching him.
While his Soul Map had become much stronger, it had also expanded from 80,000 km to 200,000 km. Now, he could see much farther and in much more detail.

Locking onto the second beast, Kent teleported and appeared before it, his fist shooting forward like a missile. The beast was slow to evade, so when it was struck on its head, it exploded, ending its existence in an instant.
The third beast saw this and tried to run. However, with Kent having the 200,000 km range under his control, he commanded his ice element to form a large shield around it.
Before it could make any attempt to break the ice walls, Kent appeared, his fist driving a hole into its head.
If Immortal Lords from the Infinity Universe were to witness this, they would run with their tails tucked between their legs.
After the last beast was killed, Kent gazed due west and teleported, appearing before a dark hole in the ground. Ryoa appeared beside him and transformed into a bone dragon.
"So much Chaos Essence in the air." A smile formed on his face.
"Time for us to see what is hidden there." He jumped onto Ryoa’s back and, without any hesitation, they started plunging deep into the darkness below.
