Once all cities are conquered, find a way to open the portal to the other six domains.
It is time for the Star Realm to become the Evil Realm, and I am going to need all of you to make that happen."
"We will do our best, Lord Evil."
"I know you will.
Now go and make me proud."
They bowed and left to form the army.
So far, over 500,000 warriors are ready to match up.
However, knowing the city needed protection, Kent only asked for 400,000.
He knew just this number would be more than enough to handle the mission.
Up against millions, just 400,000 of his evil warriors would be more than enough.
After they left, he allowed himself to take a breather before turning into mist and flying away.
A few minutes later, he appeared atop a small mountain 40 km away from Skull City.
"Ryoa, time to go, buddy," Kent called out to his spear, who had been away exploring the world while he was in seclusion.
A few seconds after he said that, a dark beam came from a distance and stopped a meter from him.
The beam transformed into a demonic, pale-skinned dragon-man.
"Finally.
I have already been to the entrance of the Tormented Chaos Abyss, so we can teleport without having to waste time flying."
Kent nodded.
"Then let’s go."
Ryoa snapped his finger, and a dark portal opened.
Kent walked forward and jumped inside.
Ryoa followed, and when he too entered, it closed behind them.
A few seconds later, they appeared in a valley somewhere in the Star Realm.
"This is the Grim Valley.
Apparently, it is home to three deadly Immortal Lord-level star beasts.
I could have taken care of them myself, but I figured Master could use them to test his strength."
"Okay then." Kent smiled and started walking forward without a care in the world.
A few minutes after walking over a dozen kilometers, he sensed a presence moving toward him.
Sensing danger, he stopped and turned toward the source.
There, just beyond the bushes, a green-eyed hyena locked its dangerous gaze on him.
Sensing Kent’s gaze, it growled and then lunged forward, its forelegs poised for an attack.
Kent smiled faintly and channeled his Blood Core, tapping into the Blood Sea.
"Time to test the Blood Calamity Fist."
Just as the hyena was a few meters away, he punched forward, sending a large, metallic blood fist toward the approaching predator.
Kent furrowed his brow when he saw the blood fist had now become much more solid and was even coated with what appeared to be metal.
The giant red fist landed and exploded on the hyena’s chest, sending it crashing back.
Its body slammed into the ground, and while it growled, trying to rise back up, Kent knew it was all futile.
The strike may have contained only 20% of his power; however, thanks to the buffs he had received, it was more than enough to end the poor beast that picked a fight with the wrong target.
Controlling the blood that started spilling from its body, Kent formed a dagger from it and stabbed it into its neck, ending its misery.
"That was easy enough," Kent muttered and looked ahead, sensing two more Immortal Lord-level beasts watching him.
While his Soul Map had become much stronger, it had also expanded from 80,000 km to 200,000 km.
Now, he could see much farther and in much more detail.
Locking onto the second beast, Kent teleported and appeared before it, his fist shooting forward like a missile.
The beast was slow to evade, so when it was struck on its head, it exploded, ending its existence in an instant.
The third beast saw this and tried to run.
However, with Kent having the 200,000 km range under his control, he commanded his ice element to form a large shield around it.
Before it could make any attempt to break the ice walls, Kent appeared, his fist driving a hole into its head.
If Immortal Lords from the Infinity Universe were to witness this, they would run with their tails tucked between their legs.
After the last beast was killed, Kent gazed due west and teleported, appearing before a dark hole in the ground.
Ryoa appeared beside him and transformed into a bone dragon.
"So much Chaos Essence in the air." A smile formed on his face.
"Time for us to see what is hidden there." He jumped onto Ryoa’s back and, without any hesitation, they started plunging deep into the darkness below.

chapters.title: Chapter 1596: Chaos Essence
paragraphs: From what Princess Pandora told Kent, the Tormented Chaos Abyss has three layers: the Tormented Layer, the Chaos Layer, and the Abyss Layer.
The Tormented Layer houses demigod-level Chaos Beasts and below. The majority of them, however, are Immortal Lords and Demigods.
It has five regions: East, West, North, South, and Central. In every region, at least four demigod-level beasts can be found, along with thousands of Immortal-level Chaos Beasts.
These demigods rule the regions, but that doesn’t mean they are the only demigods in the Tormented layer.
The Central Region, however, has only one beast, the Crimson Blood Demon General.
Kent’s mission this time is to kill that bastard and complete the chain quest that will start updating once he arrives in the Tormented Chaos Abyss.
Of course, saturating his Chaos Heart is of utmost importance. It was the main reason he wanted to venture into the Tormented Chaos Abyss in the first place.
However, now that his regeneration ability has become monstrous, he has become aware that just by being there would be enough. The killing part would be a bonus at this point.

Even before entering the Tormented Chaos Abyss, his Chaos Heart went from 5% saturation to 10%, and that was simply by converting Spiritual Qi to Chaos Qi. What, then, happens when he arrives in a domain with pure Chaos Qi that is easy to absorb?
Kent had yet to find out, so as he stood on Ryoa’s back, plunging deep into the abyss, he looked forward to what would happen.
Two days later, Ryoa broke through a thick storm cloud, descending at a terrifying speed. Kent stood relaxed, his focus directed at the world below them.

He had finally arrived at the Tormented Chaos Abyss, and all he could feel in the air was Chaos Essence. He felt an abundance of it, so as they descended, his body began to open up to absorb the energy in the air.
"Tower, get to work."
Kent commanded, and Tower started using the Star Compass to scan the new world he had arrived in. While the Star Compass didn’t work as intended, it had been a valuable help.
Had it not been for it, Tower would have struggled to map out its locations.
However, now that Tower had become much stronger, she was able to tap into the complete power of the Star Compass and quickly map out the domain they had appeared in.
"We have arrived in the Northern Region of the Tormented Layer. I have scanned this entire region and located all four demigods. I will display their profiles."
Kent nodded and read through the profiles of the four demigod beasts he might face in the Northern Region.
While he had no reason to pick a fight, Kent knew testing out his abilities before meeting the Crimson Blood Demon General would be wise.
Already, he anticipated a good battle, so he wanted to make sense of his abilities first before meeting such a powerhouse.
"Looks like they would be good sport for the start."𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
Kent laughed and then pointed at a mountain 30 km away. "Ryoa, land there."
The bone dragon flew toward the mountain. In no time, they landed, and Kent jumped down. Ryoa transformed back into his humanoid form and spread his senses across the entire Northern Region.
After a few seconds, he smiled. "Looks like they are a bit powerful, Master. Are you up for this, especially against the Tree Dragon?"
Kent smiled and answered, "Even if I am not up for it, I can kill them using my Soul Universe, so you have nothing to worry about."

Ryoa smirked. "I truly have nothing to worry about, Master. I am a True God at the moment, so joining the battle of demigods isn’t something my pride would allow me to do. This is why I plan on venturing into the Chaos Layer while you play here at the Tormented Layer."
Kent turned, looked at his Living Weapon, and chuckled. "Then why are you still here if you intend to abandon me?"
Ryoa shook his head, knowing full well Kent would love to have him by his side. However, knowing what Kent came here to do, Ryoa realizes that combining their powers would be a disaster.
So he had to go to make sure Kent tested his abilities to their fullest potential.
"Before I leave, can you give me some of those Grim Contracts? I need about five."
Kent didn’t bother to ask why he needed the contracts. Reaching into his Soul Universe, Kent pulled out five tokens and handed them over to Ryoa.
"Make sure you don’t pick a fight you cannot win."
"You know me already, Master. I always win, no matter the odds." The moment those words left his mouth, he turned into a dark beam and disappeared into the distance.

Watching him go, Kent shook his head and smiled. "I should probably look for a new weapon. Knowing how unruly living weapons can be, I wouldn’t be surprised if Gaap also started running off on his own solo adventures."
Kent chuckled and sat down in a lotus posture.
Turning to the system screen, he opened the message that had appeared.
[You have received the first quest (1/4).]
[Quest Level: SS]
– Objective: [Kill or contract all four demigod beasts in the Northern Region.]
– Reward: [10 Grim Contracts, Ten Chaos Stones.]
"Sounds like my mission has been handed to me." Looking at the objective, he knew meeting the demigods was inevitable.
"I just hope they aren’t a disappointment."
Turning his attention to other messages he had received, Kent allowed his body to absorb the Chaos Essence in the air for the time being.
At the same time, while that was happening, the cocoon inside his Soul Sea housing the Dragon Intent was also progressing quickly.
By the time he had fully saturated his Chaos Heart, that too would be ready.
The only thing keeping him on edge now was the tree growing inside his Soul Sea. While a part of him believed he had nothing to worry about, he knew he could not lower his guard.
If by any chance he managed to get something good out of it, then thanks to his luck.
However, if the outcome was as dangerous as Tower made it sound, then perhaps he would have a good battle and hopefully earn something worthwhile from it later.
Kent remained seated for five hours, taking his Chaos Heart from 12% to 25%. By then, he felt like he was ready to handle the first of four quests he would be embarking on.
The Grim Contract is a unique beast contract that, when signed between a beast tamer and a beast, grants half of the beast’s soul strength to the beast tamer.

While the beast won’t feel anything even after half of their soul essence is taken away, the beast tamer surely would feel the change. So if Kent were to use it on the demigod beasts, his soul would become much stronger.
"Tower, which of the demigod beasts is closest to my current location?"
Yggzrael, The Frozen Tree Dragon
Race: Ancient Chaos Treant Dragon
Cultivation: Peak Demigod
Element: Nature/Ice Chaos
Skills
↠ Frozen Forest Domain
↠ Chaos Root Imprisonment
↠ Ice Dragon Breath
↠ World Tree Regeneration
"Sounds like it would be a perfect target to test my dragon abilities on."
Feeling confident, Kent stood up and activated his dragon wings. Now that he had become an Immortal, he had no reason to use the [Jade Void Wings], especially not against a demigod.
Taking to the air, he disappeared into the distance, speeding toward Yggzrael, the Frozen Tree Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1597: Yggzrael, The Frozen Tree Dragon
paragraphs: "Absolute Ice,"
Kent muttered, staring at a vast ice domain spanning several kilometers wide.
He had no idea just how vast the Tormented Chaos Abyss is, but staring at the domain of the Frozen Tree Dragon, he could tell it was indeed vast.
His first target was the Frozen Tree Dragon, a chaos beast made purely from plant and ice. It is a dragon, but one from the tree dragon race.𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
Because of its unique composition, it wielded both the Ice and Wood elements. Naturally, as a peak demigod, its control over ice and wood was on a whole different level.
However, despite knowing all this, Kent had no fear in his eyes as he gazed at the large dragon about 600 km away from his location.
"I wonder why I haven’t yet formed an Ice Core,"

Tower hovered beside him. "The master is required to find an Ice Source first before thinking about forming an Ice Core. Of course, with the amount of Ice Qi the master currently has stored, he can harness it to fight even beings like this dragon.
Even if the master runs out of ice essence, the master can convert chaos qi or even Blood qi."
Kent smiled and jumped off the mountain, landing softly on the ground. "Then how about I test my ice abilities on this Tree Dragon?"
"The master can do whatever he wants. I will just stand by and observe,"
Kent nodded and then took flight. A few seconds later, he transformed into a large dragon, his wings spread wide, and a powerful chaos essence started oozing off his body.
With a single flap of his wings, he closed the gap between them by several km.
ROAR
He let out a powerful roar that resonated throughout the entire ice domain, the Frozen Tree Dragon commanded.
He wanted to announce his presence, and so, tapping into his [Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty] innate+ ability, he did just that.
What Kent never expected was the reaction he received when he [Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty] on the Frozen Tree Dragon.
Maybe it was because Kent had forgotten he had now become a True Immortal, so he unleashed his [Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty] in full capacity.
Due to that reckless action, just as he closed in on the Tree Dragon, it quickly transformed into a humanoid form and went down on its knees, its body trembling like it was made of a massage chair.
Kent came to a halt 100 meters away and transformed into his humanoid form, astonishment appearing on his face.
"Please spare this young one, my Lord Monarch. I am willing to offer my domain and treasures as compensation for my life."
"Hold on a minute," Kent was practically stunned at this point. "Aren’t you like a demigod or something? Why are you cowering before me like a little coward?"
Even if he were a Monarch, the mere fact that his cultivation base was only at the True Immortal stage shouldn’t have been enough to scare a demigod to this point.

Kenthad already seen from Chaos’s memories the kind of influence he commanded when he became a Monarch. Back then, he was able to make Immortal Kings, Emperors, and some Immortal Monarchs submit to him when he was a True Immortal.
Against Immortal Lords, not all submitted.

In fact, out of ten Immortal Lords, only two submitted to him, so he knew for a fact he could not count on the [Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty] to force this demigod chaos beast to become his contracted beast.
Using the [Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty] was merely his way of announcing his presence in the Tormented Layer.
He never intended to use it to suppress anyone, not when he came to test his combat power. If his opponents surrender before he attacks, how would that help him?
"If calling me a coward would be enough to win this young lord’s mercy, then I, Yggzrael, am willing to accept whatever name and title you have for me."
Kent facepalmed, a pale smile appearing on his face.
"Stand up first."
Watching as Yggzrael slowly stood up, his gaze lowered, not daring to look Kent in the eye, a pale smile formed on Kent’s face.
’This is unbelievable.’ Kent turned and looked at Tower, who averted her gaze, almost as if she had expected this to happen.
"Tell me, Yggzrael, why did you surrender when you could have fought back?"
"The young lord carries the aura of a Monarch, so naturally, I am obligated to bow before you as a sign of respect. Failure to do so means my death, and I do not want to die just yet,"
"Well, nobody wants to die, Yggzrael. However, from where I stand, you are a demigod while I am merely a True Immortal. Shouldn’t that be all the reason you need to fight me and kill me?"
"I wouldn’t dare raise my weapon against the Young Lord."
"Oh, why not?"
"Because the Young Lord carries the aura of a Monarch. Monarchs are only found in the Chaos and Abyss Layer, so even if the Young Lord has the strength of a True Immortal, I wouldn’t dare fight you."
"Oh, so that is the reason, huh?" Kent laughed, a bit amused.

It appeared that in the Tormented Chaos Abyss, beasts with the bloodline aura of a Monarch were found only in the Chaos and Abyss Layer, the deepest and most dangerous layer in all of the Tormented Chaos Abyss.
"Tell me, Yggzrael, have you ever been to the Abyss Layer?"
"No, Young Lord. However, I have heard stories of that layer." Yggzrael paused, slowly raised his head, and looked Kent in the eye. "If the Young Lord wishes, I would like to share what I know."

While Kent wanted to laugh and say, "Wasn’t he the same person who claimed Kent was from the Abyss Layer and, by extension, that he should already know more about that place than Kent?" Kent swallowed his question and decided to hear what he had to say.
He retrieved two spirit fruits and threw one at Yggzrael. "Let’s sit first."
Yggzrael nodded and rapidly bent the ice to form two chairs for them. Kent occupied one, and Yggzrael took the other.
"Although I came to test my combat abilities, seeing my [Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty] in action can be considered a win." Kent smiled and turned to Yggzrael.
"Go ahead, tell me what you know of the Abyss Layer."
Yggzrael nodded and started to reveal all he knew of the Abyss Layer.
While Yggzrael was speaking with Kent, three demigod beasts stood firmly in their respective domains, panicked expressions on their faces.
They were the other three demigod beasts in the Northern Region.
Just now, they felt a terrifying presence appear in the Northern Region, causing them all to drop whatever they were doing and prepare to face whatever danger was coming their way.
"I wonder who Yggzrael has offended," Morveth said, his gaze turned toward Yggzrael’s domain.
"Has Lord Crimson finally come out of seclusion and decided to absorb our domains?" Baelgor, or as most call him, Mammoth, muttered, the look of fear appearing on his face.

In the other region, Kryzoth shuddered and drew in a cold breath, his gaze narrowing toward Yggzrael’s domain. "Whatever that was, I had better prepare to go all out, or else I might die before I get my hands on that scum."

While the three demigod beasts of the Northern Region prepared to handle the presence that had appeared inside their domain, the other regions also felt Kent’s overwhelming presence, and so they started to prepare for his inevitable arrival.
Kent had no idea that by forming his Chaos Heart and awakening as a True Evil, his presence had undergone several mutations, making it even more overwhelming than that of other Monarchs.
The current him carried the aura of a Chaos Dragon, True Evil, Flame Tyrant, and Blood Warlock. Soon, his Dragon Intent would awaken, and all hell would break loose.

Monarchs are only found in the Chaos and Abyss Layer, so even if the Young Lord has the strength of a True Immortal, I wouldn’t dare fight you."
"Oh, so that is the reason, huh?" Kent laughed, a bit amused.

It appeared that in the Tormented Chaos Abyss, beasts with the bloodline aura of a Monarch were found only in the Chaos and Abyss Layer, the deepest and most dangerous layer in all of the Tormented Chaos Abyss.
"Tell me, Yggzrael, have you ever been to the Abyss Layer?"
"No, Young Lord.
However, I have heard stories of that layer." Yggzrael paused, slowly raised his head, and looked Kent in the eye.
"If the Young Lord wishes, I would like to share what I know."

While Kent wanted to laugh and say, "Wasn’t he the same person who claimed Kent was from the Abyss Layer and, by extension, that he should already know more about that place than Kent?" Kent swallowed his question and decided to hear what he had to say.
He retrieved two spirit fruits and threw one at Yggzrael.
"Let’s sit first."
Yggzrael nodded and rapidly bent the ice to form two chairs for them.
Kent occupied one, and Yggzrael took the other.
"Although I came to test my combat abilities, seeing my [Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty] in action can be considered a win." Kent smiled and turned to Yggzrael.
"Go ahead, tell me what you know of the Abyss Layer."
Yggzrael nodded and started to reveal all he knew of the Abyss Layer.
While Yggzrael was speaking with Kent, three demigod beasts stood firmly in their respective domains, panicked expressions on their faces.
They were the other three demigod beasts in the Northern Region.
Just now, they felt a terrifying presence appear in the Northern Region, causing them all to drop whatever they were doing and prepare to face whatever danger was coming their way.
"I wonder who Yggzrael has offended," Morveth said, his gaze turned toward Yggzrael’s domain.
"Has Lord Crimson finally come out of seclusion and decided to absorb our domains?" Baelgor, or as most call him, Mammoth, muttered, the look of fear appearing on his face.
In the other region, Kryzoth shuddered and drew in a cold breath, his gaze narrowing toward Yggzrael’s domain.
"Whatever that was, I had better prepare to go all out, or else I might die before I get my hands on that scum."

While the three demigod beasts of the Northern Region prepared to handle the presence that had appeared inside their domain, the other regions also felt Kent’s overwhelming presence, and so they started to prepare for his inevitable arrival.
Kent had no idea that by forming his Chaos Heart and awakening as a True Evil, his presence had undergone several mutations, making it even more overwhelming than that of other Monarchs.
The current him carried the aura of a Chaos Dragon, True Evil, Flame Tyrant, and Blood Warlock.
Soon, his Dragon Intent would awaken, and all hell would break loose.

chapters.title: Chapter 1598: Fighting Yggzrael
paragraphs: Yggzrael spent some time telling Kent all he knew about the Abyss Layer.
From what he said, it appeared that in the Abyss layer, there are four overlords, each terrifying opponents.
Yggzrael couldn’t put into words the true extent of their strength. However, from what he said, it appeared these four overlords were stronger than Celestials.
Before coming to the Tormented Chaos Abyss, Princess Pandora told him that her main body was one of the overlords of the Abyss Layer and that she had 25% authority over the Tormented Chaos Abyss.
Since that was the case, it might mean the other three overlords were on the same level as her.

Kent came to this conclusion because, in his opinion, if she were stronger than they, she would have suppressed them a long time ago. However, since she hadn’t, it showed those three overlords were very terrifying.
As someone who knew just how terrifying the Queen of Evil truly was, Kent realized that the other three overlords weren’t beings he could afford to antagonize.
Even when he was at his peak as the Ruthless Bandit, he knew he wouldn’t be able to last an hour against 25% of the Queen of Evil’s power.
Thanks to this reveal, he finally understood why Yggzrael was scared of him.

Apparently, aside from the overlords, there were even Immortal Lord-level beasts in the Abyss Layer. However, these beasts were under the authority of the overlords, and as such, the power they held was not something low-level beasts like them could contend with.
Also, the beasts there, regardless of their cultivation, each had the aura of a Monarch. Because of this, they didn’t dare mess around with beings from that layer.
"So you thought I was from the Abyss Layer," Kent chuckled, a bit helpless at what Yggzrael assumed of him.
"Young Master holds the presence of a Monarch... in fact, Young Master’s presence is even more commanding compared to a Monarch I had once met. I dare not antagonize this young master."
Kent smiled and nodded. "Worry not, I am not from the Abyss Layer. However, I plan on visiting there someday."
Yggzrael only looked at Kent with a bewildered expression.

"Enough about me. How about you, Yggzrael? Do you want to become my contracted beast? If you accept, I will grant you powers far beyond your understanding and even ensure you leave this place and have the chance to explore the universe out there."
If it were before Kent unleashed his [Chaos Monarch’s Sovereignty], maybe Yggzrael would have become mad and attacked Kent out of anger for saying he wanted to make him his contracted beast.
However, in the wild, the strong rule.
Yggzrael had recognized Kent’s strength, so he had no reason to reject the offer he had been given. If it meant saving his neck, taking a master wasn’t too bad.
Even so, he sat there for a minute to analyze a few things.
Before he could respond, Kent smiled and said:

"If you want, I am willing to take you on in a duel. If you can withstand three attacks from me, I will elevate your bloodline to Celestial Grade and even grant you a unique cultivation method that would one day allow you to ascend to the rank of a Monarch."
"I accept."
"Good. Then let’s fight first before signing the contract."
Kent smiled happily.
He came to test his abilities, so having the chance to fight Yggzrael felt like the best thing that had happened to him since he became a True Immortal.
In no time, they were ready to fight.
"Be sure to give it your all, Yggzrael. I don’t know the true extent of my abilities just yet."
Yggzrael nodded and prepared for Kent to attack.
Seeing he hadn’t raised any defense yet, Kent smiled and raised his right hand.
Tapping into the knowledge behind the [Finger of Destruction], he activated it, but instead of fire, he used ice.
BOOM
The cloud exploded, and a large finger appeared, a terrifying pressure descending on Yggzrael. Initially, he was prepared to fight, but first wanted to see what power Kent had.
Now, he saw it, and the expression on his face changed.
Abandoning his human form, he transformed back into a large Tree Dragon, his body covered in crystal ice.
"Frozen Forest Domain,"

Yggzrael tapped into one of his strongest defensive abilities, and at once, a large fortress of ice made from both roots and ice formed, creating a large defensive structure strong enough to block a full-on attack from even a God Ascension stage cultivator.
"That won’t be enough, buddy," Kent grinned, his left eye emitting a black aura. Inside his soul sea, his Evil Core spun, releasing waves of Evil Qi.

Up in the air, dark runes started appearing on the finger that was halfway through the cloud. The moment the first rune appeared, the pressure doubled, and a crack appeared in the [Frozen Forest Domain.]
But it didn’t end there.
As more runes started to appear, the pressure kept increasing.
"What in the hell?" Yggzrael felt his brain go numb as the pressure falling down on him continued to increase.
He tapped into his power and summoned more frozen structures. Aside from that, he activated two more defensive abilities, [Ice Dragon Shield] and [Palm of Carnage].
The moment the two skills appeared, the pressure bearing down on him lessened.
Kent noticed it, so he did the next best thing. He tapped into his Chaos Heart and unleashed 1% of his Chaos Qi.
BOOM BOOM BOOM
The [Frozen Forest Domain], [Ice Dragon Shield], and [Palm of Carnage] shattered the moment this Chaos Essence was added.
Pfft
Yggzrael transformed back into his humanoid form and coughed up a mouthful of blood, his pale expression whiter than before.
Seeing this, Kent smiled and snapped his finger, causing the [Finger of Destruction] to disperse into a mist of ice, Evil Qi, and Chaos Qi.
"What was that?" Yggzrael asked, the look in his eyes telling Kent that if before he was scared of him, now he was terrified.
Kent laughed. "Nothing to be worried about. I just used 25% of my Ice Qi, 5% Evil Qi, and 1% Chaos Qi to unleash that attack. I never expected it would be that powerful."

"Powerful... that attack was terrifying. While I am not that good at defense, I doubt even someone with decent defense would survive such an attack." Yggzrael wiped the blood off the corner of his mouth.
"Just who are you really?"
Kent laughed and stretched his arms. "Nobody special."
Yggzrael could only shake his head and will himself to stop shaking.

What both he and Kent didn’t know was that just now, when Kent activated the [Finger of Destruction], the purple cocoon inside Kent’s soul sea stirred and released a strand of incomplete Dragon Intent.
That incomplete strand transformed the attack beyond what Kent expected. However, because he had no idea what had happened, both of them remained oblivious.
Already, the [Dragon Intent] Seed had reached 78% completion. However, without knowing it, it had already started aiding Kent.

Had it not been for it, Yggzrael would have been able to defend against the [Finger of Destruction]. However, now, things were different, and Kent, who had just defeated a peak-level demigod, could only let his pride and ego inflate.
After making sure Yggzrael had calmed down, Kent retrieved one of the Grim Contracts and activated it. Two runes appeared from it, one merging with Yggzrael while the other merged with Kent.
In no time, the contract was signed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1599: Verdant Abyss Corefruit
paragraphs: [Grim Contract Successfully Formed]
[Yggzrael has become your Contracted Beast]
[Granting Benefits...]
[→ Bloodline Evolution Path: Unlocked]
[→ Cultivation Limit Break: Removed]
[→ Monarch Pathway: Initiated]
[You have received 50% of Yggzrael’s soul power]
Kent’s soul surged, waves of overwhelming power seeping deep into his body. The contract was formed, and the benefits were immediate.
He had expected his soul to become stronger after forming the Grim Contract with Yggzrael, since that was the nature of the contract. However, what he felt was beyond anything he had expected.
Already, his soul cultivation had reached Tier 30. That made him an Immortal Lord in soul cultivation.
However, judging by how vast his soul sea was and the fact that the soul universe had become much more powerful, even demigods could not contend with him in soul arts.
However, after all this, Yggzrael still managed to strengthen his soul to the point where he saw a profound change. He even felt his soul universe expand.
That was beyond anything he had expected.
’Makes me wonder who created the Grim Contract,’ Kent smiled and turned to look at Yggzrael.
Seeing the dazed look that had appeared on his face, Kent could tell he was in shock, and perhaps more blown away than he was.
Naturally, that was indeed true. Yggzrael had never expected the changes he felt to happen the moment he formed the contract with Kent.
He was a dragon, so naturally, arrogance was his nature. However, from the moment Kent appeared before him, his arrogance vanished, replaced by respect and fear.
Kent terrified him, but his strength made him respect him. Now, however, he did not know what to even think.
"Until today, my bloodline had not undergone the evolution to become Divine. However, I can feel an evolution rising deep within me. Soon, I believe I will become a Divine Beast."
The happiness on his face and in his voice made Kent smile.
Kent had already discovered that there are actually four groups, grades, levels, or ranks of blood essence.
Five, if the common grade is added.
The first of them is the Divine grade, where beasts or humans with such blood essence were known as Divine Beasts or Divine Beings.
Vexthra and the rest of her sisters were at this stage. Below that grade were ordinary beings who could be classified as common.
The second stage is the Monarch stage.
At this stage, Beast Monarchs such as the Primordial Chaos Dragon, who ruled the Primordial Era, could be put in this category. This rank makes them super powerful and more domineering.

However, it had been rumored above the monarch stage that there is another grade known as Overlord. They ranked above Monarchs. In fact, just one Overlord is powerful enough to take on thousands of Monarchs.

Kent had reason to believe that the beings hidden within the Abyss layer are probably Overlords. He could not confirm that yet, but he intended to find out when Princess Pandora’s main body awakened and found him.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
The last rank, however, had only been mentioned once. Kent had no idea whether they existed, but he was not about to be arrogant and say they did not, because he believed they did.
Tyrants existed, but he prayed he would not meet them just yet.
Even he, who was a Monarch, was already terrifying enough. How much more terrifying would a Tyrant be?
"Rest assured, Yggzrael, with me around, becoming a Monarch one day is not impossible."
With the knowledge he had received during the Tower’s upgrade, he was confident that, aside from him, the people around him would soon become much more powerful.
Yggzrael nodded and allowed himself to feel happy. After savoring his joy for a few minutes, he turned toward Kent and knelt down.
"I pledge on my Chaos Core that I, Yggzrael, will follow the Young Master through thick and thin. I will give my life to protect the Master."
As if to prove his loyalty, he waved his hand, and a storage pouch appeared. He presented it to Kent.
"Contained in this pouch are all the valuable treasures I have collected over the thousands of years I ruled this domain."
Kent smiled and received the gift he was being offered. As someone who liked to take what did not belong to him, he was not about to deny such valuables.
Peeking inside, a broad smile formed on his face. "Oh my, so many goodies."
Yggzrael smiled, a part of him cursing himself for presenting everything to Kent. However, recalling the benefits he had reaped after becoming Kent’s contracted beast, he let himself calm down.
Now, aside from cultivating like normal people, he would never meet bottlenecks in his cultivation path. That alone was more than enough for him to give everything he owned to Kent.
Kent reached into the pouch and pulled out a green fruit oozing the power of chaos. It looked like an orange, but slightly bigger. On its surface, small runes could be seen.
"Verdant Abyss Corefruit." Kent brought it close to his nose and smelled it, his eyes sparkling.
He looked at Yggzrael and smiled. "Thanks, buddy. With this, I will make so much progress."
Yggzrael nodded at his master. "I am happy I can help the Young Master."
Kent sat in a lotus posture and decided to eat the Verdant Abyss Corefruit first. However, knowing it might take him a few days to absorb everything, he decided to put Yggzrael to work first.
"Yggzrael, visit the other domains and tell them to come see me in five days’ time. Failure to do so means they have chosen death."
"I will do as you command, Young Master."
Kent nodded and watched as Yggzrael sped off toward the domain of the second demigod beasts in the Northern Region.
"With this fruit, I will awaken my Dragon Intent and even push my Chaos Heart close to saturation."
Perhaps already eager to taste the essence, Kent took a bite out of the Verdant Abyss Corefruit, and the pure chaos essence seeped deep into his body.
Feeling the power strengthen his body, he smiled and took another bite. The Dragon Intent seed trembled as waves of chaos essence were absorbed into it.
In less than three hours, Kent consumed the entire fruit and waited for the essence to be completely absorbed.

Meanwhile, after Yggzrael left his domain, he made his way toward Morveth’s domain. Morveth is one of the demigods in the northern region. He is a Mid-level Demigod known mostly as the Night Crow Sovereign.
He came from a race called Chaos Ravens, so when it came to speed and aerial combat, he could be counted among the top ten in the Tormented Layer.
After he heard the roar come from Yggzrael’s domain, he was on high alert. So even long before Yggzrael reached his domain, he had sensed the approaching figure.
What he never expected, however, was to see Yggzrael when he had anticipated him to be dead, considering the pressure he felt came from Yggzrael’s domain.
But seeing Yggzrael appear in his domain, he was taken aback.
His shock, however, intensified when he sensed that Yggzrael had become much stronger than he was the last time they met.
Yggzrael was a Peak-level Demigod, while Morveth was a Mid-level Demigod. However, judging by the aura now coming off Yggzrael, it was about three times his previous strength.
"Yggzrael, what happened to you?"
Morveth asked, his expression narrowing.
Yggzrael smiled and flicked his hair back. "What, were you expecting to hear that I died?"
To his utter shock, Morveth nodded. "Of course I expected you to die. After all, the presence I felt was that of a Monarch. How are you still alive?"
"Tsk." Yggzrael smirked and said, "I am still alive simply because the Young Lord spared my life and allowed me to become his subordinate." He paused, letting the frown on Morveth’s face deepen.
"In fact, I am here because the Young Master wants you to become his subordinate too."

Morveth is one of the demigods in the northern region.
He is a Mid-level Demigod known mostly as the Night Crow Sovereign.
He came from a race called Chaos Ravens, so when it came to speed and aerial combat, he could be counted among the top ten in the Tormented Layer.
After he heard the roar come from Yggzrael’s domain, he was on high alert.
So even long before Yggzrael reached his domain, he had sensed the approaching figure.
What he never expected, however, was to see Yggzrael when he had anticipated him to be dead, considering the pressure he felt came from Yggzrael’s domain.
But seeing Yggzrael appear in his domain, he was taken aback.
His shock, however, intensified when he sensed that Yggzrael had become much stronger than he was the last time they met.
Yggzrael was a Peak-level Demigod, while Morveth was a Mid-level Demigod.
However, judging by the aura now coming off Yggzrael, it was about three times his previous strength.
"Yggzrael, what happened to you?"
Morveth asked, his expression narrowing.
Yggzrael smiled and flicked his hair back.
"What, were you expecting to hear that I died?"
To his utter shock, Morveth nodded.
"Of course I expected you to die.
After all, the presence I felt was that of a Monarch.
How are you still alive?"
"Tsk." Yggzrael smirked and said, "I am still alive simply because the Young Lord spared my life and allowed me to become his subordinate." He paused, letting the frown on Morveth’s face deepen.
"In fact, I am here because the Young Master wants you to become his subordinate too."

chapters.title: Chapter 1600: Dragon Intent Unleashed
paragraphs: "Hold on a minute, Yggzrael. Did you just say you had become a subordinate of a Monarch? But how?" Morveth was left in shock, learning that Yggzrael had become Kent’s subordinate.
From what he had heard of Monarchs, they would not lower themselves to take unranked beasts as their subordinates.
In fact, most came down to the Chaos or Tormented Layer to train through bloodshed. Their servants are mostly Divine Beasts, and sometimes even Monarch Beasts.
A monarch having another monarch as their servant is a clear sign of superiority and privilege.

Many of the unranked beasts had died at the hands of such tyrannical beasts in the past. So for Yggzrael to say he had become a subordinate of one and even wanted Morveth to join him left the poor demigod in great shock.

"First of all, it would be in your best interest to wipe all such thoughts from your head. My Young Lord is someone very powerful. In fact, when he tested me, I could not handle even one of his attacks."
"WHAT?"
Morveth’s eyes widened. "Surely you must be joking, right? You are the strongest in this region, Yggzrael. Unless the attack came from a god, I am sure you could handle it."

Yggzrael smiled. "I do not know what to tell you, Morveth. I activated all three god-grade defensive techniques I have, yet they all shattered under the weight of his attack. In fact, I never even got to receive the attack head-on, since it overpowered me with just the pressure it exuded."
"That is..." Morveth was tempted to call Yggzrael’s bluff. However, knowing the kind of beast Yggzrael was, he knew he would not lie just to rope him into becoming someone else’s subordinate.
If anything, the kind of rivalry between them would have compelled Yggzrael to stand on the side and watch them all burn.
But here he was, recruiting him to join Kent’s legion.
"Then, compared to that monster hidden in the Central Region, who is the strongest?" Morveth asked, prompting Yggzrael to frown slightly.

"That..." he paused and reexamined Kent’s power and then that of the monster Morveth had referenced. "Honestly, I cannot tell who is stronger. However, I have seen enough of that monster’s power, and so for now, I will say he is stronger.
But you must understand, my Young Lord is just a True Immortal, so maybe he is far more monstrous, considering he defeated me. And I am certain he would defeat you, too."
Morveth could only sigh and nod at Yggzrael’s words.
To be frank with himself, all demigods inside the Tormented Layer were scared of only two things. The first were the Monarch Beasts, mostly from the Chaos and Abyss Layers.
Every few thousand years, they came by to hunt, which they called training. Every time they appeared, all the beasts ran and hid from them, making sure they only came out after they left.
The second was the monster hidden inside the Central Region.
They feared him so much because of the powers he possessed. He was also a Monarch, and his combat power rivaled that of even True Gods.
In the past, when the Monarchs came from the Chaos Layer to hunt, he was the only one who did not run. And that was even before he became a Monarch.
One time, he killed another Monarch Beast that had come from the Chaos Layer, and because of that, three God Beasts were sent over to kill him, only for him to end up killing them.
This incident sent shockwaves throughout the Tormented Layer. Many expected the Monarchs in the Chaos Layer to send more gods after him. However, to their shock, they did not follow up on it.
Since then, whenever new Monarchs arrived, they made sure never to venture into the Central Region.
So, for Yggzrael to say Kent was on the same level as that monster, despite Kent being only a True Immortal, he became interested in Kent.
"One last thing, you have five days to respond to his summon, else do not blame me for not warning you," Yggzrael said, then left.
A few minutes later, Morveth followed him.
He recognized where Yggzrael was headed, and so he decided to join and see what the others would say.
Three days later, all four of them stood in Yggzrael’s domain, staring from 400 km away as Kent sat there still absorbing the Chaos Essence.
"I have seen millions of Immortal-level beasts, but this person scares me," Kryzoth, the Frozen Fang, said, his eyes exuding waves of ice.

Among the four demigod rulers in the northern region, he is the weakest, but also the most mysterious. Over the years, they had all suspected he was hiding his power. However, since he was only an Early Demigod, they placed him at the lowest rank.
Yggzrael smiled and said proudly, "Wait until you face the Young Lord in battle. I am sure you will finally reveal the power you have been hiding from us."
Baelgor, the Thunder Mammoth, laughed. "I do not know if what you said is indeed true, Yggzrael, but I want to test if he can break past my defense."
Among the four of them, Baelgor had the strongest defense and offense, thanks to his robust body and affinity for lightning.

In the past, he and Yggzrael had fought to a stalemate. Right now, he could sense that Yggzrael had become much stronger. Seeing his rival had surpassed him, he accepted Kent’s offer when Yggzrael reached his domain.
They all wanted to come and test the waters first.
Just when they were all growing more curious, the sky suddenly started to turn dark. Tracing the trajectory, they all deduced it was forming over Kent’s head.
"Heavenly Tribulation," Baelgor exclaimed, his expression narrowing.

"It has been 20,000 years since I saw a Heavenly Tribulation. That was when that monster hidden in the Central Region became a Monarch," Yggzrael added, a part of him wondering just what had happened to his Young Master.
In no time, terrible lightning started to churn in the clouds.
BOOM
Suddenly, seated 400 km away, a suffocating intent exploded out of Kent’s body, sending all four demigod beasts to their knees.
"W-What is that..." Baelgor, who prided himself on having a robust defense, felt his body pressed down by a terrible force.
"This pressure," Yggzrael muttered, "it is the same thing I felt when the Young Lord attacked me. Only this time, it is much more pronounced and very potent."
Just when he said that, they saw Kent stand up and stretch.
Then he looked up at the sky and smiled. Under their shocked gaze, he reached into his space ring, pulled out grapes, and started tossing them into his mouth.
"What is he doing?" Kryzoth asked, the shocked look on his face showing how scared he was. What Kent was doing did not align with someone who should be preparing for a Heavenly Tribulation.
Judging by the pressure they sensed when the tribulation cloud first formed, he knew it was not something to scoff at.
So why is Kent that relaxed?
Hearing his worry, Yggzrael smiled and forced his body to turn toward Kryzoth. "That is my Young Lord. You had better open your eyes and witness greatness."
Of course, he was scared for Kent, but he had to show off somehow.
If only they knew Kent was not being arrogant but rather preparing to take a leap of fate toward achieving two objectives at once.
[I have determined the nature of the lightning tribulation, Master. You must endure three deadly attacks using your body.]
[If the Master manages to endure the three lightning attacks, the Dragon Intent will fully awaken.]
[Also, the Master must know that by enduring the three lightning attacks, there is a chance the lightning element will finally awaken.]
"Oh yeah. Bring it on..."
